### [1] [STATERA: Hidden Mass Estimation via Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Kinematics using Frozen Temporal Tubelets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00003)
*Animesh Varma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 STATERA，用冻结的视频骨干（V-JEPA）加轻量时序 tubelet mixer，从短单目视频中预测不透明非对称刚体的质心（CoM）热图与轨迹，并发布 HiddenMass Benchmark。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉模型多为帧级外观预训练，难以从运动中推断隐藏物理属性；在自遮挡下表面线索与点跟踪不可靠，质心定位困难。

Method: 适配预训练视频骨干 V-JEPA，权重大多冻结，仅训练轻量时序 tubelet mixer，输出逐帧 CoM 热图与轨迹；构建 HiddenMass Benchmark（50K MuJoCo 轨迹 + 63 序列实拍测试集，含物理标定 CoM 真值）。

Result: 仿真中 STATERA-50K-Sigma 将归一化 CoM 误差从 DINOv2 的 41.7% 降至 25.2%；零样本 sim-to-real 中，相位感知目标可致双峰预测，相位无关目标会坍缩至统计安全的几何中心；相位感知的 STATERA-50K-Crescent 是唯一持续朝真实隐藏偏移移动的方法，虽因单目矢量过冲略增绝对欧氏误差，但物理捕获率由 2.6% 提升至 41.0%。

Conclusion: 冻结的时序表征能更好地区分惯性动力学与视觉几何，有助于隐藏参数估计。

Abstract: Vision models pretrained for frame-level appearance often struggle to infer hidden physical properties from motion. We study center-of-mass (CoM) localization for opaque, asymmetric rigid bodies from short monocular videos, where surface cues and point tracking are unreliable under self-occlusion. We propose STATERA, which adapts a pretrained video backbone (V-JEPA) with mostly frozen weights and a lightweight temporal tubelet mixer to predict per-frame CoM heatmaps and trajectories. To support this task, we introduce the HiddenMass Benchmark, comprising 50K MuJoCo trajectories and a 63-sequence real-world test set with physically calibrated CoM ground truth. In simulation, STATERA-50K-Sigma improves normalized CoM error from 41.7% (DINOv2) to 25.2%. In zero-shot sim-to-real transfer, we observe a fundamental trade-off in supervision: phase-aware targets can induce bimodal predictions, while phase-agnostic targets can collapse toward statistically safe centroids. Nevertheless, our phase-aware STATERA-50K-Crescent is the only evaluated method that demonstrates consistent movement toward the true hidden offset. While this leads to a monocular vector overshoot artifact that marginally increases absolute Euclidean error compared to a static geometric centroid, it improves physics capture from 2.6% to 41.0%. These results suggest that frozen temporal representations can better separate inertial dynamics from visual geometry for hidden-parameter estimation.

</details>


### [2] [Emergent Object Binding Has a Finite Spatial Horizon](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00006)
*Mayank Singal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文质疑用单一解码准确率概括"同一物体绑定"信号的做法，提出该信号实为具有有限特征尺度的局部空间相干性，并系统刻画其行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练ViT的冻结patch嵌入中可高精度解码出"IsSameObject"信号，暗示物体绑定源于自监督预训练本身；但单一准确率掩盖了信号的结构，作者希望揭示其真实形态与性质，并解释聚合分数无法说明的一系列现象。

Method: 将绑定重新表述为具有有限范围的局部空间相干性；在不同物体尺寸、三种探针家族（probe families）、ADE20K与COCO两个数据集、以及DINO和CLIP主干上，测量同一物体两patch被解码为绑定的概率随二者距离的变化，并对混淆因素加以控制后逐一映射各行为。

Result: 绑定概率随patch间距离单调衰减，并稳定在一个非零地板（floor）上，该衰减可由具有有限长度尺度的指数函数很好地描述；该衰减规律跨物体尺寸、跨三种探针、跨两个数据集、跨DINO与CLIP主干均成立，说明是表示本身的性质而非解码器性质。作为局部相干性可解释：绑定在大物体上变弱；同类不同物体之间的区分比不同类物体更不可靠；物体部件与其整体被归为一组。而一旦控制物体尺寸，遮挡不影响该信号。初步观察到horizon与floor在DINOv2与DINOv3中组织于不同深度，作者因探测层数较少及两模型间存在混淆而仅作提示性报告。

Conclusion: IsSameObject信号并非均质的准确率数值，而是具有有限特征尺度的局部空间相干性；这一视角系统解释了聚合分数无法解释的行为（大物体上绑定减弱、同类物体难以分离、部件与整体聚合），且不受遮挡影响（控制尺寸后）；horizon与floor的深度组织差异具有提示意义但尚需进一步验证。

Abstract: Pretrained Vision Transformers encode whether two image patches belong to the same object. This IsSameObject signal is decodable from frozen patch embeddings at high accuracy, which suggests that object binding emerges from self-supervised pretraining alone. We show that this single accuracy number hides the structure of the signal. Binding is local: the probability that two patches of the same object are decoded as bound falls off monotonically with the distance between them and levels off at a nonzero floor, a falloff well described by an exponential with a finite length scale. This decay holds across object sizes, across three families of probe, on both ADE20K and COCO, and across DINO and CLIP backbones, which indicates that it is a property of the representation rather than of the decoder. Reading binding as local spatial coherence with a finite range accounts for a set of behaviors that the aggregate score leaves unexplained: binding weakens on large objects, separates distinct objects of the same class less reliably than objects of different classes, and groups object parts with their wholes. It is, by contrast, unaffected by occlusion once object size is controlled. We map each behavior with confounds controlled. As a preliminary observation, the horizon and its floor are organized at different depths in DINOv2 and DINOv3, which we report as suggestive given the small number of layers probed and the confound between the two models.

</details>


### [3] [Spatial Lifting for Dense Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00017)
*Mingzhi Xu,Tao Zhou,Yong Li,Yizhe Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 Spatial Lifting (SL)，将2D图像提升到高维空间并用高维网络（如3D U-Net）处理，在密集预测任务上以更低推理成本、更少参数取得良好性能，并支持自洽性质量与不确定性估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统密集预测方法通常参数多、推理成本高。作者希望探索一种更高效、通用的建模策略，既能保持甚至提升基准任务性能，又能大幅降低模型参数量和推理开销。

Method: SL 将标准输入（如2D图像）提升到更高维空间，再使用为该高维空间设计的网络（如3D U-Net）进行处理。该框架沿提升维度产生内在结构化输出，从而支持训练时的密集监督，并在测试时通过单次前向传播实现基于自洽性的质量与不确定性估计。

Result: 与常规方法相比，SL 在基准任务上取得良好性能，同时降低推理成本并大幅减少模型参数量。其提升维度带来的结构化输出可促进密集监督，并实现测试时的自洽性质量与不确定性估计。

Conclusion: Spatial Lifting 提供了一种简单通用的建模策略，为视觉密集预测任务中更高效、准确和可靠的深度网络提供了有前景的方向。

Abstract: We present Spatial Lifting (SL), a novel methodology for dense prediction tasks. SL operates by lifting standard inputs, such as 2D images, into a higher-dimensional space and subsequently processing them using networks designed for that higher dimension, such as a 3D U-Net. Counterintuitively, this dimensionality lifting allows us to achieve good performance on benchmark tasks compared to conventional approaches, while reducing inference costs and \textbf{drastically lowering the number of model parameters}. The SL framework produces intrinsically structured outputs along the lifted dimension. This emergent structure facilitates dense supervision during training and enables single-forward-pass self-consistency-based quality and uncertainty estimation at test time. Spatial Lifting introduces a simple and general modeling strategy that offers a promising path toward more efficient, accurate, and reliable deep networks for dense prediction tasks in vision.

</details>


### [4] [Encoded but Disconnected: Decomposing Vision-Language Model Failures under a Patching Null](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00024)
*Genpei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在三类视觉-语言模型（LLaVA-1.5-7B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B、InternVL3-8B）上，中层表征虽在错误样本中以68–91%的比例编码了正确答案，但该信号对最终预测无因果作用：残差流逐层patch的翻转率为0%，逐头patch在两个架构上亦为0%。仅InternVL3 layer-20 head-2出现局部化例外效应（p<1e-4）。作者转而将错误操作性划分为三种失效模式，并验证其可学习性及机制真实性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究中层可解释性在视觉-语言模型中是否具有跨架构的因果有效性。此前研究多依赖探针（probing）等相关性证据，隐含假设"被编码即被使用"；本文旨在检验该假设，即中层所编码的真值信号是否真正因果驱动最终预测，并借此澄清错误产生的机制来源。

Method: 在三个VLM架构上，于共同基准POPE上开展中层分析。（1）用探针检测中层是否编码ground-truth答案；（2）用残差流patch进行因果干预，分别做层级与逐头（per-head）翻转测试，统计非平凡翻转率（如Qwen共0/12,600次patch前向）；（3）定位并检验唯一例外头（InternVL3 layer-20 head-2，非词表、自注意力头）的效应局部性（p<1e-4）；（4）据观察将错误划分为三种失效模式并训练分类器验证可学习性；（5）用架构先验方向预测两种干预的类别特异性响应（在oracle标签下评估）。

Result: 中层在68–91%的错误中编码正确答案，但该信号不具因果活性：层级patch在所有三个架构上翻转率为0%，逐头patch在三个架构中的两个上为0%（Qwen: 0/12,600）。唯一例外为InternVL3 layer-20 head-2，效应局限于该特定头（p<1e-4）。错误可操作性分为三种失效模式——Perception Failure、Encoded-but-Disconnected、Prior-Override，在三架构上均可学习至60%以上；架构先验方向可预测两种干预中哪一种引发类别特异性响应。缓解效果在oracle标签下报告。

Conclusion: 本文报告一个跨架构的普适性负结果：中层对真值的编码与最终预测之间存在因果断裂，即"编码≠使用"。该结论挑战了以探针精度推断机制重要性的常见做法，并提示错误应被分解为感知失败、编码-输出脱节、先验覆盖等可区分模式。缓解效应仅为类别机制真实性的证据，而非可部署方法；实际部署仍需不依赖oracle标签的干预手段。

Abstract: Across three vision-language model architectures (LLaVA-1.5-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, InternVL3-8B), we report a universal negative finding for mid-layer interpretability. On POPE -- the benchmark common to all three -- the mid layers encode the ground-truth answer in 68-91% of errors, yet this signal is not causally active for the final prediction: residual-stream patching yields 0% non-trivial flip at the layer level on all three architectures, and on two of three at the per-head level (Qwen: 0/12,600 patched forwards). The lone exception, InternVL3 layer-20 head-2, is a non-vocab, self-attending head whose effect is localized to that specific head (p < 1e-4). Despite the null, the errors separate operationally into three failure modes -- Perception Failure, Encoded-but-Disconnected, Prior-Override -- learnable above 60% on all three architectures, and the architecture's prior direction predicts which of two interventions elicits a category-specific response. We report these mitigation effects under oracle labels as evidence the categories are mechanistically real, not as a deployable method.

</details>


### [5] [Domain generalization and synthetic data in object detection: the enabler, the probe, and the gap](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00030)
*Elfi I. S. Hofmeijer,Ella P. Fokkinga,Friso G. Heslinga,Klamer Schutte,Jörgen M. Karlholm*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文综述了面向目标检测的域泛化（DG），从"使能、探针、合成-真实差距"三个视角分析合成数据在其中的作用，并指出未来需发展同时解决定位与分类问题的表征感知方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目标检测模型在分布偏移（如天气、作业环境、目标外观变化）下性能下降；而现有域泛化研究多集中于分类任务，针对检测模型的DG研究稀缺，且检测还面临定位与多尺度表征等额外挑战。合成数据因能大规模生成多样化样本而成为支持DG的潜在工具，但其角色缺乏系统梳理。

Method: 采用文献综述方法，从三个互补视角对合成数据在检测DG中的作用进行梳理：(1) 作为DG使能器，通过多样化和对齐策略提升对分布偏移的鲁棒性；(2) 作为探针，支持受控实验以识别和理解失效模式；(3) 讨论合成到真实（synthetic-to-real）差距这一特殊域偏移形式。

Result: 识别出当前面向目标检测的DG方法存在局限，指出现有方法未能充分应对检测任务中定位与分类在域偏移下的耦合问题。

Conclusion: 未来研究需要发展表征感知（representation-aware）的方法，显式地在域偏移下同时处理定位与分类问题。

Abstract: Object detection models often experience performance degradation when deployed under distribution shifts, caused by for example changes in weather type, operational environment, or object appearance. Domain Generalization (DG) aims to develop models that remain robust under such shifts and generalize well to unseen domains. DG research specifically focused on object detection models is scarce, although these models face additional challenges around localization and multi-scale representations. Synthetic data is a promising tool to support in DG, by enabling large-scale generation of diverse new samples. In this paper, we present an object detection-centric review of DG and examine the role of synthetic data from three complementary perspectives. First, synthetic data acts as an enabler of DG through diversification and alignment strategies that aim to improve robustness to distribution shifts. Second, it serves as a probe that enables controlled experimentation to identify and understand failure modes. Third, we discuss the synthetic-to-real gap, a particularly challenging form of domain shift that arises when models trained on synthetic imagery are deployed on real-world data. Through reviewing these perspectives, we identify limitations of current DG approaches for object detection and argue that future research requires representation-aware methods that explicitly address both localization and classification under domain shift.

</details>


### [6] [Seeing the City or Recognizing the Place? What Street-View Imagery Adds Beyond Existing Urban Data in VLM Urban Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00031)
*Kaizhen Tan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文比较街景图像预测与既有城市数据的增量价值：图像仅在建筑类型、功能和低层楼层数等视觉可辨识属性上占优，其余属性既有数据相当或更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 街景图像被广泛用于推断城市属性，但仅凭预测精度无法判断图像在同一地点已有城市数据之外提供了多少增量信息，因此需要区分图像价值与数据可得性带来的优势。

Method: 在七个属性、五个公共数据源和三个视觉语言模型上比较图像预测与既有城市数据。对同一城市单元分别使用图像、任务上下文、邻近观测和公共记录进行评估，并通过图像替换与冲突记录测试模型对数据源的依赖；同时考察到最近标注建筑距离和建筑高度对图像优势的影响，以及OpenFACADES楼层标注的生成方式（由OpenStreetMap楼层值生成）与误差模式。

Result: 道路损坏、路缘坡道和房价上既有城市数据与图像模型相当或更优；邻近官方统计在人口上几乎匹配最佳图像结果。图像在建筑类型、建筑功能和低层楼层数上信息量更大。楼层数方面，到最近标注建筑距离每翻倍，图像优势增加5.7个百分点，高建筑的屋脊线常超出画面使优势下降。模型常跟随冲突记录，OpenFACADES楼层标注呈现与纯图像重跑相反的随高度变化误差模式。

Conclusion: 街景图像的价值取决于视觉可辨识性和本地数据覆盖度；将图像与既有城市数据对比可指导图像采集并厘清衍生城市地图的数据来源。

Abstract: Street-view imagery is increasingly used to infer urban attributes, but predictive accuracy alone does not reveal how much a photograph contributes beyond data already available for the same place. We compare image-based predictions with existing urban data across seven attributes from five public resources and three VLMs. The same urban units are evaluated using images, task context, nearby observations, and public records, while image replacements and conflicting records test source reliance. Existing urban data matched or exceeded image-only models for road damage, curb ramps, and house price, while neighbouring official statistics nearly matched the best image result for population. Images were more informative for building type, building function, and low-rise floor count. For floor count, image advantage increased by 5.7 percentage points per doubling of distance to the nearest labelled building and declined for tall buildings whose rooflines often fell outside the frame. Models frequently followed conflicting records. OpenFACADES floor annotations were generated with OpenStreetMap floor values and showed the opposite height-dependent error pattern from image-only reruns. Street-view image value therefore depends on visual legibility and local data coverage. Comparing images with existing urban data can guide image collection and clarify the provenance of derived urban maps.

</details>


### [7] [DSSR-3D: Decoupled Reasoning for View-Dependent Referring in 3D Gaussians](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00040)
*Thanh-Khoi Nguyen,Thien-Phuc Tran,Minh-Triet Tran*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DSSR-3D，一个无需重训练的推理期框架，在连续3D高斯场上实现视角相关的指代分割，并构建了ViewRef-GS基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有指代场将语言特征嵌入全局视角不变空间，无法处理依赖相机位姿的观察者中心空间关系（如"在……的左边"）。

Method: 将任务形式化为两个接口：位姿不变语义定位与位姿条件空间推理，任意满足约束的函数对均可实例化；本文用温度锐化softmax定位机制与基于投影的方向评分函数实例化，并通过轻量、免训练的步骤融合；同时提出ViewRef-GS基准，并联合增强的Ref-LERF进行评估。

Result: 相比现有基于3DGS的指代方法取得一致性提升，且无需在基础语义场之外进行额外训练；两个接口可零样本迁移到结构不同的语义场。

Conclusion: DSSR-3D以推理期、免训练方式解决了3D高斯场上的视角相关指代分割问题，不依赖边界框等离散几何代理，并为视角相关空间定位提供了系统化测试平台。

Abstract: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting have enabled open-vocabulary and referring segmentation by distilling semantic knowledge from 2D foundation models into 3D representations. However, existing referring fields embed language features in a globally view-invariant space, making them fundamentally unable to resolve observer-centric spatial relations (e.g., "to the left of") that depend on camera pose. We propose DSSR-3D, an inference-time framework for view-dependent referring segmentation on continuous 3D Gaussian fields, formalized as two interfaces - pose-invariant semantic localization and pose-conditioned spatial reasoning - such that any pair of functions satisfying these constraints yields a valid instantiation, requiring no retraining of the underlying semantic field and no reliance on discrete geometric proxies such as bounding boxes. We instantiate the two interfaces with a temperature-sharpened softmax localization mechanism and a projection-based directional scoring function, fused via a lightweight, training-free step, and show they transfer zero-shot to structurally distinct semantic fields without adaptation. We further propose ViewRef-GS, a benchmark isolating view-dependent segmentation on 3D Gaussian fields, evaluated jointly with an augmented Ref-LERF to provide a comprehensive testbed for viewpoint-dependent spatial grounding. Experiments show consistent gains over existing 3DGS-based referring methods, with no additional training beyond the base semantic field

</details>


### [8] [Reachability Is Not Generalization: Understanding Verb--Noun Decomposition in Assembly Action Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00064)
*Changyi Li,Yu Xiao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文系统分析了装配动作识别中动词-名词分解方法的组合泛化能力，发现其只能部分突破原子分类器的零概率上限，并提出可移植的诊断框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 装配动作具有组合性，部署中常遇到熟悉组件的新组合，但原子动作分类器对任何未见组合的预测概率为零。动词-名词分解被广泛用于预测组件并重组以获得未见动作，然而其在组合偏移下的泛化机制仍缺乏深入理解。

Method: 在三个装配数据集（MECCANO、HAViD、IMPACT）上对动词-名词分解进行系统分析，考察其组合泛化表现、与训练数据共现结构的关系、词表规模不对称导致的瓶颈转移，以及共享编码器训练引起的组件纠缠问题。

Abstract: Assembly actions are compositional: they combine a manipulation with a part or tool. While widely adopted, how decomposition generalizes under compositional shift remains poorly understood. We present a systematic analysis of verb--noun decomposition across three assembly datasets (MECCANO, HAViD, and IMPACT). Although decomposition escapes the atomic ceiling, its generalization extends only partially beyond it. Unseen-composition performance remains strongly tied to the co-occurrence structure of the training data, indicating that much of the observed gain arises from interpolation within densely supported regions of the compositional space rather than from unconstrained recombination. Across datasets, failures consistently concentrate on the larger-vocabulary component, and IMPACT's verb-heavy vocabulary reverses the bottleneck from nouns to verbs. We further show that shared-encoder training introduces component entanglement, encouraging reliance on co-occurrence patterns that transfer poorly to unseen compositions and trailing independent recombination by up to $6.0\times$ in harmonic mean. Taken together, these findings explain why decomposition achieves only partial compositional generalization in practice. By identifying primitive support, vocabulary asymmetry, and component entanglement as connected sources of error, we provide a portable diagnostic framework for studying compositional recognition beyond aggregate accuracy. </details>

Rather than improving the underlying video backbone itself, DramaAgent introduces an upper-level control layer that decomposes generation into story planning, persistent character conditioning, scene-wise synthesis, and reflection-guided targeted repair. Abstract: Model judges now supervise multimodal systems at scale, filtering training data, selecting outputs, and supplying the reward that shapes multimodal reasoning models. Trusting one means first checking that it uses its evidence, and that check is itself worth scrutinizing, so we ask whether a counterfactual probe of visual grounding measures what it claims to. The probe edits the image so the ground truth flips, holds the reasoning trace fixed, and asks whether the verdict follows. We formalize it as the Verdict Grounding Score and show it cannot be read the way such scores are read. A verdict responds only to an edit that reaches the judge's decision-relevant reading, so the score is capped by how perceptible the edit is, and unless editing makes the attribute easier to read, the error is one-sided: the score can only make a judge look less grounded than it is. The practical failure is therefore a false alarm, an auditor discarding a usable overseer. Under assumptions we state, we show this missing quantity is not merely bounded but identified from three quantities the same audit protocol already collects, which makes the false-alarm rate directly measurable rather than merely a concern. Auditing nine judges, we find the predicted ordering holds strictly across our entire primary pool, and the typical judge there acts on only about half of the edits whose attribute it can otherwise resolve. Applying a conservative rejection threshold certifies several cells as false alarms outright, the clearest being a judge that detects the injected error essentially every time while still scoring as if it had not used the image at all. The rule that follows is that an image-side counterfactual score should never be reported alone: a detection probe on the unedited image upper-bounds it, certifies its false alarms, and costs nothing extra to run.

</details>

As a result, the impact of fog severity on ground-to-air UAV detection remains poorly understood. This work presents the first severity-controlled fog benchmark for this task: synthetic fog at ten severity levels is applied to the RGB modality of the Anti-UAV300 dataset, comparing a clear-trained YOLOv5m baseline to a fog-aware model trained on both clear and foggy images. Detection performance drops sharply and non-linearly: degradation is front-loaded across light-to-moderate fog (beta approximately 0.05-0.10), with a 96% reduction in mAP@0.5:0.95 from clear to thickest fog, mainly due to lost recall and confidence. On the comparable metric (mAP@0.5), this collapse exceeds the most extreme rain degradation reported in the closest prior benchmark. Fog-aware training boosts detection across all severities (up to +0.320 mAP@0.5:0.95) with only a 9.1% drop in clear-sky accuracy, raising the threshold for reliable detection while not preventing collapse under extreme fog. Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential for video understanding and caption generation, but their performance may decline in specialized medical imaging domains such as echocardiography. The target is constructed by converting structured video annotations into qualitative attributes, generating a fixed-format reference caption, and mapping it into the language-model embedding space. ### [15] [Query Independent Variable Rate Visual Token Coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00204)

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文将视觉token压缩从"选择保留/丢弃"问题重构为变换编码中的"变速率编码"问题：保留全部token，通过率-失真曲线做整数速率-失真优化分配比特预算，实现与查询无关的一次压缩多次读取。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉token压缩几乎完全被定义为选择问题（按语言模型注意力排序决定保留哪些token），这使压缩表示依赖于所提问题；在单轮基准中不可见，但在跨轮对话缓存或设备-服务器传输等"一次写入、多次读取"场景下是致命的。

Method: 采用变换编码工具的另一半：不丢弃token而是改变每个token的速率。对每个token测得失真-速率曲线，在固定比特预算下通过精确整数速率-失真优化将比特分配到各token。管线中不引入任何文本，因此单一压缩表示可服务任意查询。

Result: 在相同比特预算下，于两个数据集和两种模型容量上，该方法在保持模型输出分布与答案方面优于均匀速率编码、闭式注水法和按失真排序剪枝；在与剪枝方法调优所用问题相同时与注意力排序剪枝持平，而当同一压缩图像需回答同一图像的另一问题时则超越后者。

Conclusion: 保留全部token并优化其速率的变换编码方案，能在同等比特预算下取得更好的保真度，并因与查询无关而在多轮或传输场景中具备显著优势。

Abstract: Visual-token compression for vision--language models is posed almost entirely as a selection problem: decide which tokens to keep and discard the rest. The criteria that work best rank tokens by the attention the language model pays them, which makes the ranking a function of the question being asked. That is invisible in a single-turn benchmark and decisive whenever a compressed representation is written once and read many times, as when it is cached across the turns of a conversation or transmitted between a device and a server. We take the other half of the classical transform-coding toolkit instead: keep every token and vary its rate. A transform code exposes each token's measured distortion--rate curve, and a fixed bit budget is distributed across tokens by exact integer rate--distortion optimisation on those curves. No text enters the pipeline, so one compressed representation serves any query. At equal bit budgets, on two datasets and two capacities, it preserves the model's output distribution and its answers better than uniform-rate coding, the closed-form water-fill and distortion-ranked pruning. It matches attention-ranked pruning on the question pruning was tuned for, and overtakes it once the compressed image must answer a different question about the same image.

</details>

Abstract: The segmentation of anatomical structures in medical images and particularly in MRI scans, is essential for clinical diagnosis and monitoring disease progression. While Deep Learning (DL) architectures, such as U-Net and its extensions are very effective in medical image segmentation tasks, they often struggle with preserving fine-grained details and global contextual information. Specifically, the architecture introduces a module, named Multi-Resolution Feature Fusion (MRFF), that can be easily integrated into any U-Net-like architecture. The MRFF is integrated in all levels of an encode-decoder structure, along with attention mechanisms and skip connections to extract features at multiple resolutions, enabling the model to capture both fine-grained details and global contextual information. We evaluate the MRFFU-Net on two publicly available benchmark MRI datasets of different anatomical targets; one for Cerebrospinal Fluid (CSF) segmentation in spinal MR scans, and one for left atrium cardiac segmentation, from the Medical Segmentation Decathlon (MSD) challenge. Abstract: Automated acne severity grading requires both whole-face context and fine-grained lesion evidence. We propose LENS-GRF (Lesion Evidence Network with Set-Transformer and Gated Residual Fusion), an interpretable multi-stage framework for four-class acne severity grading. The method combines Adaptive Facial Skin Segmentation and a global Vision Transformer prior with a permutation-invariant Lesion Set Transformer that encodes localized lesion patches and spatial geometry. Gated Residual Fusion adaptively controls the local residual contribution and reduces to the global prediction when the gate is zero. On ACNE04, fully automated LENS-GRF with YOLOv11s achieved 80.82% accuracy; with ground-truth lesion annotations, it achieved 95.89% +/- 0.59% accuracy and a Quadratic Weighted Kappa of 0.9753. A data-integrity audit identified 15 cross-split duplicate image pairs, including five with conflicting severity labels. In locked zero-shot evaluation on the full PLSBRACNE01 cohort (200 subjects, 600 views), automated LENS-GRF achieved 35.00% accuracy versus 42.50% for the global baseline. Abstract: Crowdsourced imagery provides timely, fine-grained, street-level observations for disaster mapping, complementing conventional remote sensing imagery (RSI) during emergency response. However, such imagery is often unstructured, spatially ambiguous, and lacks reliable geographic metadata, making manual geolocalization and interpretation labor-intensive and difficult to scale. This work proposes a multi-task Geospatial Reasoning Disaster mapping framework, namely GRDisaster, to examine the potential of vision-language models (VLMs) in understanding, geolocalizing, and reasoning over crowdsourced disaster imagery. GRDisaster is built on a newly curated benchmark dataset derived from PhotoMappers, comprising 26,340 images organized into human-validated volunteered geographic information (VGI), street-view imagery (SVI), RSI cross-view triplets covering multiple disaster events from 2018 to 2024. The framework combines deterministic and probabilistic cross-view geolocalization with multi-view fusion to associate VGI images with georeferenced SVI and RSI. It introduces two sets of spatial reasoning indicators for cross-view geolocalization validation and disaster damage assessment. These indicators use structural, environmental, and global-scene cues to validate cross-view correspondences and visually observable damage evidence with expert-verified annotations to assess disaster severity, improving the interpretability of VLM outputs. To our knowledge, this study provides the first systematic investigation and unified evaluation framework for examining how VLM-based spatial reasoning can transform crowdsourced disaster imagery into actionable geospatial artificial intelligence (GeoAI) through cross-view geolocalization validation, interpretable spatial reasoning, and damage-aware severity assessment.

</details>

Abstract: Historical Manchu documents preserve invaluable linguistic and cultural heritage, yet their digitization is hindered by severe degradations and the scarcity of paired training data. To address this limitation, we propose a retrieval-guided glyph-aware restoration framework that goes beyond pixel reconstruction by explicitly incorporating glyph-level structural knowledge. Extensive experiments on Manchu historical documents demonstrate that the proposed approach improves both image restoration quality and glyph-level fidelity compared with existing restoration methods. These results highlight the importance of incorporating character-aware structural priors for reliable restoration of low-resource historical documents.

### [20] [EgoRefine: Ego-Referenced Predictive Alignment and Trajectory-Conditioned Reliability-Aware Fusion for Asynchronous Collaborative Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00319)
*Lingzhao Kong,Yongsheng Zang,Yu Kang,Kailun Yang,Jie Fu,Yukun Zuo,Zhiyong Li*

Main category: cs.CV

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异步通信下协同特征存在时序延迟。现有基于预测的方法主要依赖发送端自身历史来补偿特征，与自车当前观测仍存在残余错位；后续融合也常忽视对齐质量的空间差异。

Abstract: Collaborative perception enables connected agents to share complementary observations for 3D object detection, extending sensing range and mitigating occlusion. Under asynchronous communication, however, cooperative features arrive with temporal delay. Existing prediction-based methods compensate for these features mainly from the transmitting agent's own history, leaving residual misalignment with the ego agent's current observation; subsequent fusion also often overlooks spatial variations in alignment quality. We propose EgoRefine, an ego-referenced predictive alignment and reliability-aware fusion framework for asynchronous collaborative perception. Its Ego-referenced Predictive Alignment module uses the current ego feature to guide cooperative trajectory-field prediction and refines the sampling offsets along an ego-referenced trajectory direction. Its Trajectory-conditioned Reliability-aware Fusion module treats the trajectory discrepancy between the ego and cooperative streams and the directional refinement magnitude as alignment cues, using them to condition the relation between aligned features and adaptively reweight the two streams before convolutional fusion. Experiments on V2V4Real and DAIR-V2X-Seq show that EgoRefine outperforms TraF-Align by 1.6 and 2.9 points on average in AP@0.5 and AP@0.7, respectively. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/godk0509/EgoRefine.

</details>


### [21] [LEGO-OPD: Factorized Teacher Composition for Multimodal On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00333)
*Jaeyun Shin,Hangeol Chang,Jong Chul Ye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LEGO-OPD 通过将语言专家与视觉定位专家的预测因子化组合为一个教师分布，实现多模态 on-policy distillation 中语言推理与视觉定位的独立可控，并自适应校准视觉似然的更新强度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态 on-policy distillation 需在提升视觉定位能力的同时保留语言模型的推理能力。现有多教师方法结合 LLM 与 VLM 教师以提供互补监督，但直接使用 VLM 的完整预测分布会将其视觉定位信号与自身语言先验纠缠在一起，导致定位信息无法被独立迁移；而单纯增强视觉监督虽可改善感知，却可能过度强调视觉证据并损害语言推理，形成难以权衡的矛盾。

Result: 基于 Qwen3 模型的实验表明，LEGO-OPD 在多模态与纯文本推理任务上均持续优于所评估的单教师与多教师 OPD 基线；同时提升了初始学生的视觉感知能力，并保持了纯文本推理性能。

Conclusion: 通过因子化组合语言先验与视觉似然并自适应校准其更新强度，LEGO-OPD 有效缓解了多模态 OPD 中视觉定位与语言推理之间的权衡问题，实现了定位与推理的独立可控与协同提升。

Abstract: Multimodal on-policy distillation (OPD) aims to improve visual grounding while preserving the strong reasoning capabilities of language models. Recent multi-teacher approaches combine LLM and VLM teachers to provide complementary supervision. However, directly using a VLM's full predictive distribution entangles its visual grounding signal with its own language prior, preventing the grounding information from being transferred independently. Conversely, increasing the strength of visual supervision can improve perception but may overemphasize visual evidence and degrade language reasoning. To address this trade-off, we introduce LEGO-OPD, which selectively composes factors from a Language Expert and a Grounding expert into One teacher distribution for multimodal OPD. Under a generalized Bayesian formulation, the language expert provides a prior over candidate tokens, while the grounding expert contributes a visual likelihood that updates this prior, rather than transferring its complete predictive distribution. This factorized composition allows language reasoning and visual grounding to be controlled independently. We further introduce adaptive calibration to determine how strongly the visual likelihood should update the language prior at each decoding prefix. Specifically, LEGO-OPD uses the grounding expert's image-induced prediction shift as a prefix-dependent reference, preventing both insufficient and excessive visual supervision. Experiments with Qwen3 models show that LEGO-OPD consistently outperforms the evaluated single- and multi-teacher OPD baselines on both multimodal and text-only reasoning tasks. Moreover, it improves the initial student's visual perception while preserving text-only reasoning.

</details>


### [22] [Vmem-$\varphi$: Low-Compute Out-of-Distribution Detection in Spiking Neural Networks from Membrane-Potential Statistics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00350)
*Arul Rana,Agrim Tripathi,Shoaib Ahmed Dipu,Md. Shaown Miah,Syed Ishtiaque Ahmed,Sayeed Shafayet Chowdhury*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出利用脉冲神经网络内部亚阈值膜电位统计量进行事件相机数据的分布外检测，并发布Gen1-C损坏基准，提出MDD方法，在多数损坏类型上取得AUROC>0.88。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件相机数据在SNN上处理具有能效优势，但该场景下的分布外（OOD）检测仍具挑战。现有OOD检测方法依赖模型输出或计算组件，而在目标检测SNN中这些组件不可用，且不适合低算力部署。因此需要一种不依赖外部输出、低成本且适配SNN内部特性的OOD信号。

Method: 作者提出以亚阈值膜电位V_mem(t)作为内部信号，基于膜动态计算简单的逐通道统计量用于OOD检测。为评估该思路，构建了Gen1-C事件相机损坏基准，基于Prophesee Gen1汽车检测数据集，包含六种面向传感器的直方图级压力测试，每种分五个严重程度。进一步提出多描述符偏差（MDD）方法，该方法对损坏类型不可知（corruption-blind），仅作用于膜电位统计量。

Conclusion: 时间膜电位动态可为基于SNN的事件感知提供有效且低成本的OOD检测信号。

Abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer an energy-efficient approach to processing event-camera data, yet out-of-distribution (OOD) detection remains challenging in this setting. Existing OOD detection methods often depend on model outputs or computational components that are unavailable in object detection SNNs or are poorly suited to low-compute deployment. To that effect, we show that the subthreshold membrane potential \(V_{\mathrm{mem}}(t)\) provides a useful internal signal for detecting distribution shifts. Simple per-channel statistics derived from these membrane dynamics enable OOD detection. To evaluate this approach, we introduce Gen1-C, an event-camera corruption benchmark developed upon the Prophesee Gen1 automotive detection dataset, containing six sensor-motivated histogram-level stress tests at five severity levels. We further propose the Multi-Descriptor Deviation (MDD), a corruption-blind method that operates on membrane-potential statistics. At the highest corruption severity, MDD achieves an AUROC of more than 0.88 on five of the six corruptions using only a bounded 64-frame observation window. Notably, the remaining corruption is also the one that has the smallest effect on the underlying detector. These results show that the temporal membrane-potential dynamics can provide an effective and low-cost signal for OOD detection in SNN-based event perception.

</details>


### [23] [From Image Latent Space to Fuzzy Rules: Interpretable Analysis of Gastrointestinal Foundation Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00414)
*Michael D. Vasilakakis,Dimitris K. Iakovidis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出一种基于原型的模糊规则框架，无需微调即可解释预训练基础模型中间层提取的patch级特征：先在特征空间聚类得到类特定原型，再将patch特征表示为原型相似度，用可读的IF-THEN模糊规则分类。在三个医学影像任务上，该方法在不微调骨干网络的情况下达到与k-NN、核SVM和线性探测相当的精度，并可借助规则对合成医学图像进行人类可读的差异定位分析。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型在医学影像任务上迁移性强，但其潜在表示如何编码临床相关信息仍不明确，这在安全攸关领域是未解难题。已有工作多依赖微调或黑盒分类器，缺乏对冻结特征中临床结构的透明、层次化解读。

Method: 提出基于原型的模糊规则框架，解释预训练基础模型内层输出的patch级特征，且不做任何微调。方法在特征空间聚类学习类特定原型，得到紧凑视觉模式；将patch特征表示为与原型的相似度，再由带语言化IF-THEN条件的模糊规则分类。在ImageNet-1K与GastroNet-5M预训练的ViT-S/16最后两个block上，与k近邻、核SVM、线性探测在相同冻结特征下对比，任务包括无线胶囊内镜分类、胃肠内镜分类和结肠息肉分割。

Result: 实验表明，该方法在不微调骨干网络的情况下，精度与上述黑盒分类器相当；领域特定预训练所得特征既具判别性又可符号化压缩。由于规则源自真实数据并以可解释术语表达，还被用作分析合成医学图像的工具，可人类可读地说明生成器复现或未能复现哪些真实原型与规则，定位合成图像偏离真实组织之处，而非仅给出单一评分。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了关于基础模型如何组织临床相关结构的透明、深度分辨的视角，并给出了提取规则的一种实用下游应用。

Abstract: Foundation models pretrained on large-scale datasets demonstrate strong transferability to medical imaging tasks. However, understanding how their latent representations encode clinically relevant information remains an open challenge in safety-critical domains. This study proposes a prototype-based fuzzy-rule framework that interprets the patch-level features produced by the inner layers of pretrained foundation models, without any fine-tuning. Class-specific prototypes are learned by clustering in the feature space, yielding compact visual patterns. Patch features are then expressed as prototype similarities and classified by fuzzy rules with linguistic IF-THEN conditions that are human readable. The framework is applied across the final two blocks of ViT-S/16 backbones pretrained on ImageNet-1K and GastroNet-5M, and benchmarked against k-nearest neighbours, kernel SVM, and linear probing under identical frozen features, on wireless capsule endoscopy classification, gastrointestinal endoscopy classification, and colonic polyp segmentation. The experimental analysis shows that the proposed method, without backbone fine-tuning, reaches accuracy comparable to these black-box classifiers, and that domain-specific pretraining yields features that are both discriminative and symbolically compressible. Because the resulting rules are extracted from real data and expressed in interpretable terms, they are further used as an instrument to investigate synthetic medical images, providing a human-readable account of which real prototypes and rules a generator reproduces or fails to reproduce, localising where a synthetic image departs from real tissue rather than summarising it with a single score. The framework thus offers a transparent, depth-resolved view of how foundation models organise clinically relevant structure, together with a practical downstream use of the extracted rules.

</details>

*Bhanu Prakash Vangala,Sowmya Guda,Latha Peddi,Navya Vangala*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 脑肿瘤MRI自动分类在公开基准上准确率普遍超过98%，但准确率无法反映基准质量的一个关键维度——数据集完整性，即测试数据在图像、患者和采集来源层面上与训练数据的独立性。作者希望揭示该文献体系所依赖的公开语料是否存在系统性污染。

Method: 作者定义一个三层污染框架：重复泄漏、患者泄漏和来源标签泄漏。他们审计三个最广泛使用的语料库，并引入胸部X线作为阴性对照，在九种架构和三种评估条件下量化每一层泄漏对测得性能的影响，同时进行去重后的性能对比。

Result: 每一层污染都很严重：主导语料官方测试集中28.8%的样本在训练集中存在近重复；第二个语料22.3%的测试图像字节级完全相同；95.5%可追溯的测试图像与训练集共享患者；不含任何解剖信息的文件头特征即可在肿瘤与无肿瘤之间达到0.959的平衡准确率，与微调ResNet主干相当。关键意外结果是，移除所有已识别的泄漏测试图像后，平衡准确率基本不变。

Conclusion: 数据集完整性是基准质量的一个独立且可度量的维度，稳定的排行榜无法证明基准的完整性。对于生物医学研究而言，仅凭这些语料上的报告准确率不能说明模型学会了识别肿瘤，而非利用数据集特有的线索。作者公开了污染文件清单、恢复的患者标识符和去重后的划分。

Abstract: Automated classification of brain tumors from MRI is a heavily published application of deep learning in medical imaging, with reported accuracies on public benchmarks routinely exceeding 98%. However, accuracy does not capture a critical dimension of benchmark quality: dataset integrity, defined as the independence of test from training data at the image, patient, and acquisition-source levels. We introduce a three-layer contamination framework comprising duplicate, patient, and source-label leakage to assess the public corpora on which this literature rests. We audit the three most widely used corpora against a chest-radiograph negative control and quantify each layer's effect on measured performance across nine architectures and three evaluation conditions. Contamination is severe at every layer: 28.8% of the dominant corpus's official test split has a near-twin in its own training split, a second corpus leaks 22.3% of its test images byte-identically, 95.5% of traceable test images share a patient with training, and file-header features containing no anatomy separate tumor from no-tumor at 0.959 balanced accuracy, at parity with fine-tuned ResNet backbones. The unexpected result is that removing every identified leaked test image leaves balanced accuracy essentially unchanged: stable performance after deduplication does not establish benchmark integrity. Our findings establish dataset integrity as a distinct, measurable axis of benchmark quality that a stable leaderboard cannot certify. For biomedical research, reported accuracy on these corpora alone does not establish that a model has learned to recognize tumors rather than exploit dataset-specific cues. We release the contaminated-file lists, recovered patient identifiers, and deduplicated splits.

</details>


### [25] [PACT: End-to-End Learning of Human Pose, Contacts, and Forces from Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00451)
*Rikhat Akizhanov,Yangsong Zhang,Nikolai Kaliazin,Peter Wolf,Yoshihiko Nakamura,Pascal Fua,Fabio Pizzati,Ivan Laptev*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PACT：端到端联合估计单目视频中人体姿态、接触与接触力的模型，借助力token与时序Transformer，并用物理监督与数据标注流水线解决力标注稀缺，另提出ForceWall攀岩力基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人体运动、环境接触与交互力受共同物理规律支配，但现有方法通常将视觉姿态重建与接触/力估计分离。这种分阶段处理限制了联合推理，并会在各阶段间传播误差。

Method: 以人体重建基础模型为骨架，引入可学习的接触力token（contact-force tokens）与融合视觉特征及世界坐标运动（world-space motion）的时序Transformer；通过联合预测头精化人体姿态并估计接触与力，同时以物理监督约束重建运动与交互力的一致性。针对力标注稀缺，构建结合接触标注与物理驱动的运动/力优化的数据标注流水线，从合成与真实视频生成训练监督。

Result: 在接触与力估计上达到当前最优（SOTA），优于分阶段重建方法，并能泛化到训练分布之外的交互。同时提出真实场景攀岩基准ForceWall，包含攀岩视频与来自力传感器的真值接触力。

Conclusion: 结果表明，端到端联合学习是从视频中恢复人体运动与物理交互的有效途径。

Abstract: Human motion, environmental contacts, and interaction forces are governed by common physical laws, yet existing approaches typically separate visual pose reconstruction from contact and force estimation. This separation limits joint reasoning and can propagate errors between stages. We introduce PACT, an end-to-end model that jointly learns to estimate human pose, contacts and contact forces from monocular video. Our approach augments a human reconstruction foundation model with learnable contact-force tokens and a temporal transformer that integrates visual features with world-space motion. Joint prediction heads refine human poses and estimate contacts and forces, while physics-based supervision encourages consistency between the reconstructed motion and interaction forces. To address the scarcity of force annotations, we develop a data annotation pipeline that combines contact labeling with physics-based motion and force optimization, producing training supervision from synthetic and real-world videos. We also introduce a real-world climbing benchmark ForceWall with climbing videos and corresponding ground-truth contact forces obtained from the force sensors. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art contact and force estimation, outperforming staged reconstruction approaches and generalizing to interactions beyond the training distribution. These results support end-to-end joint learning as an effective approach to recovering human motion and physical interactions from video.

</details>


### [26] [PixelDense: Dense Prediction as Representation Alignment for Pixel Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00483)
*Lehan Yang,Daiqing Qi,Wenhao Zhang,Avery Li,Yiqing Yang,Yifan Li,Yu Kong,Haitian Zheng,Zhifei Zhang,Zhe Lin,Varun Jampani,Sheng Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PixelDense，将语义与几何密集预测教师分路对齐并施加权重空间正交惩罚，显著提升像素空间扩散模型生成与编辑性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有REPA方法的对齐目标几乎只用DINOv2、CLIP等语义编码器，但分析表明对齐效果来源于空间结构而非全局语义，而专门预测该结构的密集预测基础模型被忽视；同时多教师简单相加会因语义与几何梯度竞争而劣于最佳单一几何教师。

Conclusion: 密集预测基础模型作为对齐目标有效，且按语义/几何分路并正交解耦的多教师对齐优于简单求和。

Abstract: Representation alignment (REPA) accelerates diffusion transformer training, but its alignment targets are almost exclusively semantic encoders such as DINOv2 and CLIP. Recent analysis points to spatial structure, not global semantics, as the carrier of the alignment effect, yet dense-prediction foundation models trained to predict that structure remain overlooked as REPA targets. In pixel-space diffusion, SAM2, Depth Anything v2, and Metric3D v2 each outperform the DINOv2-only GenEval baseline, with the two geometric teachers leading the segmentation teacher. A flat sum of all four teachers, however, lands below the best single geometric teacher, as semantic and geometric gradients compete for one denoiser projection. We introduce PixelDense, which routes DINOv2 and SAM2 through a semantic projection stream, routes Depth Anything v2 and Metric3D v2 through a geometric projection stream, and adds a weight-space orthogonality penalty that keeps the two streams in disjoint subspaces. All four teachers are frozen during training and dropped at inference. Applied to PixelGen and DeCo with a single recipe, PixelDense improves GenEval, DPG-Bench, and HPS v2.1, raises PixelGen-XXL's GenEval Overall from 0.7927 to 0.8093, and beats every single-teacher and unfactored multi-teacher variant. In partial-noise reconstruction, independent panoptic, depth, and surface-normal probes show up to 53.1% PQ gain and 36.0% depth AbsRel reduction at $τ=0.5$ across COCO and Flickr30K. From random initialization, PixelDense also reaches the baseline's peak GenEval 1.23x faster. In SDEdit editing on PIE-Bench, PixelDense keeps more of the source background and layout at every edit strength, raising background PSNR by up to 2.2 dB.

</details>


### [27] [Memorizon: Training World Models Beyond Their Context Window](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00544)
*Tingting Liao,Xuezhi Liang,Hao Li,Guangyi Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Memorizon 解耦了世界模型中长跨度监督与注意力代价，通过相机共视检索构建有界共享 latent bank，使长跨度重访监督只需一次适中开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式世界模型需在重复到访同一地点时保持渲染一致，但直接监督需同时包含两次访问的长跨度样本；对整段做稠密注意力的代价是二次的，长跨度监督因此昂贵。

Method: 训练样本跨度任意长，但只对最后 k 个 chunk 计分；被计分 chunk 不 tokenize 其前历史，而是按相机共视各自检索 top-K latent，其并集构成共享 bank。bank 规模上限为 kK，故序列长度有界；最短跨度时等价于常规训练。

Result: 相比滑窗基线，检索在所有 split 上提升重访一致性；跨度长到足以覆盖每次返回的首次访问时再提升 24%–30%，但图像质量略有下降，超过该跨度后继续加长无益。用另一 episode 填充 bank 使重访相关性下降 83%。成本上，加入 bank 仅使单步开销增加一次，跨度从 100 s 增至 400 s 仅增加 12% 步时。

Conclusion: 长跨度只对监督必要、对注意力并非必要；有界检索式共享 bank 可在近似常数代价下实现长跨度重访监督，且模型确实依赖检索到的内容，超出首次访问覆盖范围的长度收益饱和。

Abstract: Streaming world models should render a place consistently across repeated visits. Directly supervising such revisits requires training samples that capture both visits, often spanning minutes. Yet dense attention over the full span incurs quadratic costs, making long-span supervision expensive. Memorizon breaks this coupling: long spans are needed for supervision, but not for attention, since the two visits can share a forward pass without including every intervening frame. A training sample covers a span of any length but is scored only on its last $k$ chunks. Instead of tokenizing the history before them, each scored chunk retrieves its own top-$K$ latents by camera co-visibility, and the union of these requests forms a shared bank. The bank is bounded by $kK$, so the sequence stays bounded however long the span; at the shortest span the recipe is exactly conventional training. Adding the bank raises the cost of a step once; beyond that, a longer span costs little, and going from 100 to 400 s adds 12% to the step time. Against a sliding-window baseline, retrieval raises revisit consistency on every split, and a span long enough to reach the first visit of each return adds a further 24% to 30%, at some cost in image quality; beyond that span, more length no longer helps. Filling the bank from another episode lowers revisit correlation by 83%, so the model uses what it retrieves. Project page: https://tingtingliao.github.io/memorizon

</details>


### [28] [PhysVista: Benchmarking Physical Intelligence in VLMs via a Perception-Reasoning-Assessment Loop](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00559)
*Xinge Peng,Yiting Lu,Tianwu Zhi,Wen Wen,Jianzhao Liu,Xin Li,Zhibo Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PhysVista基准，以"感知-推理-评估"闭环框架评估视觉语言模型的物理智能，涵盖物理状态感知、动态推理与合理性判断，并区分事件级与尺度级推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准评估碎片化，仅关注孤立认知阶段，忽视感知、推理与物理判断之间的协同，缺乏整体视角，难以诊断VLM能否可靠评估生成模型的物理真实性。

Method: 受人类"看-推理-判断"过程启发，构建闭环认知框架的PhysVista基准：联合评估物理状态感知、物理动态推理与物理合理性评估；区分事件级与尺度级推理以支持细粒度分析；同时纳入真实世界视频与AI生成视频。

Result: 在多种VLM上的大量实验显示，模型在物理推理与合理性评估方面存在明显不足，暴露出视觉识别与真正物理理解之间的持续鸿沟。

Conclusion: PhysVista揭示了当前VLM物理理解的局限，为构建更具物理基础的多模态智能提供了原则性设计方向。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong multimodal reasoning capabilities, yet whether they truly capture the physical consistency underlying real-world dynamics remains unclear. Existing benchmark paradigms often suffer from fragmented evaluation, focusing on isolated cognitive stages while overlooking the inherent synergy between perception, reasoning, and physical judgment. The lack of a holistic perspective limits the ability to diagnose whether VLMs can reliably evaluate the physical authenticity of emerging generative models. To address these issues, we introduce PhysVista, a benchmark designed to evaluate physical intelligence in VLMs through a closed cognitive loop framework inspired by the human seeing-reasoning-assessment process. PhysVista restores this loop by jointly evaluating physical state perception, physical dynamics reasoning, and physical plausibility assessment. It further distinguishes event-level reasoning and scale-level reasoning to enable fine-grained analysis of physical understanding. In addition, PhysVista incorporates both real-world and AI-generated videos, allowing evaluation across diverse domains and emerging generative scenarios. Extensive experiments across a diverse set of VLMs reveal substantial limitations in physical reasoning and plausibility assessment, highlighting a persistent gap between visual recognition and genuine physical understanding, and pointing toward more principled designs for physically grounded multimodal intelligence.

</details>


### [29] [FORTE: Adaptive Scoring and Exact Keyframe Selection for Long-Video Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00573)
*Haifeng Huang,Biyin Xu,Chunsheng Xin,Yang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出免训练的 FORTE 框架，通过自适应相关性评分与全局关键帧优化两个阶段，在有限评分预算下为长视频问答选择查询相关关键帧，在四个基准上取得最高平均准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于评分的关键帧选择方法在固定、均匀采样的候选池内搜索，导致池外证据无法被选中。在评分预算有限时，核心挑战是自适应地将评估分配给有前景的帧，同时持续探索代表性不足的时间区域。

Method: FORTE 分两阶段：(1) 自适应相关性评分：从稀疏均匀观测出发，利用高斯过程相关性预测器估计未评分帧的相关性，借助时间局部性与近似带状核结构将核心计算由立方复杂度降为线性复杂度；评分阶段以预测相关性与时间覆盖度的平衡决定下一批评分帧，兼顾前景区域与欠代表区域。(2) 全局关键帧优化：最大化同时刻画实测相关性与时间覆盖度的目标函数，利用对数覆盖结构推导精确算法，在固定最终帧预算下以与候选池规模成线性的时间找到最优子集。

Result: 在四个长视频问答基准上，FORTE 在所有测试评分预算下均取得对比选择器中最高的观测平均准确率；进一步实验表明其在不同相关性评分器与下游 MLLM 上均保持稳定有效性。

Conclusion: FORTE 以免训练方式解决了固定候选池限制与预算分配难题，通过自适应评分与精确全局优化实现高效长视频关键帧选择，具备跨评分器和跨 MLLM 的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Query-aware keyframe selection enables multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to process long videos using only a small set of question-relevant frames. Existing score-based methods, however, typically search within a fixed, uniformly sampled candidate pool, preventing evidence outside this pool from ever being selected. Given a limited relevance-scoring budget, the key challenge is to allocate evaluations adaptively to promising frames while continuing to explore underrepresented temporal regions. We introduce FORTE, a training-free framework that addresses this challenge through two stages: adaptive relevance scoring and global keyframe optimization. Starting from sparse, uniformly distributed observations, our efficient Gaussian-process relevance predictor estimates relevance for unscored frames, exploiting temporal locality and the approximately banded kernel structure to reduce the core computation from cubic to linear time in the number of frames for fixed bandwidth. The scoring stage then selects which frames to score next by balancing predicted relevance with temporal coverage, prioritizing promising regions while also exploring less-represented parts of the video. The optimization stage selects the final keyframes by maximizing an objective that jointly captures measured relevance and temporal coverage. We derive an exact algorithm that leverages the logarithmic coverage structure to identify the optimal subset of the scored candidate pool in time linear in the pool size, for a fixed final-frame budget. Experiments on four long-video question-answering benchmarks show that FORTE achieves the highest observed mean accuracy among the compared selectors under every tested scoring budget. Further evaluations demonstrate its consistent effectiveness across different relevance scorers and downstream MLLMs.

</details>


### [30] [Gestalt: Large Multimodal Interplay Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00576)
*Zequn Yang,Yu Miao,Haotian Ni,Ziheng Chen,Chengxiang Huang,Dongzhan Zhou,Kai Chen,Qi Zhang,Ji-Rong Wen,Yake Wei,Di Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Gestalt，一种以多模态交互为核心的大型多模态模型新范式，通过"多模态交互金字塔"组织建模流程，在图像生成、多模态理解与纯文本评测上均取得强劲表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态模型主要致力于容纳更多模态，却忽视了各模态的独特特性及其相互关系，导致发展遭遇瓶颈。受人类多感官感知多阶段特性的启发，作者希望以新的建模范式突破这一局限。

Method: 提出多模态交互金字塔，将建模组织为从模态特定处理、跨模态对齐到更深层多模态整合的递进过程。据此，Gestalt 采用统一的离散扩散框架与交互分区架构，以可学习的交互 token 作为跨模态交换与整合的中介；该金字塔同时指导数据组织与训练策略。

Result: 在图像生成、多模态理解以及纯文本评测中均取得强劲性能，显著提升跨模态整合能力，同时保留模态特定信息。

Conclusion: Gestalt 有效发挥了基于扩散的多模态模型的优势，为迈向统一多模态智能提供了一条有前景的路径。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose Gestalt, a new paradigm of large multimodal model built around multimodal interplay. Abstract: Qualitative comparison figures are central evidence in computer vision papers, and vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used to judge them. Yet existing benchmarks score only scalar quality or overall preference, so a judge can be rewarded for picking the preferred image for the wrong visual reason. We introduce VisionQ, the first benchmark built from peer-reviewed CV comparison figures that grounds every judgment in a named visual criterion: each question states the criterion, and a judge is credited only when it selects the output the authors identify as best on that criterion. Beyond methodological advances, we review commonly used datasets, benchmarks, and evaluation practices, and discuss open challenges such as scalable reward design, long-horizon temporal consistency, stability-expressiveness trade-offs, and safety-aware generation. *Thiru Thillai Nadarasar Bahavan,Yu Xia,Sachith Seneviratne,Saman Halgamuge*

TL;DR: 提出即插即用的 SmoothOperator (SmoothOP)，依据样本的 "prominence" 自适应设定标签平滑系数，改进开放集识别中的球面表示学习，在 Semantic Shift Benchmark 上最高提升 4.7%。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放集识别 (OSR) 的核心难点在于训练时无法对未知类的无界分布建模，容易将未知类样本误分类。现有做法转向塑造特征空间，使已知类紧凑且彼此分离，球面表示学习因而取得较好效果。标签平滑被认为是这一成功的关键因素之一，但它对所有训练样本使用相同系数，忽略了各样本本身嵌入质量的高低，缺乏样本自适应性。

Abstract: Open Set Recognition (OSR) aims to enable models to accurately classify known classes while rejecting samples from unseen classes. A key challenge in OSR lies in the inability to model the unbounded distribution of unknown classes during training, often leading to the misclassification of samples from these classes. Rather than modeling unknowns, recent work shapes the feature space so that known classes are compact and well separated, and spherical representation learning methods have achieved strong results this way. Label smoothing has been identified as one of the key drivers of this success, yet it applies the same coefficient to every training sample, regardless of how well each sample is already embedded. We show that the spherical representation learning objectives used in OSR share a single alignment--uniformity structure in which labels enter only through the alignment term. Label smoothing therefore acts as an alignment dial, and a fixed coefficient sets this dial to the same value for every sample. We propose a plug-in, SmoothOperator (SmoothOP), which sets the smoothing coefficient of each sample from its \textbf{prominence}, an embedding-space signal measuring how clearly the sample's own class stands out against its strongest competing class. Our method integrates into four existing spherical representation learning methods at minimal training overhead. SmoothOP assigns strong smoothing to samples with high prominence, which reduces their alignment and relaxes their pull. On the Semantic Shift Benchmark, SmoothOP-augmented variants generally outperform their base objectives across datasets, degrees of semantic shift, and OSR post-processors, with gains of up to 4.7\% in AUROC, OSCR, and closed-set accuracy.

</details>

Conclusion: 点变换器可有效支撑户外3D LiDAR的标注无关开放词汇分割，直接修正2D-to-3D投影误差是关键，该方法兼具高精度与实时性。

Abstract: Accurate 3D semantic perception is critical for safe autonomous navigation. However, supervised LiDAR segmentation remains tied to closed taxonomies and to the cost of point-wise manual annotation. Open-vocabulary methods avoid that cost by projecting the output of 2D vision-language models onto LiDAR and distilling it into a 3D network. These methods rely almost exclusively on voxel-based sparse convolutions, and point transformers have so far been limited to indoor environments, where 3D data is dense and bounded. We present Lang3DSeg, which establishes a point transformer as the backbone for annotation-free open-vocabulary segmentation of outdoor 3D LiDAR, and is trained from scratch without geometric pre-training. This training paradigm necessitates addressing the inherent noise in 2D-to-3D label projections; specifically, naive projection often suffers from depth ambiguity, where points behind an object are erroneously assigned its semantic label. We therefore composite masks using an explicit class-priority rule and truncate each projected instance at the first gap in its depth distribution, correcting the projection error directly rather than averaging it over registered sequences. Lang3DSeg achieves 52.8% mIoU on nuScenes validation and 41.4% on SemanticKITTI, the highest among published annotation-free methods on both benchmarks. Every 3D semantic segmentation is on a single LiDAR sweep, and inference operates in real-time without running vision-language models.

</details>

*Chensheng Peng,Wenhao Ding,Ran Tian,Zewei Zhou,Jef Packer,Maximilian Igl,Peter Karkus,Yan Wang,Masayoshi Tomizuka,Boris Ivanovic,Marco Pavone,Yuxiao Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准 WAM 训练同时对动作与视频加噪，导致失配：扰动后的动作对应反事实的视觉未来，而加噪视频仍绑定于真实录制的未来；且在低噪声区间，噪声帧中场景几何与动态行为依然清晰可见，使模型难以建立动作与视觉后果的正确关联。

Result: 驾驶实验中动作预测更准确，生成视频与动作的一致性更高，对给定指令的跟随更好；机器人实验中运动保真度与可控性更强。匹配对照实验支持离路径（off-path）渲染对指令跟随与操作保真度的增益。

Conclusion: 通过将扰动动作与其在模拟器中的真实视觉后果配对，并辅以扭曲噪声调度和多智能体动作接口，可显著提升 WAM 的可控性、动作—视觉一致性与指令跟随能力，推动更可控的世界动作模型发展。

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) jointly predict actions (intent) and visual future (foresight). Standard training adds noise to recorded actions and video simultaneously, but such training paradigms introduce a mismatch: perturbed actions imply counterfactual future visual, while the noised video remains tied to the GT recording. In low-noise regime, the scene geometry and even the dynamic behavior remain clearly visible from the noisy future frames despite the added noise. We present CtrlWAM, which executes perturbed actions in a simulator and pairs them with their noised visual consequences for joint WAM learning. To accommodate the different denoising requirements of video and actions, we introduce warped video--action noise schedules that aim to keep visual layout responsive as action predictions evolve. We further extend the action interface from ego-only control to a variable number of agent streams, allowing a unified model to represent predicted or commanded futures for multiple agents. Driving experiments show more accurate action forecasts, closer agreement between generated video and actions, and better following of supplied commands; robotics experiments show stronger motion fidelity and controllability. Matched controls support the benefit of off-path renders for command following and manipulation fidelity. Together, these findings contribute to a more controllable world action model. Motivation: 手语机器翻译虽从孤立手语识别发展至端到端系统，但仍面临数据集规模不足、评测指标难以衡量语言质量、以及手语三维多层并行结构建模困难等问题，需在技术挑战与利益相关者考量间取得平衡。

Conclusion: 手语机器翻译的持续进步依赖跨学科长期协作，尤其是与聋人社区的深度合作，技术推进需与伦理规范和社区治理同步。

Abstract: Sign language machine translation has progressed substantially over the past decade, evolving from isolated sign recognition to end-to-end translation systems. Advances in pose estimation, transformer architectures, and large-scale dataset collection have driven progress, yet challenges remain. Datasets are limited compared to spoken-language resources; evaluation metrics inadequately capture the linguistic quality of output; and models must capture the simultaneous, multi-layered, and three-dimensional structure of sign languages. This manuscript provides a comprehensive review that seeks to balance technical challenges with stakeholder considerations. We examine the linguistic properties that make sign languages computationally unique, trace the evolution of recognition, translation, and production systems, and analyze ongoing technical challenges. Crucially, we address ethical considerations around data governance, community involvement, and appropriate use. Drawing on interdisciplinary perspectives spanning computer vision, sign language linguistics, and deaf studies, our analysis emphasizes that continued progress requires sustained collaboration across these fields and with deaf communities.

### [51] [EyeTAG: Eye Trajectory-Aware Gaze Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00922)
*Jungmin Lee,Niamat Ullah,Yoseob Han*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出EyeTAG：一种因果多帧视线估计框架，将视线轨迹建模为显式一阶差分先验，以运动学token反馈，降低抖动与扫视偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然头眼运动下的视线估计对驾驶监控、人机交互至关重要。单帧方法逐帧独立预测，输出存在抖动；多帧方法虽缓解抖动，但隐式地在外观特征中学习运动，导致视线轨迹从未成为显式变量。

Method: EyeTAG为因果多帧框架，核心是显式一阶视线先验：每一步对自身近期预测做差分，将所得轨迹作为紧凑的运动学token反馈。由于差分在视线空间具有平移不变性，该token携带主体无关的运动信息而非个人视线偏移。人脸与人眼两路流提供视觉证据，经交叉注意力融合并由因果Transformer解码器处理。

Result: 在Gaze360上平均角度误差约降低1.0°；在EVE上与最强基线相当（2.56° vs. 2.58°）。模型内消融（固定编码器与其余架构，仅改变视线历史）表明，是差分形式而非单纯时序上下文消除了即使使用绝对视线历史先验仍存在的系统性扫视偏差。

Conclusion: 将视线运动显式建模为平移不变的差分轨迹token，能有效去除抖动与扫视偏差，优于仅依赖绝对视线历史或隐式运动学习的方案。代码已开源。

Abstract: Gaze estimation under natural head-eye motion underpins applications from driver monitoring to human-computer interaction. Single-frame methods predict each frame independently, so consecutive outputs fluctuate as jitter. Multi-frame methods reduce this, but they learn motion implicitly inside appearance features, so the gaze trajectory is never an explicit variable. We propose EyeTAG (Eye Trajectory-Aware Gaze Estimation), a causal multi-frame framework built around an explicit first-order gaze prior: at each step it differentiates its own recent predictions and feeds the resulting trajectory back as a compact kinematic token. Because differencing is translation-invariant in gaze space, this token carries subject-invariant motion rather than personal gaze offsets. Face and eye streams supply visual evidence, fused by cross-attention and a causal Transformer decoder. EyeTAG reduces the mean angular error by about 1.0$^\circ$ on Gaze360 and performs on par with the strongest baseline on EVE (2.56$^\circ$ vs. 2.58$^\circ$). Within-model ablations, which keep the encoder and the rest of the architecture fixed and vary only the gaze history, show that the differential formulation, rather than temporal context alone, removes the systematic saccade bias that persists even with an absolute gaze-history prior. Our code is available at https://github.com/peter8366/EyeTAG.

</details>


### [52] [Joint Branch-Space Transform Coding for Diffusion Activation Quantization with Classifier-Free Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00930)
*Mingrun Jiang,Yuejia Liu,Zishan Shao,Ting Jiang,Qinsi Wang,Hancheng Ye,Yixiao Wang,Rui-Feng Wang,Kangning Cui,Yixuan Chen,Fan Yang,Xiang Cheng,Hai Li,Yiran Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文将CFG结构引入扩散模型后训练量化，提出分支空间变换编码，并推导出闭式解GCBT，在等码率下显著提升量化保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散模型后训练量化已利用时间步、特征与层结构，近期工作也开始纳入CFG结构，但激活量化仍在条件与无条件坐标上独立进行，跨激活结构未被利用。作者发现匹配的CFG激活构成强相关的二维源，且在固定比特预算下分支编码基的选择会实质影响量化保真度。

Method: 提出分支空间变换编码：通过离线导出的2x2正交矩阵旋转匹配的CFG分支，对模型参数和量化流程改动极小。进一步推导引导-相关分支变换（GCBT），联合考虑CFG引导方向与跨分支二阶矩；在等码率量化噪声代理下，GCBT具有逐层闭式解，无需梯度优化或角度搜索。

Result: 将GCBT叠加于现有扩散PTQ方法之上，在多数评估对比中取得统计显著的保真度提升，且无统计显著退化，同时不改变底层宿主量化流程。

Conclusion: 匹配CFG激活存在可利用的跨分支相关性，通过分支空间的正交变换编码可有效提升扩散模型量化保真度；GCBT提供了无需优化的闭式方案，可作为通用插件兼容现有PTQ流程。

Abstract: Post-training quantization for diffusion models increasingly exploits timestep, feature, and layer structure. While recent work has begun incorporating CFG structure into diffusion quantization, activation quantization still operates independently across conditional and unconditional coordinates, leaving cross-activation structure unexploited. We show that matched CFG activations form a strongly correlated two-dimensional source and that, under a fixed bit budget, the choice of branch coding basis materially affects quantization fidelity. Motivated by this observation, we introduce branch-space transform coding, which rotates matched CFG branches via an offline derived 2x2 orthogonal matrix, requiring minimal modifications to model parameters or the quantization pipeline. We further derive the Guidance-Correlation Branch Transform (GCBT), which jointly incorporates the CFG guidance direction and cross-branch second moments. Under an equal-rate quantization-noise surrogate, GCBT admits a closed-form per-layer solution without gradient optimization or angle search. Applied on top of existing diffusion PTQ methods, GCBT yields statistically significant fidelity gains in most evaluated comparisons with no statistically significant degradation, while leaving the underlying host quantization pipeline unchanged.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重标注图文语料已成为T2I训练标配，VLM密集描述替代稀疏alt-text，但此类语料实为标注策略π、标注器V_c与源语料C共同诱导的监督分布。现有基于长度相关代理的评估遗漏标注语域伪影，下游T2I基准又混杂训练选择，导致该分布在语料规模上难以审计。

Method: 提出匹配预算审计框架，作用于分布D_{π,V_c,C}，在固定文本预算B=64下报告五轴画像，覆盖提示侧覆盖面、图像条件忠实度与描述表面健康度，并以“声称可控基本单元”（CBU）作为统一声称单元；在五个公开源语料上实例化，完成七组配对比较，并采用Qwen与Gemma两种Judge验证。

Result: 四组跨语料配对中，所发布数据将每描述受支持CBU提升+3.39至+6.36（Qwen与Gemma Judge下均如此）；在CC12M上，同一框架揭示出在两种Judge与四个预算下均一致的长—密前沿。

Conclusion: 该框架可复用地、在语料规模上审计重标注监督分布，避免长度代理与下游训练混杂带来的偏差；据此发布约4.9亿规模审计后的多源重标注语料及审计工件包，支撑后续T2I训练数据透明度与可比性。

Abstract: Recaptioned image-text corpora are now standard for text-to-image (T2I) training, with vision--language model (VLM) captioners replacing sparse alt-text by dense descriptions. A recaptioned corpus is a supervision distribution induced by a documented captioning policy ($π$), captioner ($V_c$), and source corpus ($C$). We instantiate the framework on seven paired comparisons over five public source corpora. Across the four cross-corpus pairs, the released surface raises supported CBU per caption by $+3.39$ to $+6.36$ under both Qwen and Gemma Judges, and on CC12M the same framework exposes a long-vs-dense frontier that is consistent across both judges and four budgets. </details>


### [54] [Two Clocks in Diffusion MLLMs: When Answers Stabilize Before Rationales Unfold](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00953)
*Keuntae Kim,Yong Suk Choi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在掩码扩散多模态大模型（MLLM）中，答案候选可在推理过程（rationale）尚未完成时即稳定；作者区分"回顾性稳定"与"token承诺"，并测量这两条时间线与推理生成的关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前工作常将答案候选的稳定直接视为模型已"确定答案"，但掩码扩散模型中候选可能在推理尚未展开时就先稳定。需要区分"记录候选的回顾性稳定"与真正的"token承诺"，并厘清答案稳定、推理展开与视觉敏感性三者的时间关系。

Method: 在三个视觉问答基准上分析单块、EOS抑制的LaViDa运行；通过改变块长度（128→8）、EOS启用提示与直接指令干预，考察答案覆盖率与条件准确率；用对称分解分离覆盖与条件准确率的贡献；用匹配画布的图像消融测量视觉敏感性。

Result: 单块EOS抑制LaViDa运行中，答案稳定时89.4–98.1%的推理侧画布尚未写入；V*Bench上将块长度从128降至8时，该比例由89.4%变为1.7%，同时答案覆盖率与可用观测窗口变化。EOS启用提示下，直接指令使Nemotron在M3CoT和ScienceQA上整体准确率分别提升15.0和19.5个百分点，但使LaViDa/V*Bench准确率下降11.0个百分点。对称分解表明各变化的较大绝对分量来自覆盖率而非条件准确率。

Conclusion: 这些测量将答案稳定、推理展开与视觉敏感性区分开来，并确定覆盖率是提示差异中的较大组成部分。

Abstract: An answer candidate in a masked diffusion MLLM can stabilize while its rationale is still unfolding. Under EOS-enabled prompting, direct instructions improve Nemotron's overall accuracy by 15.0 and 19.5 percentage points on M3CoT and ScienceQA, but reduce LaViDa/V*Bench accuracy by 11.0 points. </details>


### [55] [Video-Index: A Curated Meta-Benchmark for Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00960)
*Enxin Song,Yinuo Xu,Shusheng Yang,Wenhao Chai,Jiatao Gu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出"攻击金字塔"（五级捷径攻击）审计115个视频基准，发现大量基准存在答案选项、问题文本或部分视觉证据的捷径；据此筛选构建并发布更难、可复现的Video-Index基准（840项）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频基准应当衡量其声称衡量的能力，但模型可利用答案选项、问题文本或部分视觉证据等捷径"作弊"，导致评估失真，因此需要系统化审计并构建抗捷径的攻击验证基准。

Method: 提出攻击金字塔——五级捷径攻击，逐级增加对每个条目的访问权限；用它审计115个视频基准；对112个基准的505,518个问答对进行筛查，形成受审计池；由Agent将评估请求转化为规格说明，并用确定性选择器配合red-team gate组合出可复现基准；发布Video-Index（四个能力组各210项最难验证条目，共840项，来自76个来源）。

Result: 35个基准上，从未看到任何帧的攻击者即可接近全视频准确率；51个含时序探针的基准在打乱帧后仍保持中位数96%的全视频准确率；63个基准中近重复问题至少占一半条目。在相同固定输入下，Claude Opus 5比所有开源模型高出37个百分点以上，agent工具再增加约20分，但所有系统在效率与准确率上仍有提升空间。

Conclusion: 当前视频基准普遍存在严重捷径漏洞，评估结果被高估；Video-Index通过攻击审计与确定性、可复现的构建流程提供了更严格的能力评测，但所有系统仍远未达标。

Abstract: A video benchmark should reward the capability it claims to measure, yet models can exploit answer options, question text, or partial visual evidence. We introduce the attack pyramid, five levels of shortcut attacks with increasing access to each item, and audit 115 video benchmarks with it. On 35 benchmarks, attackers that never see a frame approach full-video accuracy. On 51 benchmarks with temporal probes, shuffled frames keep a median 96% of full-video accuracy. Near-duplicate questions make up at least half the items in 63 benchmarks. We screen 505,518 question-answer pairs from 112 of them into an audited pool. Agents turn evaluation requests into specifications, and a deterministic selector with a red-team gate composes reproducible benchmarks. We release Video-Index, the 210 hardest verified items under these attacks in each of four capability groups, 840 items from 76 sources. With the same fixed input, Claude Opus 5 outscores every open-source model by over 37 percentage points, and agent tools add about 20 more, yet all systems leave room to improve efficiency and accuracy. Blog: https://www.enxinsong.com/blog/video-index/ GitHub: https://github.com/Espere-1119-Song/Video-Index Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Video-Index/Video-Index

</details>


### [56] [RelationVGGT: Visual Geometry Transformers for 3D Spatial Relation Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00970)
*Minsu Kim,Jaesung Choe,Jiwoo Lee,Yu-Chiang Frank Wang,Seon Joo Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出"3D空间关系分割"新任务，并设计前馈、无需位姿的多视角框架RelationVGGT，融合视觉与几何基础模型特征，通过关系Transformer实现主体条件下的跨视角关系预测，同时基于ScanNet++构建自动标注流水线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D重建已从逐场景优化走向前馈推理，语义场景理解也随之发展，但现有方法仅限于以对象为中心的感知，忽略了对象之间的空间关系。因此需要将空间关系理解引入前馈、无位姿的多视角设定。

Method: 提出RelationVGGT前馈框架：整合视觉基础模型的语义特征与3D几何基础模型的几何感知表示，并利用关系Transformer进行主体条件化、跨视角的关系预测。该方法无需逐场景优化，也无需已知相机位姿。此外，基于ScanNet++，结合VLM与LLM构建全自动标注流水线，实现可扩展的训练数据生成。

Conclusion: 该工作将3D空间关系分割形式化为前馈、无位姿的多视角任务，通过融合视觉与几何基础模型并结合关系Transformer，为对象间空间关系的理解提供了新范式与数据基础。

Abstract: Recent advances in 3D reconstruction have progressed from per-scene optimization to feed-forward inference, and semantic scene understanding has followed suit -- yet existing methods remain confined to object-centric perception, neglecting spatial relations between objects. We formulate 3D spatial relation segmentation in a feed-forward, pose-free multi-view setting: given a visually specified subject and a relational text query, the model segments the target across views without receiving its category name. To this end, we propose RelationVGGT, a novel feed-forward framework that integrates semantic features from a visual foundation model with geometry-aware representations from a 3D geometry foundation model and leverages a relation transformer for subject-conditioned, cross-view relation prediction -- requiring neither per-scene optimization nor known camera poses. We additionally provide a fully automated annotation pipeline built on ScanNet++ with VLMs and LLMs, enabling scalable training data generation for this new task.

</details>


### [57] [Concept Driven Domain Adaptation: Finding an Abstract Needle in a Haystack](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00973)
*Haiming Zhao,Tai Wang,Kun Zhang,Xicheng Peng,Zhiyang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出"概念到示例视频检索"任务(概念级抽象针尖海捞问题),并设计三阶段框架CDDA,将双塔视觉-语言模型适配到概念级检索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学教师检索纪录片片段时,往往查询的是要讲授的抽象概念而非屏幕上的可视事件。现有基于语言的视频时刻检索方法默认查询描述可观测事件,无法满足"用具体视觉现象实例化科学原理"的教学检索需求,存在抽象鸿沟。

Method: 提出Concept-Driven Domain Adaptation(CDDA)三阶段框架:1)用教科书与教师手册的示例-概念对构建文本嵌入空间结构;2)在冻结视觉编码器下将概念感知几何迁移到纪录片视觉域;3)用稀疏视觉概念监督联合微调双编码器,使文本-概念与视觉-概念角距缩小。

Result: 在自建初中物理检索基准上,CDDA在教学导向的概念检索上优于Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B等竞争性多模态基线,同时保持适配后的具体图文匹配能力。

Conclusion: 以概念作为中间语义锚点的分阶段对齐,可在保留预训练模型具体图文描述对齐的同时实现概念级适配,有效缓解抽象需求与稀疏视觉证据之间的鸿沟。

Abstract: Science teachers frequently search for documentary excerpts not by describing what appears on screen, but by querying the abstract concepts they intend to teach. This use case exposes a limitation of existing language-based video moment retrieval methods, which typically assume that queries describe observable events, whereas instructional search requires retrieving concrete visual phenomena that instantiate an underlying scientific principle. We study this setting as concept-to-example video retrieval, an abstract-needle-in-a-haystack problem where compact curriculum concepts must be grounded in temporally sparse documentary evidence. To bridge this abstraction gap, we propose Concept-Driven Domain Adaptation (CDDA), a three-stage framework for adapting two-tower vision-language models to concept-level retrieval. CDDA treats concepts as intermediate semantic anchors: it first structures the textual embedding space with textbook and teacher-handbook example-concept pairs, then transfers this concept-aware geometry to documentary visuals under a frozen visual encoder, and finally jointly adapts both encoders with sparse visual concept supervision. From a geometric perspective, this staged alignment reduces text-concept and vision-concept angular gaps, thereby encouraging concept-level adaptation while preserving the pretrained model's concrete image description alignment. On a curated middle-school physics retrieval benchmark, CDDA achieves stronger pedagogically oriented concept retrieval than several competitive multimodal baselines, including Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B, while maintaining concrete image-text matching after adaptation.

</details>


### [58] [VIEScore2: Unified Image Evaluation with Spatially Grounded Explanations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00994)
*Xianda Du,Max Ku,Weiming Ren,Zhi Rui Tam,Chunlin Ren,Ping Nie,Min-Hung Chen,Wenhu Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 VIEScore2，一个面向图像生成与编辑任务的统一评估器，将图像表示为 N×N 网格，单次前向同时预测质量分数与缺陷位置，并通过 GRPO 强化缺陷定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有合成图像评估器通常只输出单一标量质量分数，无法指出支撑该分数的图像区域，缺乏可解释性与空间定位能力。

Method: 以 N×N 网格的文本原生表示作为统一接口，支持异构空间监督与可直接验证的后训练目标；在 38K 样本上进行仅分数、仅定位及联合监督的监督微调，再用 GRPO 优化缺陷定位，奖励由单元格级 Dice 重叠、分数准确率与输出格式合法性组成；另用无参数解析器将结构化预测转为可读解释。

Conclusion: VIEScore2 通过网格化联合建模实现了分数预测与缺陷定位的统一，在评分相关性与空间定位上均超越通用 VLM 与专用空间评估器，兼具可解释性。

Abstract: Existing synthetic image evaluators typically provide only a scalar quality score and do not identify the image regions that support it. We introduce VIEScore2, a unified evaluator for image generation and editing tasks with optional conditioning images. VIEScore2 represents an image as an N x N grid and jointly predicts quality scores and defect locations in a single model pass. Its text-native grid representation provides a common interface for heterogeneous spatial supervision and enables directly verifiable post-training objectives. We train on 38K examples spanning score-only, localization-only, and joint supervision across generation and editing tasks. Starting from supervised fine-tuning, we further apply GRPO to improve defect localization using rewards that combine cell-level Dice overlap, score accuracy, and output-format validity. A parameter-free parser converts the structured predictions into readable explanations. On the primary suite, VIEScore2 achieves an overall-score SRCC of 0.601, compared with 0.491 for Gemini-3-Flash, the strongest zero-shot general-purpose VLM baseline under matched inputs. For defect localization, VIEScore2 outperforms both general-purpose VLMs and specialized spatial evaluators on three of six benchmarks in per-image grid IoU and ranks among the top three on five, including datasets beyond its training sources.

</details>


### [59] [Watch Your Speech: Text-aware Video-to-Speech Synthesis with Textual Conditioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01012)
*Gunwoo Lee,Yoori Oh,Yoseob Han*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出WYS框架，通过引入文本条件作为显式语言线索，缓解视频到语音合成中的一对多映射问题，在LRS2/LRS3上取得最优的音画同步性能并保持有竞争力的文本准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频到语音合成旨在从无声说话人脸视频生成自然且音素准确的语音。其核心挑战是固有的一对多映射问题：视觉动态信息不足以唯一确定对应话语，导致输出存在歧义。

Method: 提出Watch Your Speech（WYS）框架，将文本条件作为显式语言线索以缓解视觉歧义。框架包含基于注意力的嵌入融合模块，将文本上下文与视频序列协同整合；并结合条件流匹配目标实现高保真语音生成。
