Conclusion: 文本条件在内容可控的视频到语音合成中具有有效性，WYS验证了引入显式语言线索能够缓解视觉歧义并提升合成质量。

Abstract: Video-to-speech synthesis aims to generate natural-sounding speech from silent talking-face videos while ensuring phonetic accuracy. A fundamental challenge in this task is the inherent one-to-many mapping problem, where visual dynamics often lack sufficient information to uniquely determine the corresponding utterance. To address this, we propose Watch Your Speech (WYS), a video-to-speech synthesis framework that incorporates textual conditioning as an explicit linguistic cue to mitigate visual ambiguity. Our framework features an attention-based embedding fusion module that synergistically integrates textual context with video sequences, coupled with a conditional flow matching objective for high-fidelity speech generation. Extensive experiments on the LRS2 and LRS3 datasets demonstrate that WYS achieves superior performance, establishing new state-of-the-art results in audio-visual synchronization (LSE-C/D) while maintaining highly competitive textual accuracy (WER). Subjective evaluations further confirm that our model generates speech with near-human naturalness, validating the effectiveness of textual conditioning in content-controlled video-to-speech synthesis. Project page: https://github.com/gunwoo5034/Watch-your-Speech

</details>


### [60] [VASC: Value-Aware Sparse Attention with Cross-Layer Memory for Efficient 3D Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01013)
*Junyi Wu,Fanqing Kong,Leyang Chen,Shaoqiu Zhang,Yulun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VASC：一种免训练的稀疏注意力方法，通过价值感知块选择与执行感知跨层记忆，提升前馈3D视觉模型的推理效率与重建质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前馈3D视觉模型（如VGGT）虽统一了相机估计与稠密场景重建，但其二次全局注意力导致长序列代价高昂；而现有稀疏方法倾向于选择注意力高但价值冗余的区域，造成计算浪费。

Method: 提出免训练稀疏注意力VASC，包含两部分：1）价值感知块选择，将池化后的query-key相关性与邻域value对比度结合，在保留query相关且具区分度内容的同时降低冗余；2）跨层记忆，跟踪各层未被满足的需求，并依据实际执行更新状态，使先前受忽视的块能在固定计算预算下参与竞争。

Result: 在7Scenes与NeuralRGB-D数据集上，基于VGGT和π³验证，相比FasterVGGT在位姿估计与重建质量上均有提升，推理速度较稠密VGGT最高快2.29倍。

Conclusion: VASC通过价值感知与执行感知的稀疏注意力设计，在不训练的前提下有效缓解全局注意力的计算瓶颈，兼顾效率与精度，代码已开源。

Abstract: Feed-forward 3D vision models such as VGGT have achieved remarkable progress, unifying camera estimation and dense scene reconstruction in a single pass. However, their quadratic global attention makes long image sequences expensive, while existing sparse methods may favor highly attended yet value-redundant regions. To address these limitations, we introduce VASC, a training-free sparse attention method combining value-aware block selection and execution-aware cross-layer memory. Our value-aware block selection integrates pooled query--key relevance with neighboring value contrast, reducing redundancy while preserving query-relevant and distinctive content. Cross-layer memory tracks unserved demand across layers and updates this state according to actual execution, enabling previously underserved blocks to compete under a fixed computation budget. Experiments on 7Scenes and NeuralRGB-D with VGGT and $π^3$ demonstrate improved pose estimation and reconstruction quality compared with FasterVGGT, together with up to $2.29\times$ faster inference than dense VGGT. Code is available at https://github.com/kosakayamahoo-design/VASC.

</details>


### [61] [FutureWorlds: Learning Robotic World Models from Alternative Futures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01019)
*Hao Wu,Shengju Qian,Weiyan Wang,Fan Xu,Fan Zhang,Yuanpeng He,Qingsong Wen,Yuxuan Liang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FutureWorlds 提出统一候选构造、历史维护与相对质量学习的机器人世界模型框架，通过多样化束搜索和 MemSPO 优化，在多个数据集上显著提升预测质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将替代性预测转化为有效学习信号存在两大难点：相似候选难以提供有信息量的质量比较，而分叉轨迹需要持续维护各自的独立历史。论文旨在解决候选构建、历史维护与相对质量学习之间的统一问题。

Method: 基于多模态离散自回归模型，使用多样化束搜索在强化学习过程中构造兼顾置信度与多样性的候选未来；引入候选特定的有界记忆以保存场景状态，确保生成与策略打分使用一致的历史；提出 MemSPO（记忆条件搜索引导策略优化），将视频轨迹奖励转化为组相对优势以优化世界模型。

Result: 在 RT-1、BridgeV2 和 RoboCasa 上，相较各数据集最强基线，32 帧预测的 LPIPS 分别降低 14.78%、20.84% 和 9.12%；在固定评估配置下，仅 200 次 MemSPO 更新即可进一步改善生成质量，并支持超出训练时域的持续预测；记忆消融、解码敏感性分析与光流评估表明增益延伸至更准确的运动预测和更一致的对象状态。

Conclusion: FutureWorlds 通过统一候选构造、候选特定有界记忆与 MemSPO 相对质量优化，有效提升了机器人世界模型的视觉质量、运动预测准确性和对象状态一致性，并具备持续预测能力。

Abstract: Robotic world models predict action-conditioned future scenes, providing a foundation for understanding action outcomes. However, turning alternative predictions into useful learning signals remains challenging: similar candidates limit informative quality comparisons, while diverging trajectories require persistent maintenance of their individual histories. We introduce FutureWorlds, a framework that unifies candidate construction, history maintenance, and learning from relative quality. Built on a multimodal discrete autoregressive model, FutureWorlds uses diverse beam search during reinforcement learning to construct candidate futures that balance confidence and diversity. Candidate-specific bounded memory preserves scene states and ensures that generation and policy scoring use matching histories. We further propose MemSPO (Memory-Conditioned Search-Guided Policy Optimization), which converts video trajectory rewards into group-relative advantages to optimize the world model. On RT-1, BridgeV2, and RoboCasa, FutureWorlds reduces LPIPS for 32-frame predictions by 14.78%, 20.84%, and 9.12%, respectively, relative to the strongest baseline on each dataset. Under fixed evaluation configurations, only 200 MemSPO updates further improve generation quality and support continued prediction beyond the training horizon. Memory ablations, decoding sensitivity analysis, and optical-flow evaluation show that these gains extend beyond visual quality to more accurate motion prediction and more consistent object states. Project page and code: https://github.com/Alexander-wu/FutureWorlds.

</details>


### [62] [Towards Automatic Video Annotation with ASH: Zero-Shot Open-Vocabulary Multi-Object Tracking and Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01022)
*Arash Rocky,Q. M. Jonathan Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GPT与ASH两项技术，构建免训练的SAM3-ASH流水线，实现任意长度视频的自动化开放词汇实例分割与跟踪标注。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于记忆-注意力的视频实例分割（VIS）方法虽具备强零样本跟踪能力，但内存需求大，仅能处理短视频片段；且单提示推理设计使多类别开放词汇跟踪的计算成本极高，难以实现任意视频的全自动标注。

Method: 两项贡献：（1）广义存在令牌（GPT）：重构SAM3推理流程，通过虚拟提示批处理同时处理N个文本提示，在不改动任何学习组件的前提下将图像编码成本由O(N)降至O(1)。（2）标注与分割处理器（ASH）：通过带重叠的时间分块与基于IoU的跨块身份匹配，将任意记忆-注意力VIS跟踪器扩展至任意长度序列，无需数据集特定训练。二者实例化为SAM3-ASH。

Result: 在完全零样本条件下，SAM3-ASH在MOTS20上取得最先进HOTA；在另外七个基准上仍与经训练的专业模型具竞争力；峰值GPU显存低于25 GB。

Conclusion: 该方法为可扩展、免训练的全自动视频标注确立了实用基线，实现了任意视频的自动化开放词汇跟踪标注。

Abstract: Memory-attention-based Video Instance Segmentation (VIS) methods have demonstrated strong zero-shot tracking capability, yet their substantial memory requirements confine them to short video clips and their single-prompt inference design makes multi-category open-vocabulary tracking computationally prohibitive. This work introduces two contributions toward fully automated tracking annotation of arbitrary video. The Generalized Presence Token (GPT) reformulates SAM3's inference pipeline to process N text prompts simultaneously via virtual prompt batching, reducing image encoding cost from O(N) to O(1) with no modifications to any learned component. The Annotation and Segmentation Handler (ASH) extends any memory-attention VIS tracker to sequences of arbitrary length through overlapping temporal chunks with IoU-based inter-chunk identity matching, requiring no dataset-specific training. Instantiated on SAM3, the resulting pipeline -- SAM3-ASH -- achieves state-of-the-art HOTA on MOTS20 under fully zero-shot conditions and remains competitive with trained specialists across seven additional benchmarks, while peak GPU memory consumption stays below 25 GB, establishing a practical baseline for scalable, training-free automated video annotation.

</details>


### [63] [Bootstrapping Video Interaction Generation with Synthetic State Transitions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01039)
*Jiho Jang,Jinyoung Kim,Nojun Kwak,Kyungjune Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出一个生成可控交互合成数据集的框架，通过状态引导采样（SGS）生成高质量物理交互视频，并建立与人类判断一致的自动评测系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型虽能合成高保真视频，但难以刻画合理的物理交互及其状态转移，这限制了其在机器人和VR/AR中的应用。

Method: 利用结构化分类体系和先进图像编辑模型生成明确的“起始”与“结束”状态图像作为视觉锚点；提出状态引导采样（SGS）技术，以缓解朴素条件生成中的伪影；并开发与人类判断对齐的自动评测系统。

Result: 实验表明，在构建的数据集上微调基础模型，可显著提升其生成合理交互的能力。

Conclusion: 该工作通过可控合成数据与状态引导采样，有效增强了视频模型对物理交互及状态转移的生成能力，并提供了可靠的自动评测手段。

Abstract: While recent video generative models can synthesize high-fidelity videos, they struggle to portray plausible physical interactions and the resulting state transitions, a critical bottleneck for applications in robotics and VR/AR. To address this, we introduce a framework to generate a scalable synthetic dataset of controllable interactions. Our pipeline leverages a structured taxonomy and state-of-the-art image editing models to create explicit `start' and `end' state images, which serve as visual anchors for the interaction. To generate a seamless video utilizing these anchors, we propose State-Guided Sampling (SGS), a novel sampling technique that mitigates artifacts common in naive conditional generation. Furthermore, we develop and validate a new automated evaluation system that aligns with human judgments to ensure data quality. Experiments show that fine-tuning a base model on our dataset significantly enhances its ability to generate plausible interactions.

</details>


### [64] [Towards Subject Consistency over Dynamic Subject Sets in Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01052)
*Tongcheng Zhang,Jun Zhu,Jianfei Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DynSC-Eval，以动态主体集评估长视频生成的主体一致性，并通过奖励驱动后训练提升一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频生成时长增加后，主体可能中途进入或离开画面，传统静态主体集假设失效，导致一致性评估被掩盖且现有指标不敏感。

Method: DynSC-Eval在主体可见生命周期内动态追踪合格主体，用六个对象级指标衡量局部连续性与全局身份保持，并显式检测不一致事件；通过注入不一致事件的合成实验验证敏感度。基于该框架构造奖励，在自动驾驶场景做DiffusionNFT后训练，并用课程学习扩展至10s/30s。

Result: 合成实验证明其敏感度并揭示现有指标局限；5s/15s/60s评测暴露显著一致性差异。5s生成时六个不一致指标平均降低13.82%（Wan-2.1-1.3B）、5.66%（SANA-2B），I2V模型ReSim亦有改善；10s/30s上一致性优化仍有效且基本保持其他能力。

Conclusion: 长视频生成应采用动态主体集评估一致性；DynSC-Eval既是敏感评测框架，也可作为有效奖励用于后训练，实现长时一致性优化。

Abstract: We argue that as video generation extends to longer durations, subject consistency should be evaluated over \textit{dynamic subject sets}. We therefore introduce \textbf{DynSC-Eval}, an evaluation framework that dynamically tracks eligible subjects throughout their visible lifespans and measures local continuity and global identity preservation using six complementary object-level metrics, with explicit detection of inconsistency events. To validate its effectiveness, we design synthetic experiments that actively inject inconsistency events, demonstrating both the sensitivity of DynSC-Eval and the limitations of existing metrics. Evaluations of diverse models on 5s, 15s, and 60s video generation further reveal substantial subject consistency differences that are obscured by conventional metrics. Beyond evaluation, we construct rewards from DynSC-Eval and apply DiffusionNFT post-training in an autonomous-driving testbed. On 5s generation, our approach reduces the six inconsistency metrics by an average of 13.82\% for Wan-2.1-1.3B and 5.66\% for SANA-2B, with improvements also observed on the I2V model ReSim. Qualitative comparisons further demonstrate the effectiveness of our method. We then extend generation to 10s and 30s through curriculum learning and show that consistency optimization remains effective while largely preserving other capabilities.

</details>


### [65] [HierGF: Hierarchical Gaussian Fields via Geometry-perception Message Passing for Sparse-view 3D Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01056)
*Bi'an Du,Zhimin Zhang,Daizong Liu,Baoquan Chen,Wei Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出分层高斯场（HierGF），从分层几何感知视角重构稀疏视图3D重建问题，将有限的观测转化为可靠的自生成监督，以缓解多视图一致性差与几何欠采样区域结构缺失的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏视图仅包含有限3D信息，带来两大挑战：1）可用图像过少，难以建立多视图一致性；2）视图覆盖不足导致欠采样区域信息缺失，造成物体结构缺块。现有方法多依赖有限重投影误差与正则项，易过拟合单视图、跨视图外观不一致；在几何欠采样区域依赖启发式密度控制，缺乏可靠引导，导致模糊与结构空洞。

Method: 提出分层高斯场（HierGF）。其核心是将粗略3D几何信息与额外2D生成先验，通过两阶段几何感知主干网络转化为结构化伪监督，从而在极少输入视图下增强多视图一致性。此外，引入可学习置信网络，将梯度导向跨视图一致内容；并设计几何一致致密化模块，改善多视图对齐及欠采样区域的重建。

Result: 摘要未给出定量结果。

Conclusion: HierGF从分层几何感知视角，将有限观测转化为超出固定先验与启发式密度控制的自生成监督，为稀疏视图3D重建提供了缓解多视图一致性不足与欠采样结构缺失的新思路。

Abstract: Sparse view 3D reconstruction is an important and common scenario in multimedia applications, such as augmented reality/virtual reality (AR/VR) content creation, cultural heritage digitization, and certain robotic applications, where only a limited number of randomly captured views may be available. However, sparse views contain only limited 3D information, posing two major challenges:1) too few images are available for matching, making it difficult to build multi-view consistency; 2) insufficient view coverage leads to a lack of information in under-sampled regions, resulting in missing parts of object structure. Existing methods mostly still rely on limited reprojection errors and regularization terms, which are prone to overfitting to a single view and inconsistent appearances across views. In geometrically under-sampled regions, they often rely on heuristic density control, lacking reliable guidance and often resulting in blurring and structural holes.To address these issues, this paper proposes Hierarchical Gaussian Fields (HierGF), which revisits sparse-view reconstruction from a hierarchical geometry-perception perspective and converts limited observations into reliable self-generated supervision beyond fixed priors and heuristic density control. In particular, we transform coarse 3D geometric information and additional 2D generative priors into structured pseudo-supervision through a two-stage geometry-perception backbone network, thereby enhancing multi-view consistency with very few input views. In addition, we introduce a learnable confidence network to guide gradients toward cross-view consistent content, and a geometrically consistent densification module to improve the reconstruction of multi-view alignment and under-sampled regions.

</details>


### [66] [Overcoming Kernel Redundancy for Scaling Logic Gate Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01069)
*Sejin Park,Hongjae Lee,Changwoo Han,Seung-Won Jung*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文系统分析了逻辑门网络的宽度缩放行为，发现朴素加宽会导致逻辑核冗余与性能饱和，并提出动态逻辑核框架，通过输入相关的核路由促进核分组特化，实现门级布尔运算下的高效加宽，提升准确率与参数效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 逻辑门网络作为高效替代方案受到关注，但其缩放行为尚未充分探索。深度神经网络中扩大模型容量通常带来性能提升，而逻辑门网络是否也能获得类似的缩放收益是一个关键问题。作者聚焦宽度这一主要缩放轴，旨在揭示朴素加宽为何失效并寻找改进方案。

Method: 1) 以宽度为主要缩放轴，对逻辑门网络的宽度缩放行为进行系统分析；2) 发现朴素加宽会在逻辑核之间引入冗余，限制新增核的有效利用并导致性能饱和；3) 提出动态逻辑核框架，通过促进核分组间的特化来重组核利用率，实现输入相关的核路由；4) 保证路由与计算在推理时完全由门级布尔运算实现；5) 发现核冗余在第一门级最为显著，据此提出早期阶段动态逻辑核策略，将自适应集中于该层。

Result: 实验结果表明，该方法提升了核利用率并增加了核多样性，在提高准确率的同时改善了参数效率。

Conclusion: 逻辑门网络的加宽收益并非自动实现，核冗余是限制缩放效果的关键瓶颈；通过动态逻辑核框架与早期阶段特化策略，可在保持纯门级布尔推理的前提下有效利用增加宽度，获得更高准确率与更优参数效率。

Abstract: Differentiable logic gate networks, which operate using only logic gates, have recently attracted attention as an efficient alternative to conventional neural networks. However, despite their efficiency, the scaling behavior of logic gate networks remains underexplored. By contrast, scaling model capacity is a central design principle in deep neural networks and typically leads to improved performance. This discrepancy raises a key question: Can similar scaling benefits also be achieved in logic gate networks? In this work, we focus on width as a primary scaling axis and conduct a systematic analysis of its behavior in logic gate networks. We observe that naive width scaling often introduces redundancy among logic kernels, limiting the effective use of additional kernels and leading to performance saturation. To address this limitation, we propose a dynamic logic kernel framework that reorganizes kernel utilization by promoting specialization across kernel groups. This enables the network to better utilize increased width via input-dependent kernel routing, while ensuring that both routing and computation are implemented entirely with gate-level Boolean operations at inference time. We further find that kernel redundancy is most pronounced at the first gate level, motivating an early-stage dynamic logic kernel strategy that concentrates adaptation at this level. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach improves kernel utilization and increases kernel diversity, leading to higher accuracy with improved parameter efficiency.

</details>


### [67] [Ego2Act: Evaluating Goal-Directed Manipulation in Egocentric Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01092)
*Patrick Amadeus Irawan,Iskandar Muda Rizky Parlambang,Rava Maulana,Qinrong Cui,Erland Hilman Fuadi,Zayd M. K. Zuhri,Nanda Ryaas Absar,Ahmed Elshabrawy,Wilfried Ariel Mulyawan,Shoubin Yu,Yue Zhang,Mohit Bansal,Alham Fikri Aji*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Ego2Act基准，包含110个真实任务、2640段视频，用于评估视频生成模型能否根据初始场景图像与高层目标，生成实现多步操作的第一人称视频；同时提出免参考评估管线Ego2ActJudge，并揭示模型在多步执行和细粒度物理动态上的不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频生成模型正被用作具身规划与学习的世界模拟器，但其需在生成视觉合理画面的同时预测环境在目标导向动作下的动态演化。现有基准多聚焦单步短动作或逐步指令，缺乏对多步物理推理的考察，尤其在第一人称视频生成中，模型需通过规划完成多个真实操作以达成高层目标。该能力评估不足。

Method: 构建Ego2Act基准：涵盖日常场景下110个真实任务、2640段视频，并变化物体杂乱程度与多步复杂度；任务设定为给定初始场景图像和高层目标，评估模型能否生成第一人称视频中手部操作物体以完成任务。同时提出免参考评估管线Ego2ActJudge，用于可扩展地评估任务完成度与物理合理性。

Result: Ego2ActJudge在任务完成度与物理合理性评估上与人类共识的对齐程度优于相关基线。实验发现：模型生成的模拟常跳过或部分执行步骤，导致后续步骤缺少依赖状态，最终目标未达成；模型在细粒度物理动态方面持续失败，尤其在复杂物体操作和持久世界建模时。

Conclusion: Ego2Act为推进视频模型迈向物理合理、目标导向的模拟提供了严格测试平台，揭示了当前模型在多步规划、状态依赖维持与精细物理动态建模上的关键局限。

Abstract: Video generation models are increasingly being explored as world simulators for embodied planning and learning. To do so effectively, these models must not only generate visually appealing frames, but also predict how environments dynamically evolve when executing goal-directed actions. While evaluating these capabilities is crucial, existing benchmarks focus mainly on single short actions or step-by-step instructions. This leaves multi-step physical reasoning underexplored, especially in egocentric video generation that requires planning to simulate proper execution to accomplish high-level goals by carrying out multiple real-world manipulations. We introduce Ego2Act, a goal-directed benchmark featuring 2,640 videos from 110 real-world tasks across day-to-day settings, varying object clutter and multi-step complexity. Given an initial scene image and a high-level goal, Ego2Act evaluates whether video generation models can produce realistic egocentric videos of a hand manipulating objects to carry out the task. To support scalable evaluation, we also introduce Ego2ActJudge, a reference-free evaluation pipeline that achieves better task completion and physics plausibility evaluation alignment with human consensus compared to relevant baselines. Our findings reveal that models' generated simulations often skip or partially execute steps, leaving later steps missing dependent states, which leads to unfulfilled goal. Furthermore, models consistently fail at fine-grained physical dynamics, particularly during complex object manipulation and persistent world modeling. We hope Ego2Act provides a rigorous testbed for advancing video models toward physically plausible, goal-directed simulation.

</details>


### [68] [MVDG: Efficient Multi-view 3D Disambiguation on Unconstrained Real-World Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01098)
*Hanyuan Xiao,Gonglin Chen,Haolin Xiong,Wenbin Teng,Haiwei Chen,Yajie Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MVDG，基于3D基础模型VGGT的多视图消歧框架，单次编解码处理任意数量视图，减少成对比较依赖，提升SfM精度与推理速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模野外3D重建与视觉定位中，视觉相似但几何不同的3D表面（Doppelgangers）会产生"错觉匹配"，是根本性障碍。既有方法采用成对分类器，限制了多视图上下文推理能力，且导致下游SfM出现O(n^2)推理复杂度。

Method: 基于3D基础模型VGGT构建可扩展多视图消歧框架，联合推理任意数量多视图图像；引入3D感知多视图特征，在单次前向中完成视图编解码以降低对成对比较的依赖。针对VGGT直接多视图微调在噪声监督下不稳定的问题，受Doppelgangers标签歧义启发，从AerialMegaDepth构建伪成对训练集，并在采样子集上微调以获得稳定优化与强泛化。此外，构建伪成对数据集用于高效验证，并推导常规SfM指标与该伪成对测试分类精度之间的预测关系。

Result: 在成对准确率上与基线相当，同时在SfM精度和推理速度上均优于基线。

Conclusion: 多视图联合推理可有效缓解Doppelgangers错觉匹配，避免O(n^2)复杂度；采样子集微调是稳定且泛化的训练策略；伪成对验证可为昂贵SfM评估提供高效替代。

Abstract: Illusory matches between distinct yet visually similar 3D surfaces--doppelgangers--remain a fundamental obstacle for large-scale, in-the-wild 3D reconstruction and visual localization. Prior work mitigates this issue with pairwise classifiers, but this design limits multi-view contextual reasoning and incurs O(n^2) inference complexity for downstream structure-from-motion (SfM). We present MVDG, a scalable multi-view disambiguation framework built on the 3D foundation model VGGT, which jointly reasons over an arbitrary number of multiview images. By incorporating 3D-aware multi-view features, our method reduces dependence on pairwise comparisons by encoding and decoding views in a single pass. We further observe that direct multi-view fine-tuning of VGGT can be unstable under noisy supervision; motivated by label ambiguity in Doppelgangers, we construct a pseudo-pairwise training set from AerialMegaDepth and show that fine-tuning on sampled subsets yields stable optimization and strong generalization to held-out scenes. Finally, because full SfM evaluation (even with faster pipelines such as GLOMAP) remains expensive, we process a pseudo-pairwise dataset for efficient validation; we derive a predictive relationship between regular SfM metrics and the classification accuracy on this pseudo-pairwise test. Experiments show that our method achieves comparable pairwise accuracy while improving both SfM accuracy and inference speed over baselines.

</details>


### [69] [Affine-Aligned Atlas for Canonical Gaussian Construction in Video Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01114)
*Masaya Takabe,Hiroshi Watanabe,Sujun Hong,Tomohiro Ikai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出仿射图集规范高斯表示，将规范高斯构建于更大仿射对齐图集空间，以帧级仿射变换吸收全局运动，提升大相机运动视频的重建质量，且可低成本集成到现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于高斯的视频表示通常将视频分解为规范高斯与时间形变。当视频存在大范围全局运动（如相机移动）时，规范表示会与各帧错位，加重时间形变模型负担，导致重建质量下降。

Method: 构造仿射图集规范高斯表示：在更大的仿射对齐图集空间中构建规范高斯；在规范高斯构建之前，用逐帧仿射变换吸收全局运动，从而缩小规范表示与目标帧之间的差距。该方法仅修改规范构建阶段，可集成到现有基于规范高斯的方法中，额外参数开销可忽略。

Result: 实验表明，该方法提升了重建质量，尤其在具有大相机运动的序列上效果显著。

Conclusion: 通过仿射对齐图集空间构建规范高斯并预先吸收全局运动，可有效缓解规范表示与目标帧的错位问题，是一种兼容性强、开销低的改进方案。

Abstract: Gaussian splatting has recently emerged as an efficient representation for images and videos due to its explicit structure and fast rendering capability. Existing Gaussian-based video representations often decompose a video into canonical Gaussians and temporal deformation. However, when a video contains large global motion such as camera movement, the canonical representation may become misaligned with individual frames, increasing the burden on the temporal deformation model. In this paper, we propose an affine-atlas canonical Gaussian representation, which constructs canonical Gaussians in a larger affine-aligned atlas space. Frame-wise affine transforms absorb global motion before canonical Gaussian construction, reducing the gap between the canonical representation and target frames. Since the proposed method only modifies the canonical construction stage, it can be integrated into existing canonical-Gaussian-based methods with negligible additional parameter cost. Experiments show that our method improves reconstruction quality especially for sequences with large camera motion.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: 将单词识别建模为目标检测任务，使用三种模型：SSD+MobileNetV2、Faster R-CNN+InceptionResNetV2以及二者的集成模型；引入改进的非极大值抑制（Modified NMS）以提升结果有效性；自建9841张、涵盖不同书写者多样笔迹的手写孟加拉语单词图像数据集进行训练与测试。

Result: 在测试集上评估三种模型性能，集成模型表现最佳，F1-score为92.61%；在单词级别上，集成模型对96.12%的单词能在一定程度上正确识别。

Conclusion: 集成深度学习目标检测模型结合改进NMS可有效识别手写孟加拉语单词；后续可通过引入后处理阶段纠正系统错误以进一步提升性能。

Abstract: An optical character recognition (OCR) can scan a paper and extract text using technology, making people's jobs easier. While various OCR systems are available in the software industry, finding a reliable equivalent solution for Bangla takes much work. When it comes to handwritten texts, the situation is much more unusual. Recognizing words from word images is the most critical stage in any OCR process. It is the second stage after segmenting words from text pictures. If this stage fails, the overall performance of the OCR will be poor, regardless of how well the other phases perform. This study aims to recognize words using deep learning in a handwritten Bangla word image. Three object detection models, SSD with MobileNetV2, Faster R-CNN with InceptionResNetV2, and an ensemble model of these two, have been used to train and test handwritten word images. A modified Non-Maximum Suppression has been introduced to enhance the effectiveness of the models' results. A customized dataset of 9841 handwritten Bangla word images has been compiled, featuring diverse handwriting styles from various individuals. All three models' performances have been checked against the test dataset, and the ensemble model has been the most impressive, with an F1-score of 92.61%. Also, at the word level, the ensemble model correctly recognizes 96.12% of the words to some extent. The system can be further improved by introducing a post-processing phase to correct errors generated by the system.

</details>

*Maria Correia de Verdier,Rachit Saluja,Jason Sho,Maryam Vabarizad,Rennie Yung-Chieh Chen,Uyen N. T. Nguyen,Mona Alrehaili,Layal Aweidah,Deniz Bulja,Wesley C. Chan,Hernan Chaves,Madhavi Duvvuri,Huseyin Ekin Ergin,Undrakh-Erdene Erdenebold,Ekim Gumeler,Mohamed Sobhi Jabal,Chin-Chi Kuo,Fatima Mubarak,Sevde Nur Emir,Scott Riley K. Ong,Johanna Ortiz,Almudena Pérez-Lara,Andreas M. Rauschecker,Shayan Sirat Maheen Anwar,Charit Tippareddy,Tam Tran,Sorawis Visrutaratna,John Mongan,Adam E. Flanders,Robyn Ball,Greg Zaharchuk,Peter D. Chang,Felipe Kitamura,Errol Colak,Luciano Prevedello,Tyler Richards,Data Contributor Group,Dataset Annotator Group,Evan Calabrese,Jeffrey D. Rudie*

TL;DR: 本文介绍了RSNA颅内动脉瘤（RSNA-ICA）数据集，这是一个面向AI动脉瘤检测与定位的大型、公开、专家标注多模态影像数据集。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 颅内动脉瘤破裂致死致残率高，但动脉瘤检测仍具挑战，尤其对小病灶及常规非血管造影影像而言。为支持AI算法在颅内动脉瘤检测与定位方向的发展与评估，RSNA联合ASNR、SNIS、ESNR构建了该数据集。

Method: 数据集涵盖来自12个国家21家机构的4278名成年患者的7202个CTA、MRA和MRI序列（2566 CTA、2166 MRA、2470 MRI），包含有和无颅内囊状动脉瘤的病例，具备显著的地域与影像多样性。专家标注了动脉瘤的存在与位置，其中178个序列额外提供挑战赛定义血管位置的三维分割。该数据集用于2025年RSNA颅内动脉瘤检测挑战赛中算法的开发与评估。

Result: 7202个图像序列中，5041个通过MIRA公开可用，其余用于挑战赛的公开与私有测试集。数据集对研究社区免费开放（非商业用途）。

Conclusion: RSNA-ICA为推进基于AI的动脉瘤检测（覆盖血管造影与常规神经影像检查）提供了全面的资源。

Abstract: Intracranial aneurysm rupture is associated with substantial morbidity and mortality, yet aneurysm detection remains challenging, particularly for small lesions and on routine non-angiographic imaging examinations. To support the development and evaluation of artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms for intracranial aneurysm detection and localization, the Radiological Society of North America (RSNA), in collaboration with the American Society of Neuroradiology (ASNR), the Society of Neurointerventional Surgery (SNIS), and the European Society of Neuroradiology (ESNR), curated the RSNA Intracranial Aneurysm (RSNA-ICA) Dataset. Developed for the 2025 RSNA Intracranial Aneurysm Detection Challenge, RSNA-ICA is a large, publicly available, expert-annotated dataset comprising 7202 CTA, MRA, and MRI series from 4278 adult patients collected across 21 institutions in 12 countries spanning five continents. The dataset includes 2566 CTA, 2166 MRA, and 2470 MRI series from patients with and without intracranial saccular aneurysms, providing substantial geographic and imaging diversity. Expert annotations indicate both aneurysm presence and location, and 178 series additionally include three-dimensional segmentations of challenge-defined vascular locations. RSNA-ICA was used to develop and evaluate algorithms in the 2025 RSNA Intracranial Aneurysm Detection Challenge. Of the 7202 image series, 5041 are publicly available through MIRA (https://mira.rsna.org/dataset/7), while the remainder were used for challenge public and private test sets. The dataset is freely available to the research community for noncommercial use and provides a comprehensive resource for advancing AI-based aneurysm detection across both angiographic and routine neuroimaging examinations.

</details>


### [72] [OptimusMesh: Compact Autoregressive Mesh Generation from Point Clouds via Sparse Latent Pivots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01148)
*Mazhar Iqbal,Naoya Chiba,Xuanmeng Sha,Tomohiro Mashita,Yuki Uranishi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出OptimusMesh，一种基于稀疏隐枢轴条件的点云直接生成紧凑三角网格的框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从点云直接生成紧凑且几何保真的3D网格仍是根本性挑战：点云无序稀疏，网格结构不规则且拓扑多变。现有方法多依赖隐式表示加表面提取/重建，虽有效但会产生稠密或过度平滑的网格，往往需要昂贵的后处理与简化。

Method: 将2048个带方向输入点压缩为仅16个稀疏隐枢轴，几何条件集缩减128倍；这些枢轴提供紧凑结构表示，用于两阶段自回归框架：先生成网格顶点，再以生成顶点与相同枢轴为条件预测三角面片。

Result: 相比近期点云条件自回归方法使用257个解码器条件token，OptimusMesh仅用16个，条件序列缩短16.1倍；在对比方法中输出最紧凑，面片数减少25.7%–94.1%，同时保持有竞争力的几何保真度与分布质量。

Conclusion: 稀疏隐枢轴条件能在显著压缩几何条件与输出规模的同时保持几何保真，实现点云到紧凑三角网格的直接生成。

Abstract: Generating compact and geometrically faithful 3D meshes directly from point clouds remains a fundamental challenge. Point clouds are unordered and sparse, whereas meshes exhibit irregular structure and varying topology. As a result, many existing approaches rely on implicit representations followed by surface extraction or reconstruction. Although effective, these pipelines can produce dense or over-smoothed meshes, often requiring computationally expensive post-processing and simplification. We present OptimusMesh, a framework for direct compact triangle mesh generation from point clouds using sparse latent pivot conditioning. Our key idea is to compress $2{,}048$ oriented input points into only $16$ sparse latent pivots, reducing the geometric conditioning set by $128\times$. These pivots provide a compact structural representation shared across a two-stage autoregressive framework that first generates mesh vertices and then predicts triangular faces conditioned on the generated vertices and the same pivots. Compared with the evaluated recent point-cloud-conditioned autoregressive methods, which use $257$ decoder-conditioning tokens, OptimusMesh uses only $16$, yielding a $16.1\times$ shorter conditioning sequence. Experiments show that OptimusMesh produces the most compact outputs among the compared recent autoregressive methods, using $25.7\%$--$94.1\%$ fewer faces while maintaining competitive geometric fidelity and distributional quality.

</details>


### [73] [PhysicsLENS: Diagnosing Physical Property Blindness in Video Generation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01162)
*Isaiah Milkey,Som Sagar,Aditya Taparia,Xinyuan Liu,Jiqing Wen,Ransalu Senanayake*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PhysicsLENS数据集与基准，用配对场景显式改变物理属性以评估机器人视频世界模型的物理合理性，发现外观逼真的视频常忽略所述物理属性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可靠的视频世界模型可为机器人学习、规划与评估提供可扩展的预测环境，但生成视频常违反物理规律、以不合物理的方式完成任务。现有视频生成基准忽略视觉上"隐藏"的物理量（如重量、粘度、摩擦），导致只评估物理的视觉保真度而非物理正确性。

Method: 构建PhysicsLENS数据集与基准：采用匹配场景对，保持相同的条件帧与任务，仅在场景文本描述中改变底层物理属性；场景取自公开机器人视频源，覆盖碰撞、重力、动量、摩擦、形变、流体、因果七个物理域；对四个视频生成模型进行评测，收集超400条人工标注。

Result: 在四个视频生成模型上评测并获400+人工标注。结果显示看似合理的视频常忽略所指物理属性（47个中有34个）；在提示中说明该属性仅使合理性略微下降，且差异不显著。

Conclusion: 现有视频模型倾向于生成视觉上合理但忽视底层物理属性的结果，说明其物理准确性不足，PhysicsLENS为以机器人任务为背景的物理合理性评估提供了新基准。

Abstract: Reliable video world models could provide scalable predictive environments for robot learning, planning, and evaluation. However, generated robot videos can violate physical principles and complete tasks through physically implausible behavior, limiting their reliability for robot learning and planning. Current video-generation benchmarks exclude physics that are inherently hidden by visuals (e.g., weight, viscosity, friction). Due to this, video models are evaluated on the fidelity of physics, not the underlying accuracy of physics. We introduce PhysicsLENS, a dataset and benchmark for evaluating plausibility of physical properties grounded in robotics. PhysicsLENS uses matched scenario pairs that hold the same conditioning frame and task, while varying underlying physics in the scene description. Scenarios are curated from public robot video sources and annotated across seven physical domains: collision, gravity, momentum, friction, deformation, fluid, and causality. We evaluate across four video generation models, producing over 400 human-annotated labels. Results show that plausible-looking videos often ignore the stated property (34 of 47), and that stating the property lowers plausibility only slightly and not significantly.

</details>


### [74] [CineMR: Tool-Integrated Vision-Language Reasoning for Quantitative Cardiac MRI Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01166)
*Kunyang Li,Hai Nguyen,Joshua Lowe,Chenguang Zhao,Peace C. Madueme,Mehdi Hedjazi Moghari,Mubarak Shah,Pegah Khosravi,Yuzhang Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CineMR 是一个工具增强的视觉语言模型，通过调用心脏影像分析工具并将结果融入交错推理，实现定量心脏磁共振（cine CMR）评估，在多队列基准上显著超越现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医学视觉语言模型（VLM）无法在无分析工具辅助下，从多维 cine 图像中可靠地推导定量测量值。而 cine CMR 解读需要整合定性视觉评估与心室容积、射血分数、心肌质量、壁厚、局部壁运动等定量测量，因此需要可靠的工具使用能力。

Method: 提出 CineMR——一种工具增强的 VLM，调用心脏图像分析工具并将其输出整合进交错推理。构建了覆盖定量指标提取、多分类诊断和鉴别诊断的多队列视觉问答基准，以及分割、相位选择、容积测定、形态测量和局部壁运动分析工具。训练采用监督微调（SFT）学习工具交互轨迹，随后使用带条件工具使用奖励的组相对策略优化（GRPO）。

Result: 在多队列 cine CMR 基准上，CineMR 达到 35.9% pass@1 和 58.9% pass@4；Qwen3-VL-8B 骨干仅 1.5% pass@1，LLaVA-Med v1.5 为 0.0%，MedGemma-4B 为 7.0%。GRPO 后正确工具调用率达 99.8%（SFT 后为 78.9%）。实时工具输出使心室测量精度较直接模型预测提升 20.4–23.7%；移除所有工具使 pass@1 从 35.9% 降至 27.9%。

Conclusion: 结果凸显了可靠工具使用对定量 cine CMR 推理的重要性，并支持 CineMR 作为辅助心脏图像评估的有前景方法。代码、基准资源和模型权重已开源。

Abstract: Cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR), including cine imaging, is a reference standard for the noninvasive assessment of cardiac morphology and ventricular function. Cine CMR interpretation integrates qualitative visual assessment with quantitative measurements of ventricular volumes, ejection fraction, myocardial mass, wall thickness, and regional wall motion. Current medical vision-language models (VLMs) cannot reliably derive quantitative measurements from multidimensional cine images without analysis tools. We present CineMR, a tool-augmented VLM that invokes cardiac image-analysis tools and integrates their outputs into interleaved reasoning for quantitative CMR assessment. We also construct a multi-cohort visual question answering benchmark covering quantitative metric extraction, multiclass diagnosis, and differential diagnosis, together with tools for segmentation, phase selection, volumetry, morphometry, and regional wall motion analysis. CineMR is trained with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on tool-interaction traces followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with conditional tool-use rewards. On the multi-cohort cine CMR benchmark, CineMR achieves 35.9% pass@1 and 58.9% pass@4, compared with 1.5% pass@1 for the Qwen3-VL-8B backbone and 0.0% and 7.0% pass@1 for LLaVA-Med v1.5 and MedGemma-4B, respectively. Correct tool invocation reaches 99.8% after GRPO, up from 78.9% after SFT. Live tool outputs improve ventricular measurement accuracy by 20.4--23.7% over direct model predictions, and removing all tools reduces pass@1 from 35.9% to 27.9%. These results highlight the importance of reliable tool use for quantitative cine CMR reasoning and support CineMR as a promising approach for assistive cardiac image assessment. Code, benchmark resources, and model weights are available at https://github.com/AI-MIND-Lab/CineMR.

</details>


### [75] [Skeleton-and-Strategy Prompting: Training-Free Negation Understanding for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01180)
*Yuliang Cai,Mohammad Rostami,Jesse Thomason*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练上下文学习方法SSP，通过骨架与策略提示提升VLM否定理解能力，在否定VQA基准上达到SOTA且计算高效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在VQA任务上表现优异，但理解否定能力差，遇到含否定子句的问题常给出错误答案，需要一种不更新参数、低成本的解决方案。

Method: SSP为免训练、上下文学习方法：给定否定问题，先将问题结构抽象为骨架，从轻量问题池中检索少量同骨架问题，再提示VLM分析其共享否定模式并合成单句回答策略；将骨架与策略前置到测试样本中以引导模型正确处理否定问题。

Result: 在多个否定VQA基准上，SSP在否定类VQA任务中取得SOTA性能，同时保持计算高效。

Conclusion: 通过骨架抽象与策略生成的提示方式，可在不更新参数的前提下显著提升VLM的否定理解能力。

Abstract: Despite the strong performance of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on a wide range of visual question answering (VQA) tasks, these models consistently struggle to understand negation and produce incorrect answers when questions involve negated clauses. To address this limitation, we propose Skeleton-and-Strategy Prompting (\textbf{SSP}), a training-free, in-context learning method that improves VLM negation understanding capabilities without any parameter updates. Given a negation question, our method first abstracts the underlying question structure into a skeleton, retrieves a small set of same-skeleton questions from a lightweight question pool, then prompts the VLM to analyze their shared negation pattern and synthesize a single-sentence answering strategy. The skeleton and strategy are prepended to the test sample to guide the model correctly tackle the negation problems. Experiments on multiple negation VQA benchmarks show that SSP achieves state-of-the-art performance on negation-focused VQA tasks while remaining computationally efficient.

</details>


### [76] [Color Independent Word Segmentation From Transcribed Bangla Passages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01191)
*Faias Satter,Noor Masrur,Sk. Md. Masudul Ahsan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对手写孟加拉语文本图像，提出一种基于自适应阈值与膨胀滤波的单词分割方法，构建包含各类拍摄干扰的自定义数据集，在7374个单词上生成7278个边界框，取得90.60%召回率、91.80%精确率和91.20% F1值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OCR系统能扫描纸质文档并提取文本，但孟加拉语缺乏可靠的OCR方案，手写体场景更为罕见。单词分割是OCR的首要基础步骤，该步骤失败将导致后续环节再优秀也无法保证整体性能。因此本文旨在解决手写孟加拉语文本图像中的单词分割问题，并使其适用于任意手机拍摄图像。

Method: 研究聚焦手写孟加拉语文本图像的单词分割，方法可应用于任意手机拍摄图像，不受纸张与墨水颜色、类型限制。考虑到手机拍摄图像可能存在阴影干扰，专门构建了涵盖各类潜在障碍的自定义数据集，并采用自适应阈值化与膨胀滤波等图像处理手段生成单词边界框。

Result: 针对7374个单词，共生成7278个边界框，召回率为90.60%，精确率为91.80%，F1分数为91.20%。

Conclusion: 该系统可通过以下方式进一步改进：对包含多个单词的边界框执行嵌套操作，或将自适应阈值化与膨胀滤波器的尺寸调整至更精细的水平。

Abstract: An optical character recognition(OCR) system can scan paper and extract text, making people's jobs easier. While numerous OCR systems are accessible in the software sector, finding a dependable equivalent solution for Bangla is tough. When it comes to handwritten texts, the case is even more rare. The first fundamental step to any OCR is to segment words from text images. If this stage fails, the total OCR's performance will be poor no matter how promising the later stages perform. This research aims to segment words in a handwritten Bangla text image. This research can be implemented on any smartphone-captured image, irrespective of the color and type of paper and ink. Furthermore, as smartphone-captured images can create shadow interferences, the custom dataset built for this research is created in such a way that every possible obstacle that can be faced is included. For 7374 words, a total of 7278 bounding boxes are generated, which have recall of 90.60 %, precision of 91.80 %, and F1-score of 91.20 %. The system can be further improved with nested operations on bounding boxes containing several words or by adjusting the adaptive thresholding and dilation filter sizes to a more precise level.

</details>


### [77] [FlashBack: Knowing When to Remember in Streaming Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01192)
*Yi Chen,MingMing Yu,Rui-Qi Wang,Boran Wang,Xiaohang Cao,Chu Tang,Jingmin Chen,Jie Gu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FlashBack：一种免训练的选择性多层级流式视频语言模型记忆框架，在检索历史前先判断查询是否需要历史证据，仅在需要时启用独立的回忆轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式视觉语言模型需在有界算力下处理持续增长的视频流，实时感知与长期记忆之间存在持续张力。检索历史信息虽可缓解，但历史回忆并非总是有益：无关历史会引入干扰上下文、损害实时感知。因此流式记忆不仅要解决"记什么"，还要解决"何时"和"如何"访问。

Method: 提出 FlashBack 免训练框架，实现选择性、多层级记忆。检索前利用冻结流式 VLM 的语义理解推断查询是否需历史证据：若不需要则沿 Native 轨迹推理；若需要则进入独立的 Recall 轨迹。Recall 轨迹通过查询局部的 Side-KV 通路将近期上下文与检索到的长期记忆结合，在不修改持久 Native 状态的情况下保持局部时间连续性。

Result: 在 StreamingVLM 与 Mage-VL-4B 上实例化，于 OVO-Bench 和 StreamingBench 评测。在若干长程与依赖记忆的任务上取得提升，同时基本保持实时感知，性能可与强训练型流式方法竞争，且无需额外训练。

Conclusion: 历史回忆的选择性触发与隔离式检索路径可有效平衡流式 VLM 的实时感知与长期记忆，且免训练方案具备与训练型方法相当的竞争力。

Abstract: Streaming vision-language models must process continuously growing video streams under a bounded compute budget, creating a persistent tension between real-time perception and long-term memory. Retrieving historical information provides a natural remedy, yet historical recall is not uniformly beneficial: unnecessary history may introduce irrelevant context into current reasoning and interfere with native real-time perception. Effective streaming memory should therefore address not only what to remember, but also when and how to access it. To this end, we introduce FlashBack, a training-free framework for selective, multi-level memory in streaming vision-language models. Before retrieving history, FlashBack draws on the semantic understanding of the frozen streaming VLM to infer whether a query calls for historical evidence. This assessment determines whether inference remains on the Native trajectory or invokes an isolated Recall trajectory. The Recall trajectory combines recent context with retrieved long-term memory through a query-local Side-KV pathway, preserving local temporal continuity without modifying the persistent Native state. We instantiate FlashBack on StreamingVLM and Mage-VL-4B and evaluate it on OVO-Bench and StreamingBench. The results show improvements on several long-horizon and memory-dependent tasks while largely preserving real-time perception, with performance competitive with strong training-based streaming methods despite requiring no additional training. Our code will be announced later.

</details>


### [78] [iSEE: Object Permanence Through Self-Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01201)
*Pramish Paudel,Ajad Chhatkuli,Luc Van Gool,Danda Pani Paudel*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: iSEE是一个无标签的自监督框架，通过物体证据建模、外观-位置分离和重现在场学习，实现遮挡下的物体恒存性，在LA-CATER上86%遮挡后重识别，隐藏定位达4.1 mAP接近有监督SoTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物体恒存性（在遮挡时保持物体身份与位置）是视频表征的核心，但现有自监督slot attention方法在遮挡下会丢失slot，无法实现恒存。该问题难点在于需检测遮挡、重现时重识别、保持隐藏位置连续，且仅能以外观重现作为学习信号。

Method: 提出iSEE框架，含三个组件：(i)物体证据建模：比较slot当前注意力与其历史，判断物体何时被遮挡；(ii)外观-位置分离：两条slot流，外观流保持用于重识别，位置流持续变化；(iii)从重现中学恒存：walker跟踪隐藏物体位置，仅以物体重现位置为训练信号。

Result: 在LA-CATER static上，iSEE在86%的遮挡后将重现物体归还到自身slot（SlotContrast为32%），隐藏期间定位与有标签训练的SoTA RAM相差4.1 mAP。两条流支持下游规划，位置流可作世界模型的动作。

Conclusion: iSEE无需任何标签即满足遮挡恒存的三个要求，验证了外观-位置分离与重现在场学习的有效性，并可用于下游规划，为无监督物体中心视频表征提供了新思路。

Abstract: Object permanence, keeping track of an object's identity and position while it is occluded, is central to video representations that track, predict and plan. Trackers that achieve it learn from boxes, track identities and visibility labels. On the other hand, self-supervised object-centric methods discover objects without labels: through slot attention, it represents a video as slots that bind to objects and follow them across frames. However, these slots are lost under occlusion, making the desired permanence impossible. Reasoning permanence is a hard problem because it requires to detect when an object becomes occluded, re-identify when object reappears, and keep the object's hidden position continuous, using reapperance as the only learning cue. To address this, we propose iSEE, a novel framework that offers all three aforementioned requirements, without any labels whatsoever. We built iSEE using the following three proposed components: (i) Object evidence modelling: a slot's attention, compared with its own past, reveals when its object is hidden. (ii) Appearance-position separation: two slot streams let the appearance be held for re-identification while the position keeps changing. (iii) Permanence from reappearance: a walker follows the hidden object's position, trained only on where the object reappears. On LA-CATER static, iSEE returns a reappearing object to its own slot after 86% of occlusions, against 32% for SlotContrast, and localises it while hidden within 4.1 mAP of the label-trained SoTA RAM. The two streams also allow downstream planning, with the position stream as the action of a world model. Project page: https://insait-institute.github.io/iSEE/

</details>


### [79] [Semantic RGB--Depth Based Surgical Skill Assessment in Microscopic Stereo Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01205)
*Jecia Z. Y. Mao,Sue M. Cho,Francis X. Creighton,Deepa Galaiya,Russell H. Taylor,Manish Sahu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种语义RGB-Depth框架，利用显微立体视频进行手术技能评估。通过回归式深度融合生成稠密几何表征，并结合语义分解的RGB流与层级注意力架构。在33例经口喉显微手术上评估，技能分级F1达0.938，优于语义RGB（0.696）与语义深度（0.929）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于能力的培训和质量保证需要客观的显微外科技术技能评估。然而现有视频方法多依赖RGB图像，忽视了刻画器械-解剖交互的3D空间关系；立体手术显微镜虽提供深度信息，但传统立体匹配在高放大成像条件下深度估计稀疏且不可靠，限制了其在自动技能评估中的应用。

Method: 提出语义RGB-Depth框架：采用基于回归的深度融合方法，将稀疏度量立体深度与稠密单目深度估计融合，生成手术场景的稠密几何表征；将其与语义分解的RGB流（对应各手术器械与周围解剖）集成；再用层级注意力架构联合编码这些流，捕捉不同训练水平外科医生在器械使用和器械-解剖交互上的判别性模式。评估采用留一外科医生交叉验证。

Result: 在6名外科医生（含主刀医师与住院医师）完成的33例离体经口喉显微手术上评估：语义RGB-Depth模型技能分级F1为0.938，语义RGB为0.696，语义深度为0.929。学习到的空间、时间与语义注意力模式还支持对模型所关注场景区域、视频片段和语义流进行定性检查。

Conclusion: 几何信息能够提升基于显微立体视频的自动手术技能评估性能，且注意力模式提供了可解释性，有助于对模型决策进行定性分析。

Abstract: Objective assessment of microsurgical technical skill is essential for competency-based training and quality assurance, yet existing video-based approaches predominantly rely on RGB images and therefore overlook the 3D spatial relationships that characterize instrument-anatomy interactions. Although stereo operating microscopes provide complementary depth information, conventional stereo matching algorithms can produce sparse and unreliable depth estimates under high-magnification imaging conditions, limiting their use for automated skill assessment. This work presents a semantic RGB-Depth framework for surgical skill assessment from microscopic stereo videos. A regression-based depth fusion method combines sparse metric stereo depth with dense monocular depth estimates to generate a dense geometric representation of the surgical scene. This representation is integrated with semantically decomposed RGB streams corresponding to individual surgical instruments and surrounding anatomy. A hierarchical attention architecture jointly encodes these streams to capture discriminative patterns of instrument use and instrument-anatomy interaction across surgeons at different training levels. The framework was evaluated on 33 ex vivo transoral microlaryngeal procedures performed by six surgeons, comprising attending surgeons and surgical residents, using leave-one-surgeon-out cross-validation. The proposed semantic RGB-Depth model achieved an F1 score of 0.938 for skill-level classification, compared with 0.696 for semantic RGB and 0.929 for semantic depth. These results suggest that geometric information can improve automated surgical skill assessment from microscopic stereo videos. The learned spatial, temporal, and semantic attention patterns also support qualitative examination of the scene regions, video segments, and semantic streams emphasized by the model.

</details>


### [80] [Resolving Mixed Single-Photon LiDAR Returns for Foreground-View and Hidden Scene Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01206)
*Ziting Wen,Runrong Deng,Zili Zhang,Haitao Zheng,Yuecong Xu,Xiaoqiang Ren,Guodong Shi,Kemi Ding*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出状态感知框架，从被遮挡单光子直方图中重建前景与隐藏场景，并引入真实配对遮挡数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部分透射屏幕与防护罩在机器人巡检中常见，会从前景材料与后方场景产生混合LiDAR回波。传统峰值LiDAR丢弃弱隐藏回波，单光子LiDAR虽保留时域直方图，但现有瞬态重建方法通常用单一场景表示拟合波形；在遮挡下，弱或邻近的前景-隐藏回波可形成宽峰或弱肩，而这些波形也可由位移的单表面或厚密度分布解释，因此瞬态拟合准确并不代表几何正确。

Method: 提出状态感知框架，重建遮挡单光子直方图中的前景视图与隐藏场景。对每条光线估计局部回波证据，判别为无可靠表面证据、单回波证据或双回波；推断出的回波状态用于路由双头神经场的监督：所有光线约束波形重建，可靠锚点提供几何定位。同时构建固定位姿下含遮挡与干净采集的真实配对单光子LiDAR遮挡数据集。

Result: 在真实数据集上，隐藏场景深度与点云精度相较基线方法均有提升。

Conclusion: 结果表明，单光子分层重建是通过部分透射遮挡物实现3D感知的可行途径。

Abstract: Partially transmissive screens and protective covers are common in robotic inspection, but they create mixed LiDAR returns from both the foreground material and the scene behind it. Conventional peak-based LiDAR usually discards weak hidden returns, while single-photon LiDAR records time-resolved histograms that preserve attenuated and overlapping echoes. However, existing transient reconstruction methods typically fit a single scene representation to the measured waveform. Under occlusion, weak or nearby foreground--hidden echoes can form a broad peak or subtle shoulder. Because such waveforms can also be explained by a displaced single surface or a thick density distribution, accurate transient fitting does not necessarily imply correct geometry. We propose a state-aware framework for foreground-view and hidden scene reconstruction from occluded single-photon histograms. For each ray, we estimate local echo evidence, identifying no reliable surface evidence, single-return evidence, or two returns. The inferred echo state routes supervision for a two-head neural field: all rays constrain waveform reconstruction, while reliable anchors provide geometry localization. We also introduce a real paired single-photon LiDAR occlusion dataset with occluded and clean captures at fixed poses. Experiments on a real dataset show improved hidden scene depth and point-cloud accuracy over baselines. Our results demonstrate single-photon layered reconstruction as a practical route for 3D perception through partially transmissive occluders.

</details>


### [81] [EgoFound3R: End-to-End Egocentric Hand Reconstruction in World Space with Point-Wise Interaction Attributes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01210)
*Hongming Fu,Jingcheng Shi,Wenjia Wang,Binhua Zuo,Bo Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出EgoFound3R，一个统一的端到端模型，可在与场景共享的度量尺度下估计世界坐标系中的手部几何，并预测逐点的交互属性（可见性、接触、距离），同时显著提升精度与吞吐量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 第一人称（自我中心）视频是具身模型监督的主要来源，其价值在于恢复世界坐标系中的手部运动，但相机运动和手部遮挡使这一任务变得困难。现有重建流程通常将手部与场景估计分离，把交互属性留给单独的任务专用模型，且每个视频需调用多个模型，因此尚无先前的重建模型能同时估计这些属性，吞吐量也成为大规模标注的实际瓶颈。

Method: EgoFound3R整合三项设计：(i) 结构化手部提示，将预训练的几何先验迁移到世界空间手部重建；(ii) 显式手部表示，用于解码手部几何与交互属性；(iii) 共享参数的多速率设计，以降低推理成本。三者结合可在一次前向传播中预测手部几何与逐点属性。

Result: 在OakInk-v2、TACO和HOI4D数据集上，EgoFound3R相比先前方法的平均每关节位置误差（MPJPE）分别降低43.2%、22.4%和11.6%，并在同一次前向传播中于几何之外预测逐点接触与距离，同时吞吐量提升约6倍。

Conclusion: EgoFound3R是一个统一的端到端模型，将世界空间手部几何重建与逐点交互属性预测整合于单次推理，在多个数据集上同时实现更高的精度与吞吐量，为大规模第一人称视频标注提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Egocentric video has become a primary source of supervision for embodied models, and its value rests on recovering hand motion in world coordinates, which camera motion and hand occlusion make difficult. Existing reconstruction pipelines typically separate hand and scene estimation, leave interaction attributes to separate task-specific models, and invoke several models per video, so no prior reconstruction model estimates these attributes and throughput becomes a practical constraint on large-scale annotation. We therefore introduce EgoFound3R, a unified end-to-end model that estimates world-space hand geometry in a metric scale shared with the scene, and predicts point-wise interaction attributes, including visibility, contact, and distance. The model integrates three designs: (i) structured hand prompts that transfer pretrained geometric priors to world-space hand reconstruction; (ii) an explicit hand representation that decodes hand geometry and interaction attributes; and (iii) a shared-parameter multi-rate design that lowers inference cost. Together, these designs predict hand geometry and point-wise attributes in one pass. On OakInk-v2, TACO, and HOI4D, EgoFound3R reduces the mean per-joint position error (MPJPE) by 43.2%, 22.4%, and 11.6% over previous methods and predicts point-wise contact and distance alongside the geometry in the same pass, while attaining approximately 6x higher throughput.

</details>


### [82] [AutoGUIWorld: Image Generators as Visual World Models for GUI Agent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01215)
*Cheng Yang,Yifan Wu,Yutao Huang,Zhaohua Zhang,Beiduo Chen,Muxi Chen,Chenchen Zhao,Hexuan Deng,Haolin Yang,Geyuan Zhu,Sa Zhu,Jianhuan Zhuo,Qiuyong Xiao,Jianhao Ruan,Yiran Peng,Jiayi Zhang,Tian Ye,Xinlei Yu,Tianwen Jiang,Jihong Zhang,Yuyu Luo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AutoGUIWorld 是一个无需部署真实软件即可合成 GUI 交互轨迹的数据生成框架，通过图像生成器的视觉先验与规划器的任务知识，产出跨 Ubuntu、Windows、macOS、Chrome 的 79,266 条带空间标注的步级训练样本，并显著提升 GUI 智能体在 OSWorld 与 ScienceBoard 上的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高质量交互轨迹对 GUI 智能体学习环境响应、状态维护与多步工作流至关重要，但轨迹多样性受限于底层环境可访问的应用、界面状态与工作流。扩展覆盖面意味着部署更复杂多样的软件，而专用应用带来额外的安装、配置与运行成本，因此需要一种无需真实运行软件即可生成多样化轨迹的方法。

Method: AutoGUIWorld 将图像生成器的视觉先验与规划器的任务知识结合，在不部署或运行对应软件环境的情况下合成 GUI 交互轨迹。它从操作系统上下文、视觉外观与界面状态的结构化规格中采样初始 GUI 场景，并基于这些场景生成任务；随后由规划器指定原子动作及其预期视觉后果，图像生成器迭代编辑当前截图以产生后续观测；最后通过动作接地（action grounding）与转移级质量过滤获得训练数据。

Result: 最终产出 79,266 条带空间标注的步级训练样本，覆盖 Ubuntu、Windows、macOS 与 Chrome。在 AutoGUIWorld 轨迹上微调 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 后，OSWorld 平均任务得分由 33.0% 提升至 40.8%，ScienceBoard 任务成功率由 14.0% 提升至 32.2%。

Conclusion: 结果表明，合成轨迹能够提升 GUI 智能体在真实桌面任务与科学任务上的性能，验证了在不部署实际软件环境的前提下生成高多样性 GUI 交互轨迹的可行性。

Abstract: GUI agents require high-quality interaction trajectories to learn how software environments respond to actions, maintain state, and support multi-step workflows. However, the diversity of available trajectories is constrained by the applications, interface states, and workflows accessible in the underlying environments. Expanding this coverage requires deploying increasingly diverse and complex software, with specialized applications imposing additional installation, configuration, and runtime costs. We introduce AutoGUIWorld, a data generation framework that combines the visual priors of image generators with the task knowledge of a planner to synthesize GUI interaction trajectories without deploying or running the corresponding software environments. AutoGUIWorld samples initial GUI scenes from structured specifications of operating-system context, visual appearance, and interface state, and generates tasks conditioned on those scenes. A planner then specifies atomic actions and their intended visual consequences, while an image generator iteratively edits the current screenshot to produce subsequent observations. Action grounding and transition-level quality filtering yield 79,266 spatially annotated step-level training samples across Ubuntu, Windows, macOS, and Chrome. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on AutoGUIWorld trajectories improves the mean task score on OSWorld from 33.0% to 40.8% and the task success rate on ScienceBoard from 14.0% to 32.2%. These results show that generated trajectories improve GUI-agent performance on real desktop and scientific tasks.

</details>


### [83] [A Compact Explicit 4D Representation for Dynamic Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01229)
*Di Yang,Zhihao Li,Yanhai Xiong,Yufei Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Sparc4D 是一种前馈自编码器，将已知相机的单目视频编码为稀疏 4D 场景状态，用共享静态特征、时序槽压缩动态特征，并用稀疏解码器输出 2D 高斯面元，实现紧凑且可渲染的动态场景表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 紧凑的动态场景表示需同时保留随时间可见的表面和用于新视角渲染的外观，现有方法在压缩效率与重建质量之间难以兼顾。

Method: Sparc4D 将单目视频编码为稀疏 4D 状态：静态特征跨片段共享，空间锚定的时序槽压缩时变特征；稀疏解码器产生 2D 高斯面元，并通过几何重投影用存储的源像素保留细纹理。状态包含一帧完整源帧、每四帧采样的动态区域像素，以及学习特征和稀疏占用。

Result: 在 32 帧 MultiCamVideo 片段上，随机窗口平均 0.95M 个 32 位等效值，first-32 协议为 0.92M；first-32 下 PSNR 达 21.70 dB，优于 MoVieS 的 20.40 dB，随机窗口下二者 PSNR 相当。关闭存储纹理后，时序槽将时变特征状态中位数压缩 4.0 倍，均值状态从 1.04M 降至 0.42M，目标视角重建质量基本不变。无需真实数据微调即可迁移到 DyCheck 和 Neu3D，存储纹理提升 LPIPS，但略微降低 PSNR。

Conclusion: Sparc4D 通过稀疏 4D 状态与存储纹理的协同设计，在保持紧凑表示的同时取得有竞争力的重建质量，并具备跨数据集的迁移能力。

Abstract: A compact dynamic-scene representation must retain both the surfaces seen over time and the appearance needed to render them from new viewpoints. We present Sparc4D, a feed-forward autoencoder that encodes a monocular video with known cameras into a sparse 4D scene state. Static features are shared across the clip, while spatially anchored temporal slots compress time-varying features. A sparse decoder produces 2D Gaussian surfels, while stored source pixels preserve fine texture through geometric re-projection. The state includes one full source frame and dynamic-region pixels sampled every fourth frame, alongside learned features and sparse occupancy. For a 32-frame MultiCamVideo clip, it averages 0.95M 32-bit-equivalent values on random windows and 0.92M on the first-32 protocol. On first-32, Sparc4D reaches 21.70\,dB, compared with 20.40\,dB for MoVieS. On randomly placed windows, their PSNR scores are comparable. With stored texture disabled, temporal slots compress the time-varying feature state by a median $4.0\times$ and reduce the mean state from 1.04M to 0.42M values, with essentially unchanged target-view reconstruction quality. Without fine-tuning on real data, Sparc4D transfers to DyCheck and Neu3D, where stored texture improves LPIPS while slightly reducing PSNR.

</details>


### [84] [Flow Matching Reinforcement for 3D Mesh Generation via Dynamic Homing Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01233)
*Zhen Zhou,Zhiwei Ning,Puhua Jiang,Sheng Zhang,Yifei Tang,Jie Yang,Xintong Han,Wei Liu,Chunchao Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文提出前向过程强化学习方法 Dynamic Homing Optimization（DHO），将负轨迹优化重构为受正样本吸引的动态归航，并构建图像到3D几何生成框架 Flow3D-Pro。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有用于3D生成的流匹配强化学习方法多沿用2D视觉生成的DPO、GRPO、NFT等目标，对负轨迹仅使预测速度偏离原方向，未显式指定朝向偏好样本的目标速度场；受预训练模型能力、rollout多样性与奖励分布复杂性限制，直接套用这些方法在几何质量上收益有限。

Method: DHO将负轨迹优化转化为正样本吸引引导的动态归航。其中，Minimum-Cost Attractive Matching（MAM）为每个负样本分配不同的正目标；Time-Aware Dynamic Correction（TDC）利用剩余时间感知的校正速度将轨迹重定向至该目标。在异步在线DHO基础上构建 Flow3D-Pro 图像到3D几何生成框架。

Result: 实验表明，DHO在3D生成中优于代表性的DPO、GRPO与NFT风格目标；Flow3D-Pro生成的3D几何质量优于现有网格生成方法。

Conclusion: 将负轨迹优化显式建模为朝向正样本的动态归航，可弥补2D强化学习目标直接迁移至3D生成的不足，DHO与Flow3D-Pro在几何生成质量上取得更优表现。

Abstract: Flow matching is central to 3D generation, yet in practice its reinforcement learning (RL) methods are largely adapted from 2D visual generation. Representative DPO-, GRPO-, and NFT-style objectives, when applied to negative trajectories, mainly steer predicted velocities away from the corresponding directions without explicitly specifying a target velocity field toward preferred samples. In 3D generation, constrained by pretrained model capabilities, rollout diversity, and reward-distribution complexity, directly applying these RL methods yields limited gains in geometric quality. We introduce a forward-process RL method \textbf{Dynamic Homing Optimization (DHO)}, which reformulates negative-trajectory optimization as positive-sample attraction-guided dynamic homing. Specifically, Minimum-Cost Attractive Matching (MAM) assigns each negative sample a distinct positive target, and Time-Aware Dynamic Correction (TDC) then redirects its trajectory toward the target using a remaining-time-aware corrective velocity. Building on asynchronous online DHO, we develop \textbf{Flow3D-Pro}, an image-to-3D geometry generation framework. Experiments show that DHO outperforms representative DPO-, GRPO-, and NFT-style objectives in 3D generation, while Flow3D-Pro produces higher-quality 3D geometry than existing mesh generation methods.

</details>


### [85] [When the Judge Acts: Auditing VLM-Guided Image Selection on Culturally Situated Prompts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01243)
*Huichan Seo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文将视觉语言模型（VLM）作为"评审器"进行决策者视角的审计，而非仅验证其评分与人类评分的一致性。在300个文化情境化提示上，比较VLM所选图像与人类评分及随机选择，并通过重排候选图像测试位置偏差。4B评审器几乎不优于随机且低于CLIP基线，表现出强烈的首位偏好；重排一致性对该评审器的筛选是有效的，对8B评审器则相反。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM日益充当图像生成结果的评审者，其选择直接决定用户所见内容。然而当前验证方式主要依赖评审器评分与人类评分的一致性，而非其实际返回的图像，因此无法揭示评审器作为决策者时的真实表现与偏差。

Method: 在300个文化情境化提示上，将VLM评审器返回的图像与（其看不到的）人类评分及同候选集中的随机选择进行比较；对每个决策重复进行候选图像重排实验，以测量位置偏差与顺序一致性。同时对比4B与8B参数规模的评审器，并引入CLIP相似度基线与较弱的第二评审器作为对照。

Result: 4B评审器仅略优于随机，且不如CLIP相似度基线；49%的调用选择首个图像（随机为28%），重排后60%的提示选择发生改变。对该评审器，跨顺序一致性具有信息量：经重排仍保留的决策显著优于随机，而与较弱第二评审器保持一致的决策则保留错误。8B评审器几乎无位置偏差且优于CLIP，但同样的筛选对其反而丢弃了多数正确决策。4B评审器在刻板印象评分上的轻微上升，在跨顺序聚合或使用更大评审器后不再可检测。

Conclusion: 一致性筛选仅在针对评审器的具体失效模式时才有效，因此每当评审器更换，过滤器都必须重新审计。评估VLM评审器应关注其作为决策者的实际输出与位置偏差，而非仅看评分一致性。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly act as judges that pick the best of several generated images, so their choices decide what users see. Such judges are usually validated by score agreement with human ratings, not by the images they return. We audit VLM judges as decision-makers: on 300 culturally situated prompts, we compare the returned image with human ratings the judge never sees and with random choice from the same candidates, and repeat every decision with the candidates reordered. A 4B-parameter judge barely beats random and falls short of a CLIP similarity baseline. It picks the first image shown in 49% of calls (chance: 28%), and reordering changes its choice on 60% of prompts. For this judge, agreement across orders is informative: decisions that survive reordering are much better than random, whereas agreement with a weaker second judge keeps the wrong ones. An 8B judge shows almost no position bias and outperforms CLIP, yet for it the same filter mostly discards good decisions. Agreement helps only when it targets the judge's failure mode, so filters must be re-audited whenever the judge changes. The 4B judge's slight rise in stereotype ratings is no longer detectable after aggregating across orders or with the larger judge.

</details>


### [86] [PickMoment: Continuous-Time Single-Image-to-Video via Learning Deblurring and Blur-to-Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01279)
*Junseong Shin,Hyeonsu Jo,Daehyun Kim,Tae Hyun Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PickMoment将单图去模糊重新表述为连续时间学习：用单一确定性模型直接学习曝光区间任意子区间上的均值模糊，并通过三项监督训练，统一了单图去模糊、模糊到视频生成与连续时间任意时刻恢复三类任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于学习的去模糊方法回避了运动模糊的物理成因（连续清晰信号在有限曝光窗口上的时间积分），仅预测清晰信号本身：单图去模糊通常只恢复曝光中心的一帧，模糊到视频方法则预测固定数量的帧，无法灵活地在曝光区间内任意时刻取帧。因此需要一种贴合物理模糊模型的连续时间表述，用同一个模型支持任意子区间的查询。

Method: 提出PickMoment，类比MeanFlow的平均速度表述，把曝光区间任意子区间的区间均值模糊作为学习目标，用单一确定性模型建模。训练使用由模糊积分导出的三项监督：(1) 基于可用子帧的经验重建损失；(2) 强制重叠子区间自洽的加性损失；(3) 锚定于零区间极限的清晰帧损失。推理时无需迭代采样，单次前向即可完成，且无需为不同任务分别训练。

Result: 在GoPro与HIDE上，PickMoment在生成式去模糊方法中达到最先进性能，并在RealBlur上与复原类方法相比具有竞争力；在GoPro-7模糊到视频任务上取得最高的逐帧保真度，且全部为单次前向、无迭代采样。

Conclusion: 通过连续时间与区间均值的物理化重表述，单一模型即可统一单图去模糊、模糊到视频生成与连续时间任意时刻恢复，避免任务专属训练与迭代采样，验证了该表述在精度与效率上的优势。

Abstract: Motion blur arises from the temporal integration of a continuous sharp signal over a finite exposure window, yet existing learning-based methods sidestep this physical model and predict only the sharp signal itself: most single-image deblurring methods recover a single frame at the exposure center, while blur-to-video methods predict a fixed set of frames. We introduce PickMoment, a continuous-time reformulation that directly learns the interval-mean blur over arbitrary sub-intervals of the exposure with a single deterministic model. Drawing an analogy to MeanFlow's average-velocity formulation, we train the model with three supervisions derived from the blur integral: an empirical reconstruction loss from available subframes, an additivity loss that enforces self-consistency across overlapping sub-intervals, and a sharp-frame loss anchored at the zero-interval limit. A single trained model unifies single-image deblurring, blur-to-video generation, and continuous-time pick-a-moment recovery as different queries to the same network, with no separate training for each task. Our PickMoment achieves state-of-the-art performance among generative-based deblurring methods on GoPro and HIDE while competitive against restoration-based methods on RealBlur, and the highest per-frame fidelity on GoPro-7 blur-to-video, all in a single forward pass without iterative sampling.

</details>


### [87] [ShelfChange3D: Object-Level 3D Change Detection for Retail Shelf Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01283)
*Lingyi Zhou,Yunke Wang,Mengyu Zheng,Wenbo Wang,Zijian Wang,Chang Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出"货架监测"的新任务形式——对象级3D变化检测，构建了ShelfChange3D数据集（145K合成+5K真实配对RGB-D观测），并提出端到端框架ChangeBox，联合推理配对观测并预测对象级3D变化框，结合基于几何的细化阶段提升定位精度，性能优于现有变化检测基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有缺货检测方法主要在图像空间中操作，缺乏面向下游机器人系统的度量3D定位能力。可靠的货架监测是零售自动化的重要能力，因此需要将货架监测重新定义为对象级3D变化检测任务，以同时识别变化商品并给出3D包围盒定位。

Method: 1）任务形式化：给定不同时刻的两组RGB-D观测，识别发生变化的商品并以3D包围盒定位每个变化。2）数据集：构建ShelfChange3D，包含145K合成与5K真实世界配对RGB-D观测，并带对象级3D变化标注。3）模型：提出ChangeBox端到端框架，联合推理配对观测并预测对象级3D变化框。4）几何细化：引入基于几何的细化阶段，利用深度与重力先验估计相对位姿并精修预测框。

Result: 实验表明，ChangeBox在性能上优于现有变化检测基线；几何细化阶段带来进一步提升；从合成数据到真实世界观测的迁移有效。

Conclusion: 该工作将货架监测建模为对象级3D变化检测，通过新数据集ShelfChange3D与端到端框架ChangeBox（含几何细化）实现了优于基线的3D变化定位性能，并验证了合成到真实的迁移有效性，为零售自动化中的机器人下游任务提供了度量3D定位支持。

Abstract: Reliable shelf monitoring is an important capability for retail automation, yet existing out-of-stock detection methods mainly operate in image space and lack metric 3D localization for downstream robotic systems. We formulate shelf monitoring as object-level 3D change detection: given two RGB-D observations captured at different times, the goal is to identify changed products and localize each change with a 3D bounding box. To support this task, we introduce ShelfChange3D, comprising 145K synthetic and 5K real-world paired RGB-D observations with object-level 3D change annotations. We further propose ChangeBox, an end-to-end framework that jointly reasons over paired observations and predicts object-level 3D change boxes. To improve localization accuracy, we introduce a geometry-based refinement stage that exploits depth and gravity prior to estimate relative pose and refine predicted boxes. Experiments show that ChangeBox outperforms existing change detection baselines, with further gains from refinement and effective transfer from synthetic to real-world observations.

</details>


### [88] [Dyna3: VLM-Guided Training-Free 4D Reconstruction via Depth Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01286)
*Xinhao Xiang,Weiyang Li,Zhijie Zheng,Abhijeet Rastogi,Jiawei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Dyna3是一个免训练的4D动态场景重建框架，无需微调即可将深度基础模型DA3扩展到动态环境，性能与效率均显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度基础模型（如DA3）虽在多视图深度估计上表现优异，但假设场景为静态3D，难以适用于真实动态环境。而现有免训练4D方法（如Easi3R、VGGT4D）依赖对应关系训练的骨干网络，其注意力机制编码了跨帧匹配信息，而仅训练深度的DA3不具备该特性，因此无法直接沿用。

Method: 提出免训练框架Dyna3。核心洞见：DA3的跨视图特征虽仅训练用于深度一致性，但结合跨帧最佳匹配特征搜索后，隐式编码了运动判别信号——静态表面能全局一致匹配，动态物体则不能。进一步引入视觉语言模型（VLM）自动生成场景特定语义提示，驱动SAM 3实现实例级分割，区分"哪些物体在动"与"存在哪些物体"。重建时将场景解耦为跨帧对齐的静态背景与逐帧动态点云。

Result: 在四个数据集上验证：动态物体分割方面以+5.5pp J-Mean超越最先进的VGGT4D（及对应关系训练方法）；位姿估计提速最高13倍，4D重建提速3倍，内存降低4至8倍。

Conclusion: Dyna3证明仅训练深度的基础模型可通过特征匹配隐式获取运动信号，实现免训练4D重建并全面超越对应关系训练方法，其高效性可支持此前方法难以承受的更密集时间采样。

Abstract: Recent depth foundation models like Depth Anything 3 (DA3) achieve remarkable multi-view depth estimation but assume static 3D scenes, limiting their applicability to real-world dynamic environments. Existing training-free 4D methods like Easi3R and VGGT4D rely on correspondence-trained backbones whose attention encodes cross-frame matching, a property absent in depth-only models like DA3. We present Dyna3, a training-free framework that extends DA3 for 4D dynamic scene reconstruction without any fine-tuning. Our key insight is that DA3's cross-view features, though trained only for depth consistency, implicitly encode motion-discriminative signals when combined with best-match feature search across frames. Its static surfaces find consistent matches globally, while dynamic objects cannot. We further adopt vision-language models (VLM) to automatically generate scene-specific semantic prompts for SAM 3, enabling precise instance-level segmentation that distinguishes which objects move from what objects exist. For reconstruction, we decouple the scene into a cross-frame aligned static background and per-frame dynamic point clouds. Experiments on four datasets demonstrate that Dyna3 surpasses correspondence-trained methods with +5.5pp J-Mean over state-of-the-art VGGT4D on dynamic object segmentation, while achieving up to 13x faster pose estimation and 3x faster 4D reconstruction with 4 to 8x lower memory. Dyna3 could therefore enable much denser temporal sampling that prior methods cannot support.

</details>


### [89] [ODDR: One-Step Deshadow Diffusion via Reward Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01291)
*Junseong Shin,Kijun Kim,Minseong Kim,Dongjin Kim,Tae Hyun Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ODDR框架，用奖励引导的单步扩散模型实现无需真实配对监督的高效去阴影，缩小合成到真实的域差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有去阴影方法大多依赖真实世界配对数据集，采集成本高、场景多样性有限，导致泛化能力受限。

Method: 先用合成阴影数据训练单步去阴影扩散基线模型ODD，实现高效一步生成无阴影图像；再引入ShadowReward——首个完全无需人工标注的奖励模型，通过对受控退化（纹理失真、边界伪影等）的合成图像排序来模仿人类感知判断；以此奖励指导微调ODD得到ODDR，弥合合成到真实的域差距。

Result: 实验表明ODD在不依赖真实配对监督下已具强劲性能，ODDR进一步提升，与基于真实配对数据全监督方法差距缩小，同时作为单步模型保持更高计算效率。

Conclusion: ODDR以无真实配对监督、单步高效的方式实现高保真去阴影，验证了无标注奖励模型引导扩散模型缩小合成到真实域差距的可行性。

Abstract: Recent advances in deep learning for shadow removal have significantly enhanced image quality and realism. However, most approaches rely on real-world paired datasets, which are costly to collect and often limited in scene diversity, leading to limited generalization. To address these limitations, we propose One-step Deshadow Diffusion via Reward guidance (ODDR), a new framework that achieves efficient and high-fidelity shadow removal without relying on real-world paired supervision. Our method begins with One-step Deshadow Diffusion (ODD), a baseline model trained on synthetic shadow data for efficient one-step shadow-free reconstruction. We further adapt ODD into ODDR using ShadowReward. In contrast to traditional, annotation-heavy approaches, ShadowReward is the first reward model for shadow removal trained entirely without human annotation. It learns to mimic human perceptual judgments by ranking synthetically generated images with controlled degradations, such as texture distortion and boundary artifacts. This reward-guided fine-tuning enables ODDR to close the synthetic-to-real domain gap. Extensive experiments show that ODD achieves strong performance without relying on real-world paired supervision, and ODDR further improves the results, narrowing the gap to fully supervised methods trained on real-world paired data while maintaining higher computational efficiency as a single-step model.

</details>


### [90] [STAGE: Subspace-Targeted Affine Generative Erasure for Text-to-3D Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01302)
*Karol Dziekan,Przemysław Spurek,Dawid Malarz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: STAGE：面向原生文本到3D生成的阶段感知概念擦除框架


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有闭式概念擦除方法针对2D图像扩散设计，假设单一生成通路，一次编辑需同时覆盖几何与纹理；原生3D生成器直接合成结构化3D表示，违反该假设，因此需要阶段感知的擦除策略。

Method: 提出STAGE，一种免训练、闭式框架。将每个编辑限制在擦除嵌入与锚嵌入之差张成的低维子空间内，并把先前编辑器的保范（正交）约束松弛为最小二乘仿射校正，将目标激活映射到安全锚点，同时对保留提示的位移施加惩罚；校正可作用于结构阶段、外观阶段或两者。

Result: 在TRELLIS上针对15个形状、材质与对象概念，STAGE在兼顾遗忘目标概念与保留其他内容的综合得分（聚合基于CLIP的语义与物理指标）上达到66.7，最强适配基线为53.2。

Conclusion: 编辑必须到达的阶段由概念类型决定：形状与对象概念需在结构阶段擦除，材质概念需在外观阶段擦除。

Abstract: Concept erasure suppresses a target concept while preserving behavior on unrelated inputs. Existing closed-form methods were designed for 2D image diffusion and assume a single generative pathway, so one edit must cover geometry and texture at once. Native 3D generators, which synthesize structured 3D representations directly rather than by lifting 2D samples, violate this assumption. We show that shape and object concepts must be erased in the structural stage of the pipeline and material concepts in the appearance stage. We therefore formulate erasure in native text-to-3D as a stage-aware editing problem and introduce STAGE, a training-free, closed-form framework. STAGE confines each edit to the low-dimensional subspace spanned by the differences between erase and anchor embeddings, and relaxes the norm-preserving (orthogonal) constraint of prior editors into a least-squares affine correction that maps target activations onto safe anchors subject to a penalty on the displacement of retained prompts. The correction applies to the structural stage, the appearance stage, or both. We find that the stage an edit must reach is determined by concept type. On TRELLIS, the standard open native 3D generator, across 15 shape, material, and object concepts, STAGE reaches 66.7 on a composite score that balances forgetting the target concept against preserving everything else, aggregating CLIP-based semantic and physical metrics, versus 53.2 for the strongest adapted baseline.
  Code: https://github.com/gmum/STAGE/
  Project Page https://gmum.github.io/STAGE/

</details>


### [91] [ARROW: Arbitrary Reconstruction and Tracking of 4D Observations in the Wild](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01314)
*Ilya Fradlin,Christian Schmidt,Jens Piekenbrinck,Karim Knaebel,Gonzalo Martin Garcia,Bastian Leibe*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ARROW是一个前馈模型，统一了任意图像集合的3D重建与3D点跟踪，核心是顺序不变的查询机制，在多个基准上取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态场景可由运动相机、多视频流或不同时刻拍摄的图像捕获，这些观测揭示了场景几何与运动的互补信息，但整合它们需要跨视点、跨拍摄时间和可见性变化建立对应关系，现有方法难以统一处理。

Method: 提出ARROW前馈模型，采用新颖的顺序不变（order-invariant）查询方法，使查询能与任意输入中的观测进行关联；训练时让模型接触更多样化的输入集合，以提升任务性能并获得泛化能力，支持多视图跟踪等更广泛任务。

Result: 在WorldTrack和TAPVid-3D上建立3D跟踪新最优；在适配的RGB-only MVTracker基准上超越专用多视图跟踪器，同时在多个3D重建任务上保持竞争力。

Conclusion: ARROW通过统一的前馈框架与顺序不变查询，实现了任意图像集合下的3D重建与点跟踪，并具备向多视图跟踪等任务泛化的能力，代码与权重已公开。

Abstract: Dynamic scenes may be captured by a moving camera, multiple video streams, or images taken at different times. These observations reveal complementary aspects of scene geometry and motion, yet bringing them together requires establishing correspondence across viewpoints, capture times, and visibility changes. We introduce ARROW, a feed-forward model that unifies 3D reconstruction and 3D point tracking from arbitrary image sets. At its core is a novel order-invariant querying approach, which allows the association of queries with observations across arbitrary inputs. We show that exposing the model to more diverse sets of inputs during training results in improved task performance. Moreover, the resulting model is capable of generalization to a wider range of tasks including multi-view tracking. Trained with this strategy, ARROW establishes a new state of the art in 3D tracking on WorldTrack and TAPVid-3D and outperforms dedicated multi-view trackers on an adapted RGB-only MVTracker benchmark, while remaining competitive across 3D reconstruction tasks. Code and weights are publicly available.

</details>


### [92] [CLASP: Continual Low-rank Adapters for Spatially Placed Concepts from One Hypernetwork](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01331)
*Wojciech Gromski,Patryk Krukowski,Jan Miksa,Maciej Zieba,Przemysław Spurek*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种无回放、单固定规模超网络的持续个性化方法，用于冻结扩散模型，参数量不随概念数增长，并集成空间控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本到图像扩散模型的持续个性化需在顺序学习新概念的同时保留旧概念。现有方法要么存在灾难性遗忘，要么依赖存储额外的概念专属参数与空间组件，导致参数规模随概念流增长，难以扩展到长序列的个性化任务。

Method: 采用无回放（rehearsal-free）框架，使用单个固定规模的超网络对冻结的扩散模型进行持续个性化。超网络动态生成个性化所需的概念专属适配，而非随新概念扩展模型，从而在获取新概念时保留旧概念。框架进一步将空间控制整合进个性化过程，使用户可指定个性化概念的出现位置，且不引入额外的逐概念组件。

Result: 实验表明，方法对已学概念具有较强保留能力，并实现可靠的空间定位；在性能上匹配或优于现有方法，同时能有效扩展到长序列个性化任务。

Conclusion: 除紧凑的概念表示外，参数量与所学概念数量无关，实现可扩展的持续个性化，兼顾概念保留与空间可控性。

Abstract: Continual personalization of text-to-image diffusion models requires sequentially acquiring new concepts while retaining previously learned ones. However, existing methods either suffer from catastrophic forgetting or rely on storing additional concept-specific parameters and spatial components, causing their parameter footprint to grow with the concept stream. This limits their ability to scale to long sequences of personalization tasks. We propose a rehearsal-free approach that uses a single fixed-size hypernetwork to continually personalize a frozen diffusion model. Instead of expanding the model as new concepts are acquired, the hypernetwork dynamically produces the concept-specific adaptations required for personalization while preserving previously learned concepts. Our framework further integrates spatial control into the personalization process, allowing users to specify where a personalized concept should appear without introducing additional per-concept components. This formulation enables continual personalization with a parameter footprint that remains independent of the number of learned concepts, aside from compact concept representations. Experiments demonstrate strong retention of previously learned concepts and reliable spatial grounding, matching or improving upon existing methods while scaling effectively to long streams of personalization tasks.

</details>


### [93] [MMVistaReason: Toward Open-Data and Post-Training Recipes for Multimodal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01352)
*Juekai Lin,Honglin Lin,Yuqian Yuan,Xiaolong Wu,Jie Cao,Liang Liang,Yunqi Cao,Yun Zhu,Wenqiao Zhang,Lijun Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MMVistaReason（MVR）是一套开放数据的多模态推理后训练方案，涵盖更广的能力覆盖、高效的SFT/RL数据构建与"先专精后整合"训练策略，在15个多模态基准上以更少样本量超越多个更大规模或专用模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放多模态推理模型虽受益于大规模推理监督，但后训练面临数据质量参差、监督构建低效、难度不均衡与跨域干扰等问题，亟需可靠的后训练方案。

Method: 由三部分组成：(1) 覆盖Analytical与Real-World两个互补推理组，强调结构化推理与视觉感知、空间定位的能力广度；(2) 高效数据构建，通过分阶段清洗与标注标准化异构开放数据，采用难度感知级联教师蒸馏与基于答案似然的轨迹筛选构建MVR-SFT-528K，并用规模特定前沿过滤构建MVR-RL-63K；(3) 先专精后整合训练，训练互补RL专家并用多教师同策略蒸馏（MOPD）整合能力。

Result: 揭示了监督难度、轨迹质量与模型容量间的容量依赖交互：小学生更受益于精选监督，大学生对轨迹变化与混合域干扰更鲁棒；混合域RL带来基准级负迁移，而MOPD实现一致的能力整合，最优KL方向随模型规模变化。15个基准上MVR-4B均分72.8，超过Qwen3.5-9B(Instruct)与MMFineReason-8B且样本少约70%；扩至9B均分74.4，超过Qwen3.5-35B-A3B(Instruct)。

Conclusion: MMVistaReason表明，系统化的开放数据构建与容量感知的后训练为可靠多模态推理提供了一条实用且可扩展的路径。

Abstract: Open multimodal reasoning models have benefited from large-scale reasoning supervision, yet reliable post-training remains challenging due to uneven data quality, inefficient supervision construction, imbalanced difficulty, and cross-domain interference. We introduce MMVistaReason (MVR), an open-data post-training recipe with three components: (1) broader capability coverage across complementary Analytical and Real-World reasoning groups, emphasizing structured reasoning versus visual perception and spatial grounding; (2) efficient SFT and RL data construction, standardizing heterogeneous open data through staged cleaning and annotation, combining difficulty-aware cascaded teacher distillation with answer-likelihood-based trajectory selection to construct MVR-SFT-528K, and applying scale-specific frontier filtering for MVR-RL-63K; and (3) specialize-then-integrate training, which trains complementary RL experts and consolidates their capabilities through multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). Our analyses reveal a capacity-dependent interaction between supervision difficulty, trajectory quality, and model capacity: smaller students benefit more from selected supervision, while larger students are robust to trajectory variation and mixed-domain interference. Mixed-domain RL introduces benchmark-level negative transfer, whereas MOPD provides consistent capability integration, with the preferred KL direction varying across model scales. Across 15 multimodal benchmarks, MVR-4B achieves an average score of 72.8, outperforming Qwen3.5-9B (Instruct) and MMFineReason-8B while using about 70% fewer samples than MMFineReason. Scaling to 9B improves the average to 74.4, surpassing Qwen3.5-35B-A3B (Instruct). Overall, MMVistaReason demonstrates that systematic open-data construction and capacity-aware post-training provide a practical and scalable path toward reliable multimodal reasoning.

</details>


### [94] [Supervising Sound Localization by In-the-wild Egomotion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01388)
*Anna Min,Ziyang Chen,Hang Zhao,Andrew Owens*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出以自运动(egomotion)作为监督信号的双耳声源定位学习方法，并构建真实音频-视觉数据集加以验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实场景中声源定位缺乏大规模标注数据，而监督信号获取成本高；作者希望利用视频中相机运动导致的声源方位变化这一自然线索，作为廉价且大量可得的弱监督。

Method: 将视频中相机朝向声源的方位随相机运动而变化这一特性作为监督信号：先用多视图几何的传统方法从视觉估计相机运动，再训练音频模型预测与视觉估计一致的声源方向；并将该弱监督与传统双耳线索相结合。同时提出包含真实世界音频-视觉视频及其自运动信息的数据集用于评测。

Result: 模型能够从真实世界数据中成功学习，并在声源定位任务上表现良好。

Conclusion: 以自运动为监督信号是一种可行且有效的双耳声源定位学习范式，可缓解标注瓶颈，并在真实数据上取得良好定位性能。

Abstract: We present a method for learning binaural sound localization using egomotion as a supervisory signal.
