One epoch of GSPO on a rank-32 LoRA adapter improves pass@1 on each of the six external benchmarks we evaluated, across three agent harnesses: SWE-Bench Pro (60.1 to 64.8), DeepSWE (31.0 to 43.4), Terminal-Bench 2.1 (67.4 to 82.0), Terminal-Bench 3 (1.4 to 12.1), Terminal-Bench 4 (0.0 to 7.6), and SWE-Marathon (5.0 to 25.0). Pooled over the five independent task sets (Terminal-Bench 4 revises Terminal-Bench 3), the improvement is significant (p < 0.001), and it remains significant on the three sets released after the training data was collected (p = 0.004); the model also improves under both harnesses never used in training. Median trajectories on DeepSWE and Terminal-Bench 3 are 24-35% shorter in agent steps. The base model's failed DeepSWE runs are mostly near-misses, and on the tasks the trained model newly solves, paired trajectories show it avoiding each of the four failure modes above.

</details>


### [404] [Clock Diffusion: Efficient Semi-Autoregressive Continuous Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00894)
*Yair Schiff,Omer Belhasin,Roy Uziel,Matan Rusanovsky,Ran Zilberstein,Marianne Arriola,Gilad Turok,Guanghan Wang,Volodymyr Kuleshov,Michael Elad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Clock Diffusion 框架，通过位置相关的噪声调度实现半自回归连续扩散语言模型（ClockDLM），支持变长生成与 KV 缓存，并在 OpenWebText 与 GSM8K 上达到领先的扩散似然与生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续扩散模型在离散数据上已能与离散扩散模型性能相当，但存在两大实用缺陷：缺乏变长生成能力与键值（KV）缓存支持，且整体质量仍落后于自回归模型和前沿离散扩散模型。论文旨在弥补这些不足。

Method: 引入一种模型参数化方式，使用位置相关的噪声调度来定义半自回归（SAR）连续扩散语言模型；配合高效训练与采样算法，构成 Clock Diffusion 框架，并给出块生成与滑动窗口生成两种特例。基于滑动窗口 Clock Diffusion 构建高斯扩散模型族 ClockDLM。进一步提出 Cache Grab 采样器，借鉴离散扩散加速推理技术，如对超过置信阈值的 token 进行提交（committing）以及自推测解码（self-speculative decoding）。

Result: ClockDLM 在 OpenWebText 上取得当前最优的扩散似然界，超过性能优异的块式 SAR 离散扩散模型；在 TinyGSM 上训练后在 GSM8K 基准上显著优于连续扩散基线，并达到或超过可比的 SAR 离散扩散模型；Cache Grab 采样器进一步提升了模型质量与推理效率。

Conclusion: 位置相关噪声调度驱动的半自回归连续扩散框架 Clock Diffusion，成功为连续扩散语言模型补齐变长生成与 KV 缓存能力，并通过 ClockDLM 与 Cache Grab 在似然、下游任务质量与推理效率上取得领先，缩小了与自回归及离散扩散前沿的差距。

Abstract: Recent works on continuous diffusion for discrete data have demonstrated performance on par with comparable discrete diffusion models. However, these continuous counterparts lack key features that are essential to practical use as language models, namely variable-length generation and support for a key-value cache, and they still lag behind the frontier of autoregressive and discrete diffusion quality. In this work, we address these limitations. We do so by introducing a model parameterization that uses position-dependent noise schedules to define semi-autoregressive (SAR) continuous diffusion language models (DLMs). Together with efficient training and sampling algorithms, we call this framework Clock Diffusion, and we present two special cases of our method: block and sliding window generation. We then define ClockDLMs, a family of Gaussian DLMs based on sliding window Clock Diffusion that attain state-of-the-art diffusion likelihood bounds on OpenWebText, even beating the performant block SAR discrete diffusion models. ClockDLMs trained on TinyGSM also substantially outperform continuous baselines on the GSM8K benchmark and match and exceed comparable SAR discrete diffusion models. Finally, building on our parameterization, we propose more efficient samplers that we dub Cache Grab, which adapt techniques from accelerated inference in discrete diffusion, such as committing tokens whose probabilities exceed a confidence threshold and self-speculative decoding, further improving our models' quality and efficiency.

</details>


### [405] [Towards Fast and Disentangled Counterfactuals for Visual Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00895)
*Sidney Bender,Benedikt Kunz,Ahmed Zeid,Shinichi Nakajima,Klaus-Robert Müller,Marco Morik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DiDAE，将冻结的基础模型包裹于条件扩散解码器中，通过解耦字典的单次闭式编辑生成反事实样本，无需梯度，速度比SOTA快约2000倍，可用于修复下游分类器并定位其依赖的少数方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型易受伪相关与"Clever Hans"策略影响。可解释机器学习能在无元数据情况下为分类器发现并移除这类策略，但基础模型尚无类似方案，因此需要一种针对基础模型的反事实生成与修复方法。

Method: DiDAE用条件扩散解码器包裹冻结的基础模型。反事实生成即沿解耦字典某一方向做一次闭式编辑后解码；字典获取可监督（Procrustes）或无监督（SVD、稀疏自编码器）。方法无需梯度。该机制还可对预训练字典与已训练分类器进行排序，返回分类器真正读取的方向，并用翻转决策的反事实因果验证，进而沿教师标注为伪相关的方向修复分类器。配套开源Peal库。

Result: 在六个数据集（两个合成、四个真实）上评估。在三个数据集的需求驱动基准中，反事实质量与SOTA持平或更优；经CFKD修复下游分类器时优于基于元数据的校正；速度最高约为SOTA的2000倍。

Conclusion: DiDAE为基础模型提供了无需元数据的反事实解释与修复能力，兼顾高效与可解释性；借助公开字典和预训练解码器，仅需对分类器做廉价的线性蒸馏与自身微调即可完成修复。

Abstract: Foundation models remain vulnerable to spurious correlations and ``Clever Hans'' strategies. Explainable machine learning can find and remove such strategies for classifiers without metadata. For foundation models, no such option exists yet. We propose Disentangled Diffusion Autoencoders (DiDAE). DiDAE wraps a frozen foundation model in a conditional diffusion decoder. A counterfactual is one closed-form edit along a direction of a disentangled dictionary, followed by decoding. The dictionary can be supervised (Procrustes) or unsupervised (Singular Value Decomposition, Sparse Autoencoders). No gradients are needed, so DiDAE is up to 2000 times faster than the state of the art. We evaluate on six datasets, two synthetic and four real-world. In a desiderata-driven benchmark on three of them, its counterfactuals are on par with or better than the state of the art, and they repair downstream classifiers through Counterfactual Knowledge Distillation (CFKD), where they beat metadata-based correction. The same machinery can rank a pretrained dictionary against a trained classifier. It returns the few directions the classifier actually reads, each causally verified by a counterfactual that flips the decision, and repairs the classifier along those a teacher marks spurious. The workflow is plug-and-play in our open-source Peal library we publish alongside the paper. With a public dictionary and a pretrained decoder, all that remains is a cheap linear distillation of the classifier and its own fine-tuning.

</details>


### [406] [When Do Biological Reasoning Models Use Their Biological Inputs?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00898)
*Ada Fang,Nikitha Thoduguli,Lukas Fesser,Hanlin Zhang,Sham M. Kakade,Marinka Zitnik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文检验了生物推理模型是否真正利用生物基础模型表征与生物文本进行推理,发现多数模型的基准准确率并不代表生物输入对性能有实质贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物推理模型通过后训练将LLM与生物基础模型表征及生物文本连接,其基准准确率被当作LLM能对这些输入进行推理的证据,但这一假设缺乏验证。

Method: 在DNA、蛋白质和单细胞任务上测试六个生物推理模型;在固定查询与其他输入的情况下扰动单一生物输入,构造将某一基因组/蛋白质/细胞的表征与另一文本配对的证据冲突,对语言模型接收到的表征拟合线性探针,并对照生物输入分析推理轨迹。

Result: Evo2与ESM3对BioReason和BioReason-Pro在所测任务上贡献很小;打乱DNA序列几乎不改变BioReason的疾病预测准确率,证据冲突中两模型分别有97.9%和99.7%跟随文本。Evo2与ESM3表征上的线性探针能预测任务目标,说明其编码了任务相关信息但未带来整体性能提升。相反,基础模型输入对ChatNT、Prot2Text-V2和CellWhisperer有贡献,基因句中的差异表达基因对Cell2Sentence-Scale有贡献。在BioReason-Pro的SFT与RL检查点及42个BioReason检查点中,准确率提升并不意味着生物输入贡献增大。BioReason轨迹错误陈述核苷酸变化,BioReason-Pro轨迹在证据冲突下描述了被最终预测省略的功能。

Conclusion: 当前后训练策略无法保证基础模型表征对任务性能产生贡献,基准准确率不能作为模型真正使用生物输入进行推理的证据。

Abstract: Biological reasoning models use post-training to connect LLMs to biological foundation model representations and biological text. Their benchmark accuracy is taken as evidence that LLMs reason over these inputs. We test this assumption in six biological reasoning models across DNA, protein, and single-cell tasks. We perturb one biological input while holding the query and other inputs fixed, construct evidence conflicts that pair the foundation model representation of one genome, protein, or cell with the text of another, fit linear probes to the representations the language model receives, and analyze reasoning traces against the biological inputs. Evo2 and ESM3 contribute little to BioReason and BioReason-Pro performance on the evaluated tasks. Shuffling the DNA sequence barely changes BioReason disease prediction accuracy, and in evidence conflicts the two models follow the text in 97.9% and 99.7% of cases. Linear probes trained on the Evo2 and ESM3 representations predict the task targets, so these foundation models encode information relevant to the task, but provide limited overall performance improvement to BioReason and BioReason-Pro. In contrast, foundation model inputs contribute to ChatNT, Prot2Text-V2, and CellWhisperer performance, and differentially expressed genes in the gene sentence contribute to Cell2Sentence-Scale performance. Across SFT and RL checkpoints of BioReason-Pro and 42 BioReason checkpoints, increases in accuracy do not imply greater performance contributions from biological inputs. BioReason traces misstate nucleotide changes, while BioReason-Pro traces describe functions omitted from final predictions under evidence conflicts. We find that current post-training strategies do not ensure that foundation model representations contribute to task performance.

</details>


### [407] [Sharpen Before You Adapt: Data-Free Entry-State Sharpening for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00903)
*Zhanming Zhang,Vinoth Selvendran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出“入口状态锐化”（entry-state sharpening）：在测试时强化学习（TTRL）之前，先用无数据（data-free）训练把通用模型置于更利于无标签自适应的入口状态。实验表明入口策略熵与TTRL的端点转化效率强相关，可将检查点准备视为“状态控制问题”。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TTRL依赖模型自身采样产生监督信号，因此检查点的“入口状态”至关重要：策略分布越弥散，自监督噪声越大，有限的适应预算可能被消耗在概率质量集中上，而非表达模型已具备的能力。

Method: 在TTRL之前引入无数据训练以锐化入口状态；该思路不绑定特定训练配方，不同无数据目标可将同一基座模型移至不同入口状态。基于Qwen3-4B构造五个无数据检查点，在相同的15步TTRL协议下评测，并与R-Zero、SPIRAL等不同目标进行对比，同时进行域内无标签自蒸馏干预。

Result: 入口策略熵对端点转化效率（reliability-to-reachability度量）具有强排序能力：Spearman ρ=-0.90（控制入口可达性后ρ=-0.99）。R-Zero保持弥散（3.39 nats），在MATH、GPQA、AMC的6/6配对比较中低于未调优基座；SPIRAL达到0.07 nats，在MATH和GPQA上取得最高的TTRL后准确率，尽管其自博弈阶段未使用数学训练数据。域内无标签自蒸馏进一步显示入口状态可被有意锐化。

Conclusion: 应将检查点准备视为“状态控制问题”：用无数据训练提升TTRL准备度，以入口熵作为无标签控制信号，并以可达能力作为约束条件。

Abstract: Test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) adapts language models on unlabeled test problems using supervision derived from their own samples. This makes the checkpoint's \emph{entry state} consequential: a diffuse policy provides noisier self-supervision and may spend much of a limited adaptation budget merely concentrating probability mass before reliably expressing capability it already possesses. We propose \textbf{entry-state sharpening}: use data-free training \emph{before} TTRL to prepare a general-purpose checkpoint in a state that subsequent label-free adaptation can exploit more efficiently. The idea is not tied to one training recipe; different data-free objectives can move the same base model to different entry states. Across five data-free checkpoints derived from Qwen3-4B and evaluated under an identical 15-step TTRL protocol, entry policy entropy strongly rank-orders endpoint conversion efficiency, a reliability-to-reachability measure (Spearman $ρ=-0.90$; $ρ=-0.99$ after controlling for entry reachability). The contrast across objectives is striking: R-Zero remains diffuse at $3.39$ nats and finishes below the untuned base in 6/6 matched comparisons across MATH, GPQA, and AMC, whereas SPIRAL reaches $0.07$ nats and achieves the highest post-TTRL accuracy on MATH and GPQA despite its self-play stage using no math training data. An in-domain label-free self-distillation intervention further shows that the entry state can be deliberately sharpened. These results motivate treating checkpoint preparation as a \emph{state-control problem}: use data-free training to improve TTRL readiness, with entry entropy as a label-free control signal and reachable capability as the constraint.

</details>


### [408] [In CEM, a World Model Is Also a Proposal Mechanism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00921)
*Oliver Obst,Frieder Stolzenburg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将CEM中预测模型的作用拆分为"当前决策打分"与"影响后续候选池"两种角色，分别评估其误差对最终选中序列成本的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CEM用世界模型分数选择动作序列，并据此拟合下一轮采样的分布。因此打分误差会同时改变当前决策和未来候选集，但这两条影响路径此前未被区分评估。

Method: 在Walker与Cheetah上，用四类预测模型生成CEM轨迹，并对每个已保存候选池用所有模型重新打分；在环境中执行同一批候选获得参考精英集与提议分布更新。共12个独立训练的task-seed单元，预设定提议距离、提议宽度、拟合均值分离度、成对排序一致性与精英集一致性等指标。随后用原始6个单元选定Random nonlinear做单步干预，其余6个单元作为留出验证。

Result: 全部12个单元中，提议距离从首次到末次CEM迭代均下降，提议宽度收缩，拟合均值相对剩余搜索宽度分离。成对排序一致性在Walker接近随机水平，在Cheetah上下降；精英集一致性未改善。Cheetah上打分器差异大于候选池来源差异，Walker上两者及配对差异均有。将首次模型排序更新替换为环境排序更新后，原始6个与留出的6个单元中最终实际选中序列成本均下降。

Conclusion: 预测模型在CEM中的作用可分解为决策打分与分布塑形，二者并非等价；排序一致性差并不妨碍提议分布的收缩与分离，而用环境反馈校正首次更新能稳定降低最终选中序列成本，说明模型打分的早期偏差具有可修正的因果影响。

Abstract: The cross-entropy method (CEM) uses world-model scores to select action sequences and fit the distribution sampled in its next iteration. A scoring error can therefore change both the present decision and the candidates considered later. We evaluate these two roles separately. Four types of predictive model generate CEM traces, and every model rescores every saved candidate pool. Executing the same candidates in the environment provides a reference elite set and proposal update.
  Across twelve independently trained task-seed units on Walker and Cheetah, the pre-specified proposal distance falls from the first to the final CEM iteration in every unit. Proposal widths contract and fitted means separate relative to the remaining search width. Pairwise ranking agreement stays near chance on Walker and declines on Cheetah; elite-set agreement does not improve. This comparison shows greater variation between scorers than between pool sources on Cheetah; Walker has variation in both and in their pairings. We use the original six units to select Random nonlinear for a one-update intervention, without inspecting intervention outcomes. Replacing its first model-ranked update with an environment-ranked update lowers final realised selected-sequence cost in those six units and in six further units held out from the selection.

</details>


### [409] [Rate-Optimal Algorithm for Adversarial Linear CMDPs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00927)
*Kihyun Yu,Honghao Wei,Dabeen Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究转移未知的 episodic 对抗性线性约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP），提出新的原始-对偶算法，在不假设 Slater 条件的情况下同时达到 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{K})$ 的 regret 与累积约束违反，闭合了此前 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(K^{3/4})$ 与最优 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{K})$ 之间的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前针对转移未知的 episodic 对抗性线性 CMDP 的最佳算法仅达到 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(K^{3/4})$ 的 regret 和累积约束违反，与最优的 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{K})$ 依赖存在差距。主要困难在于：学习线性 CMDP 需要对具有受控覆盖数的值函数类进行一致集中分析，而约束在线学习中的标准技术（如 policy mixing）会使该类变得更复杂。

Method: 提出一种新的原始-对偶算法，结合自适应 Follow the Regularized Leader（FTRL）、收缩值估计（contracted value estimation）以及指数 Lyapunov 函数。采用自适应对偶正则项，抵消原始 regret 界中对对偶权重的依赖，从而无需 policy mixing。FTRL 更新中的归一化使策略参数的界独立于对偶权重的大小，保证所得策略类与一致集中分析兼容；在特征访问下计算复杂度与状态空间大小无关。

Result: 在不假设 Slater 条件的情况下，同时达到 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{K})$ 的 regret 和累积约束违反，闭合了与最优速率之间的差距；同时证明了策略类保持与一致集中分析兼容，并且在特征访问下计算复杂度与状态空间规模无关。

Conclusion: 该工作为对抗性线性 CMDP 提供了达到最优 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{K})$ 速率的算法，无需 Slater 条件与 policy mixing，通过自适应对偶正则与 FTRL 归一化解决了值函数类集中分析的难题，并具备与状态空间规模无关的计算效率。

Abstract: We study episodic adversarial linear constrained Markov decision processes (CMDPs) with unknown transitions, where both the loss and constraint functions may vary adversarially across episodes. The best previous algorithm achieves $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(K^{3/4})$ regret and cumulative constraint violation, leaving a gap to the optimal $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{K})$ dependence on the number of episodes $K$. We close this gap by proposing a new primal dual algorithm that achieves $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{K})$ regret and cumulative constraint violation without assuming Slater's condition. The main challenge is that learning linear CMDPs requires uniform concentration over a value function class with a controlled covering number, whereas standard techniques in constrained online learning, such as policy mixing, can make this class more complex. Our algorithm combines adaptive Follow the Regularized Leader (FTRL), contracted value estimation, and an exponential Lyapunov function. An adaptive dual regularizer offsets the dependence on the dual weights in the primal regret bound, removing the need for policy mixing. We further show that the normalization in the FTRL update bounds the policy parameters independently of the magnitudes of the dual weights, which explains why the resulting policy class remains compatible with uniform concentration. Under feature access, the computational complexity is independent of the size of the state space.

</details>


### [410] [Platonic Task Arithmetic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00929)
*Junghwan Park,Woojin Cho*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出"柏拉图任务向量"假设，并用通用任务描述符（UTD）实现跨异构模型的任务知识迁移与组合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对同一任务的专用模型行为相似，但其参数更新不共享统一坐标系，导致权重空间的任务算术局限于单一模型、无法跨架构迁移，除非存在结构对应。作者受柏拉图"洞穴寓言"启发，假设这些模型特定的更新是同一个模型无关对象的"影子"。

Method: 提出通用任务描述符（UTD）：形状独立于架构与嵌入维度的矩阵，记录任务的功能效果，并支持矩阵加法与取负。迁移时将描述符注入目标模型，通过在其无标签探针图像与类名提示上复现描述符来实现编辑，无需逐图标签。两种实现：(1) 将描述符分解为图像嵌入上的位移场，用一次最小二乘求解得到线性算子，折叠进目标最后一层作为权重编辑，按线性性可将算子库以带符号求和实现任意强度组合；(2) 用同一目标训练低秩适配器，可触及所有层并联合拟合组合，代价是每次编辑需一次优化。

Result: 异构模型仅部分共享该对象，模型特定残差的范数与共享分量相当，但跨模型迁移仍保留目标自身描述符增益的74–80%。实验覆盖六个模型家族、八个分类任务及一个音频-文本设定，两种实现下任务知识均可跨异构模型迁移与组合。

Conclusion: 任务知识可作为架构无关的"柏拉图任务向量"，通过UTD在异构模型间迁移与组合，即便模型仅部分共享该对象，跨模型迁移仍具有显著有效性。

Abstract: Models specialized for the same task converge to similar behavior, yet the parameter updates that produce it share no common coordinate system, so weight-space task arithmetic stays confined to a single model and cannot cross architectures without a structural correspondence. Drawing on Plato's allegory of the cave, we hypothesize that these model-specific updates are shadows of one shared, model-agnostic object, which we call the platonic task vector. To make it operational for models that pair an image or audio encoder with a text encoder, we introduce Universal Task Descriptors: matrices whose shape is independent of architecture and embedding dimension, which record a task's functional effect and support addition and negation as matrix operations. Transferring a descriptor into a target means editing the target until it reproduces the descriptor on the task's unlabeled probe images and class-name prompts, requiring no per-image labels. We realize this edit in two ways. First, the descriptor factorizes into a shift field on image embeddings, so a single least-squares solve yields a linear operator that folds into the target's last layer as a weight edit; by linearity, a bank of such operators admits any composition at any strength as a signed sum. Second, a low-rank adapter trained on the same objective reaches every layer and fits compositions jointly, at the cost of one optimization per edit. Heterogeneous models share this object only partially, with a model-specific residual comparable in norm to the shared component, yet cross-model transfer still retains 74-80 percent of the gain of the target's own descriptors. Experiments across six model families, eight classification tasks, and an audio-text setting show that task knowledge transfers and composes across heterogeneous models under both realizations.

</details>


### [411] [GUI-HARVEST: Self-Improving GUI Agents through Evidence-Driven Harness Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00948)
*Geyi Yang,Zikun Qu,Xiang Li,Zhiyong Wang,Min Zhang,Shipei Zeng,Zhongxiang Dai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GUI-HARVEST是一个自动化harness优化器，通过将诊断与动作效果对齐、以重复运行作为联合证据、并跨任务归纳失败模式，实现冻结骨干模型下GUI智能体的自我改进，在OSWorld-Verified上取得稳定提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GUI模型的可执行harness决定了观测如何组装、动作如何执行以及验证、恢复和终止如何控制。相比非GUI智能体的harness优化，自动优化GUI harness面临三个耦合挑战：模型意图与观测视觉效果的协调、变异性执行结果下的失败诊断、以及跨任务识别可复用的失败模式并转化为运行时改动。

Method: 1）将模型输出和执行动作与前后截图对齐，把诊断锚定到具体界面转换；2）将同一任务的多次重复运行视为联合证据单元，利用任务内比较定位与结果相关的行为差异；3）跨任务整合已验证发现为反复出现的失败模式，映射为有界源码编辑，并在评估前记录预测，通过重复执行同时检验预测的行为效果与任务性能。

Result: 在OSWorld-Verified上，六种通用开源、GUI专用开源和专有骨干模型均取得一致的留出集提升；Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct在完整套件上提升12.33个百分点。冻结harness迁移在50步下将GPT-5在WindowsAgentArena上提升13.87个百分点，且无需进一步优化。相同骨干与初始harness下，GUI-HARVEST优于Self-Harness和Meta-Harness。

Conclusion: GUI特有的诊断与验证有助于harness改进泛化到未见任务，表明面向GUI的失败诊断与有界源码编辑可有效实现冻结骨干下的自我改进harness优化。

Abstract: The executable harness surrounding a GUI model determines how observations are assembled, actions are executed, and verification, recovery, and termination are controlled. Compared with harness optimization for non-GUI agents, automatically optimizing this harness poses three coupled challenges: reconciling model intent with observed visual effects, diagnosing failures under variable execution outcomes, and identifying recurrent failure patterns across tasks and translating them into reusable runtime changes. We introduce GUI-HARVEST, an automatic harness optimizer that enables self-improving GUI agents with frozen backbone models. First, to ground diagnosis in observed action effects, it aligns model outputs and executed actions with before-and-after screenshots, tying findings to specific interface transitions. Second, to account for execution variability, it treats repeated runs of the same task as a joint evidence unit, using within-task comparisons to locate outcome-relevant behavioral differences. Third, it consolidates verified findings across tasks into recurring failure patterns, maps them to bounded source-code edits with predictions recorded before evaluation, and checks the predicted behavioral effects alongside task performance through repeated execution. Experiments on OSWorld-Verified show consistent held-out gains across six general-purpose open, GUI-specialized open, and proprietary backbone models; Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct gains 12.33 points on the full suite. Frozen-harness transfer improves GPT-5 by 13.87 percentage points on WindowsAgentArena at 50 steps without further optimization. With the same backbone and initial harness, GUI-HARVEST outperforms Self-Harness and Meta-Harness, suggesting that GUI-specific diagnosis and validation help harness improvements generalize to unseen tasks. The code is available at https://github.com/GaryYang12345/GUI-HARVEST.

</details>


### [412] [Structure-agnostic Causal Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00968)
*Arman Behnam,Binghui Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SaCRL：无需先验因果结构，联合识别结构与学习不变表示，理论保证结构可辨识性并多基准SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有因果表示学习方法需预先指定因果结构，而不同结构要求互不相容的不变性约束，结构设定错误会丢弃预测性信息。

Method: 将结构选择建模为候选不变性的软优化，采用基于HSIC的违背度度量，并以自适应权重自动聚焦于可实现的结构，从而联合识别因果结构与学习相应不变表示。

Result: 在合成与半合成贝叶斯网络基准上恢复真实结构；在Colored MNIST上优于固定不变性基线；在PACS、VLCS、OfficeHome上达到SOTA；在结构误设与环境多样性有限时性能平缓退化。

Conclusion: SaCRL可在无先验结构知识下同时实现结构识别与不变表示学习，具备理论保证与稳健泛化能力。

Abstract: Causal representation learning aims to discover robust features by exploiting the causal structure underlying data generation. Existing methods require specifying the causal structure a priori, yet different structures demand fundamentally incompatible invariance constraints, and misspecification leads to representations that discard predictive information. We introduce SaCRL, a framework that jointly identifies the causal structure and learns the corresponding invariant representation without prior structural knowledge. Our approach formulates structure selection as a soft optimization over candidate invariances using HSIC-based violation metrics, with adaptive weights that automatically concentrate on the achievable structure. We provide theoretical guarantees for structure identification, including under random-feature approximation, invariance satisfaction, and out-of-distribution generalization. Empirically, SaCRL recovers the true structure on synthetic and semi-synthetic Bayesian-network benchmarks, outperforms fixed-invariance baselines on Colored MNIST, achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on three DomainBed benchmarks (PACS, VLCS, OfficeHome), and degrades gracefully under structural misspecification and limited environment diversity. Code is available at: https://github.com/ArmanBehnam/sacrl.

</details>


### [413] [Variational Streaming Flow: Probabilistic Forecasting in Physical Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00976)
*Hans Hao-Hsun Hsu,Minseon Gwak,Soon Hoe Lim,Pan Li,N. Benjamin Erichson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Variational Streaming Flow (VSF)，通过在物理时间上学习以动力学为条件的潜分布，实现高效的概率预测，兼顾流匹配的灵活性与streaming flow的计算效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂动力系统存在内在随机性和观测不完整，同一观测状态可能演化出多种未来，因此需要概率预测。流匹配虽然灵活但计算昂贵；Streaming Flow (SF)虽高效，但学习的是确定性速度场，对固定初始状态和历史只能给出单条轨迹，无法表达多模态未来。

Method: VSF在SF框架上引入潜变量分布，该分布以感兴趣的动力学为条件，从而支持概率预测；同时保持在物理时间中生成，延续SF的计算效率。此外可将其作为即插即用预测器接入JEPA世界模型。

Result: 在确定性和随机动力系统上，VSF在预测精度和分布保真度上均优于基线；在超过1000步的长时程滚动及分叉动力学场景中展现优势；集成到JEPA世界模型后提升了时间动力学建模及导航、运动规划、操作任务的目标达成率。

Conclusion: VSF弥补了SF仅能确定性预测的缺陷，以低计算代价实现高质量概率预测，并具备良好的可扩展性和与现有世界模型的兼容性。

Abstract: Probabilistic forecasting is important for predicting complex dynamical systems because intrinsic randomness and incomplete observations can cause the same observed state to evolve into multiple plausible futures. While flow matching is a flexible approach for probabilistic forecasting, it is computationally expensive. Streaming flow (SF) reformulates this approach to model temporal evolution efficiently by learning a continuous velocity field directly in physical time. However, SF learns a deterministic velocity field. Thus, it provides only a single future trajectory for a given fixed initial state and observation history. To overcome this limitation, we introduce Variational Streaming Flow (VSF). Our approach learns a latent distribution that is conditioned on the dynamics of interest. In turn, this enables probabilistic forecasting. Importantly, we retain the computational efficiency of SF by generating in physical time. Across deterministic and stochastic dynamical systems, VSF demonstrates superior predictive accuracy and distributional fidelity. We demonstrate the advantage for both long-horizon rollouts exceeding 1,000 steps, and settings with bifurcating dynamics. Moreover, VSF can be integrated into existing Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA)-based world models as a plug-and-play predictor to improve temporal dynamics and goal-directed success rate in navigation, motion planning, and manipulation.

</details>


### [414] [Generalist Representation, Specialist Detection: TS-Router for Time-Series Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00978)
*Tian Lan,Yifei Gao,Yimeng Lu,Xuming An,Meng Wang,Yue Pan,Wenjun He,Chenghao Liu,Chen Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 TS-Router：用预训练时序基础模型表征估计异构异常检测器的相对能力，为目标序列自适应选择专家检测器，无需目标域异常标签。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时序异常检测（TSAD）难以跨数据集泛化：不同数据集的时序动态异质，导致"正常"定义不同、最优检测准则不同。时序基础模型虽提供可迁移表征，但搭配固定异常打分机制会忽视这种差异，因此需从"统一准则"转向"协调多种专门准则"。

Method: 采用"通用表征+专家检测"框架：基于预训练时序表征估计异构异常检测器（专家）的相对能力，并为每条目标序列选择合适专家。为避免依赖真实任务上的专家性能标签，从专家在带标签模拟任务上的相对表现中导出软能力监督。部署时路由不需要目标异常标签，仅对选中的专家在目标序列上做无监督拟合。理论方面，在表征覆盖与条件能力稳定性假设下给出 Top-k 集合能力遗憾界。

Result: 在 16 个真实世界基准和 4 个互补评估指标上，TS-Router 取得最佳总体平均排名。使用多个冻结 TSFM 编码器的受控消融进一步支持预训练表征用于能力估计与自适应专家选择的有效性。

Conclusion: 基于基础模型的 TSAD 可作为一种"由通用表征驱动的专家路由"问题，而非施加单一通用异常准则；该方法在跨数据集泛化上表现稳健，并提供理论保证。

Abstract: Time-series anomaly detection (TSAD) is difficult to generalize across datasets because heterogeneous temporal dynamics imply different notions of normality and favor different detection criteria. While time-series foundation models provide transferable representations, coupling them with a fixed anomaly-scoring mechanism can overlook this variation. This motivates a different perspective on foundation-model-based TSAD: using foundation models to coordinate specialized anomaly criteria rather than directly imposing a universal one. Based on this view, we propose \textbf{TS-Router}, a generalist-representation, specialist-detection framework that estimates the relative competence of heterogeneous anomaly detectors from pretrained temporal representations and selects suitable specialists for each target series. To avoid relying on specialist-performance labels from real tasks, we derive soft competence supervision from specialists' relative performance on labeled simulated tasks. At deployment, routing requires no target anomaly labels, and only the selected specialists are fitted unsupervisedly on the target series. We bound Top-\(k\) set-competence regret under representation coverage and conditional competence stability. Across 16 real-world benchmarks and four complementary evaluation metrics, TS-Router achieves the best overall average rank. Controlled ablations with multiple frozen TSFM encoders further support the use of pretrained representations for competence estimation and adaptive specialist selection. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TS-Router-D8FF.

</details>


### [415] [HADRec: A Hierarchy-Aware Drug Recommendation Framework by Fusing Molecular Knowledge and Electronic Health Record](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00984)
*Junke Wang,Hongshun Ling,Li Zhang,Jinjing Wu,Tong Shao,Fang Wang,Yuan Gao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出HADRec分层感知药物推荐框架，融合分子知识与电子健康记录，通过LLaMA-7B与ChemBERTa编码及跨注意力融合，并引入ATC分层预测器与一致性约束损失，在MIMIC-III/IV上取得领先性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有药物推荐方法存在两大局限：一是将药物抽象为离散token，忽略分子结构与药理机制；二是"扁平化"推荐范式未能利用国际标准ATC分类体系的层级逻辑。

Method: HADRec整合分子知识与EHR：用LLaMA-7B编码临床笔记获得患者表征，用ChemBERTa编码药物SMILES构建全局分子知识库；采用跨注意力机制对患者状态与药物特征进行多模态深度融合；引入分层预测器与一致性约束损失，强制遵循ATC逻辑依赖。

Result: 在MIMIC-III上，Jaccard、F1、PR-AUC均达SOTA；MIMIC-IV外部验证显示分布偏移下泛化性强，校准良好（ECE=0.04，Brier=0.06）；反事实评估体现临床一致的推理，可分离疾病特异治疗与一般护理。

Conclusion: HADRec是高性能、可解释且具临床依据的药物推荐路径，面向安全可靠的AI驱动用药决策。

Abstract: Accurate medication recommendation is central to clinical decision-making, directly determining therapeutic efficacy and patient safety. However, existing methods suffer from two key limitations: drugs are often abstracted as discrete tokens, ignoring their molecular structures and pharmacological mechanisms, and the commonly used "flat" recommendation paradigm fails to leverage the hierarchical logic of the internationally standardized Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) classification system. To address these issues, we propose HADRec, a Hierarchy-Aware Drug Recommendation framework that integrates molecular knowledge with electronic health records (EHRs). HADRec employs LLaMA-7B to encode clinical notes for rich patient representations and ChemBERTa to encode drug Simplified Molecular Input Line Entry System strings, building a global molecular knowledge base. A cross-attention mechanism then performs deep multimodal fusion between patient states and drug features. The framework further incorporates a hierarchical predictor and a novel consistency constraint loss to enforce strict adherence to ATC logical dependencies. Extensive experiments on MIMIC-III demonstrate that HADRec achieves state-of-the-art performance across Jaccard, F1, and PR-AUC. External validation on MIMIC-IV confirms strong generalization under distribution shifts, and calibration analysis shows well-calibrated predictive confidence on MIMIC-IV with ECE = 0.04, and Brier = 0.06. Counterfactual evaluation reveals clinically aligned reasoning, disentangling disease-specific treatments from general care. Together, these results establish HADRec as a high-performance, interpretable, and clinically grounded pathway toward safe and reliable AI-driven medication recommendation.

</details>


### [416] [Neural scaling laws and evolution of learnable activation functions of Kolmogorov-Arnold networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00985)
*Tilen Cadez,Sanghoon Lee,Kyoung-Min Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究了三种KAN变体（BSRBF-KAN、Gottlieb-KAN、Faster-KAN）的神经缩放律及可学习激活函数在数据集扩大下的结构演化，发现测试损失呈现破损神经缩放律（BNSL）行为并伴随激活函数从线性近似向符号化形式的转变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: KAN以可学习激活函数替代传统MLP的固定激活，具有优越可解释性，适合科学领域应用，但其神经缩放律及激活函数随数据量增长的结构演化尚不明确，需要量化研究以指导高效应用并平衡表达力与计算开销。

Method: 评估三种KAN变体（BSRBF-KAN、Gottlieb-KAN、Faster-KAN）在标准图像分类基准（MNIST、Fashion-MNIST）和专门科学回归任务（从摩尔磁性织构畴图像估计磁参数）上的缩放行为，分析测试损失L随数据集规模N_D的变化关系，并对激活函数复杂度随数据量增加的结构演化进行结构分析。

Result: 测试损失随数据集规模呈破损神经缩放律（BNSL）行为：经过随机猜测区后，损失遵循架构与任务相关的缩放行为；图像分类中损失从快速缩放分支过渡到慢速分支，L∝N_D^{-α}与L∝N_D^{-β}，α>β，α范围为0.4-1.5，β范围为0.06-0.6，且强烈依赖网络架构与数据规模区间；磁参数回归任务中损失遵循单一缩放律，指数范围为1.28-2.59。此外，数据集扩大驱使激活函数从简单线性近似向稳定、可解释的符号形式转变。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了KAN的破损神经缩放律特征及激活函数结构演化规律，为KAN的高效应用提供了定量路线图，有助于在模型表达力与计算开销之间进行权衡。

Abstract: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) represent a compelling alternative to traditional Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP)-based neural networks. By employing activation functions as learnable elements, KANs offer superior interpretability, making them suited for scientific domains. In this work, we investigate the neural scaling laws of KANs and the structural evolution of their learnable activation functions under dataset expansion. Specifically, we evaluate the scaling behavior of three KAN variants---BSRBF-KAN, Gottlieb-KAN, and Faster-KAN---across standard image classification benchmarks (MNIST and Fashion-MNIST) and a specialized scientific regression task (magnetic parameter estimation from domain images of moiré magnetic textures). Our results demonstrate that the test loss ${\cal L}$ exhibits a broken neural scaling law (BNSL) behavior as a function of the dataset size $N_D$. After passing through a random-guess regime, the loss follows architecture- and task-dependent scaling behavior. The loss crosses from a faster- to a slower-scaling branch, ${\cal L}\propto N_D^{-α}$ and ${\cal L}\propto N_D^{-β}$ with $α>β$ for image classification tasks. The exponents $α$ and $β$ depend strongly on both the specific network architecture and the dataset-size regime, ranging from 0.4 to 1.5 and from 0.06 to 0.6, respectively. For the magnetic parameter-regression task, the loss follows a single scaling law with its exponent ranging from 1.28 to 2.59. Additionally, we provide a structural analysis of how activation functions refine their complexity as data volume increases, finding that dataset expansion drives a transition from simple linear-like approximations toward stable, interpretable symbolic forms. These findings provide a quantitative roadmap for the efficient application of KANs while managing the trade-off between model expressivity and computational overhead.

</details>


### [417] [Auditable Algebraic Counting Field for Cryptic-Pocket Detection from Apo Structures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00988)
*Shan Yu,Xuening Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出监督式代数计数场（ACF），通过显式几何、理化与拓扑特征的整数加权查找表，从apo结构预测隐蔽口袋残基，推理时无需序列搜索、模板迁移或蛋白语言模型，并具可审查性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 隐蔽配体结合口袋在实验解析的apo结构中并不明显，仅凭未结合受体几何难以识别；同时，现有方法的预测结果及其背后证据（结构测量与学习到的证据）难以被直接审查。

Method: 提出监督式代数计数场（ACF）：将显式的几何、理化与拓扑特征编译为紧凑的整数加权查找表；每个预测分数可由特征值、训练计数、表权重与空间聚合重建，无需序列搜索、结构模板迁移或蛋白语言模型。在CryptoBench及两个锁定的外部集合上评估，并将排序性能与残基调用预算的影响分离。

Result: 在57个post-CryptoBench apo-holo单元的外部集上，ACF的平均配对ROC-AUC较P2Rank高+0.044（多重性校正95% CI [+0.010, +0.079]）；但优势依赖数据集：与P2Rank在官方fold ROC-AUC及匹配预算F1上的差异未达显著，且第二个外部评估未证实新增结构特征带来增益。

Conclusion: ACF提供了一个紧凑的预测器，具有外部验证的信号，并提供从结构测量与训练计数到残基分数的可审查路径。

Abstract: Cryptic ligand-binding pockets are not apparent in experimentally determined apo structures, making them difficult to identify from unbound receptor geometry. A complementary challenge is to make the structural measurements and learned evidence behind each prediction directly inspectable. We introduce a supervised algebraic counting field (ACF) for predicting cryptic-pocket residues from apo structures. ACF compiles explicit geometric, physicochemical, and topological features into compact, integer-weighted lookup tables. Each prediction score can be reconstructed from feature values, training counts, table weights, and spatial aggregation, without sequence search, structural-template transfer, or a protein language model at inference. We evaluate ACF on CryptoBench and two locked external collections, separating ranking performance from the effects of residue-calling budgets. On an external set of 57 post-CryptoBench apo-holo units, ACF exceeded P2Rank by +0.044 in mean paired ROC-AUC (multiplicity-adjusted 95% CI [+0.010, +0.079]). The advantage was dataset-dependent: official-fold ROC-AUC and matched-budget F1 differences against P2Rank remained unresolved, and a second external evaluation did not confirm gains from added structural features. ACF thus provides a compact predictor with externally validated signal and an inspectable path from structural measurements and training counts to residue scores.

</details>


### [418] [Adapter Thickets: Splitting an RLVR Budget Beats Concentrating It](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00991)
*Jonathan Williams,Esin Tureci Karthik R. Narasimhan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出"先用RLVR训练单一策略、再采样投票"的标准流程存在损失:RLVR使策略样本错误相关性升高,导致多数投票反而劣于未训练基座,并提出将同等预算分散训练多个LoRA适配器(adapter thicket)的替代方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多数投票是测试时扩展的核心手段,RLVR是提升单样本质量的核心手段,两者组合被视为标准流程。然而作者认为这种组合是有损的:投票只能纠正投票者不共享的错误,而RLVR会锐化策略,使样本越来越倾向于犯相同的错误,从而削弱投票纠错能力。

Method: 在4个模型(1.5B–8B)上,每个问题采样160条回答。以完整RLVR预算训练单个LoRA适配器作为基线;将相同数据与训练预算随机划分为K个互不重叠的shard,分别训练K个LoRA适配器,构成"adapter thicket"。同时设置对照:在thicket成员相同步数处提前停止训练的单适配器。比较单样本准确率、多数投票准确率及投票数从16增至160时的影响。

Result: (1)全预算训练的单适配器提升了所有模型上的单样本准确率,但在4个模型中的3个上,其多数投票准确率反而低于未训练基座,最多低4.8个点;(2)损伤随训练累积:投票者错误相关性上升,多数投票准确率早期达峰后最多下降7.0个点;(3)thicket在全部16个(model, K)设定中投票表现优于完整训练的单适配器,K≥4时与基座差距在0.8点以内或更高;(4)提前停止的单适配器对照在小K时与thicket相当,但K≥8时thicket在8个设定中的6个里保留更多单样本增益且投票表现更优;(5)投票数从16增至160时,thicket相对完整训练适配器的领先从1.3点扩大到3.3点。

Conclusion: 多数投票与RLVR组合的损失源于样本错误的"集中化"(concentration),而非RLVR本身。当计划是采样并投票时,RLVR预算应"广而浅"地使用(分散到多个适配器),而非集中于单一策略。

Abstract: Majority voting over sampled completions is the workhorse of test-time scaling, and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is the workhorse for making each completion better. The standard pipeline composes the two: train one policy with RLVR, then sample it many times and vote. We show that this composition is lossy. A vote can only overturn mistakes that its voters do not share, and RLVR sharpens a policy so that its samples increasingly make the same mistakes. With every method drawing exactly $160$ completions per problem, training a single LoRA adapter on the full RLVR budget raises single-sample accuracy on every model we test ($1.5$B-$8$B). Yet on three of four models it leaves the majority vote below that of the untrained base model, by up to $4.8$ points. The damage builds during training: voter errors grow steadily more correlated, and the majority vote accuracy peaks early before falling by up to $7.0$ points. The cause is concentration, not RLVR itself. We split the same data and training budget across $K$ LoRA adapters, each trained on its own random disjoint shard, and call the result an adapter thicket. Thickets out-vote the fully trained adapter in all $16$ (model, $K$) settings, and for $K{\geq}4$ they stay within $0.8$ points of the base model or above it. A single adapter stopped early, at a thicket member's step count, is a strong control that matches thickets for small $K$. For $K{\geq}8$, thickets keep more of RLVR's single-sample gain and out-vote this control in six of eight settings. The cost of concentration also grows with the number of votes: from $16$ to $160$ votes, the thicket's lead over the fully trained adapter widens from $1.3$ to $3.3$ points. When the plan is to sample and vote, an RLVR budget is better spent broad than deep.

</details>


### [419] [Reliability-aware short-term roll prediction for unmanned surface vehicles via multi-task learning and adaptive centralization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00996)
*Kaizhen Li,Xi Zhou,Zihao Wang,Dan Zhang,Jianjian Liu,Xiaowei Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种可靠性感知的无人船横摇预测范式，通过多任务学习在预测的同时输出置信度，并引入自适应中心化策略提升泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人船横摇预测对航行安全与自主决策至关重要；现有研究多聚焦预测精度，对预测可靠性的量化关注不足。

Method: 采用多任务学习结构：共享特征提取骨干网络连接双头，回归头输出横摇预测，量化头输出置信度评分；并提出面向短期实时横摇预测的自适应中心化策略。

Result: 在真实海况数据集上的实验表明，所提方法能有效量化预测结果的可靠性，并在不同工况下保持优越的泛化性能。

Conclusion: 该可靠性感知预测范式可为风险敏感的下游任务提供预测值与置信度，具有实际工程应用潜力。

Abstract: Reliable roll prediction of unmanned surface vehicles (USVs) is essential for ensuring navi?gational safety and enhancing autonomous decision-making. While existing studies primarily focus on improving prediction accuracy, the quantification of prediction reliability remains insufficiently addressed. To bridge this gap, this paper proposes a reliability-aware prediction paradigm that integrates confidence assessment into the predictive pipeline. The architecture utilizes a multi-task learning structure where a shared feature extraction backbone feeds into dual heads: a regression head for precise roll prediction and a quantification head for confidence scoring. This configuration provides accurate prediction and corresponding confidence for risk?sensitive downstream tasks. In addition, an adaptive centralization strategy tailored for short?term real-time roll prediction is introduced to improve model generalization under varying operational conditions. Experiments conducted on a real-sea dataset demonstrate that the proposed method effectively quantifies the reliability of prediction results and maintains superior generalization under varying conditions, offering significant potential for practical engineering applications.

</details>


### [420] [Optimal Transport Reweighting for Robust Learning under Spurious Correlations and Label Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01028)
*Sung Ho Jo,Seonghwi Kim,Wonsang Yun,Minwoo Chae*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 POTER：基于最优传输的样本重加权框架，用训练分布与参考分布间的传输几何度量样本重要性，单阶段 ERM 训练即可提升子群体偏移与标签噪声下的最差组准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习模型在子群体偏移下性能下降，虚假相关使模型依赖无法跨子群体泛化的捷径特征。已有工作用基于损失的信号识别信息样本，但在标签噪声下这些信号严重失真：被错标的样本也可能产生大损失，污染后续重加权或重训练。该交叉问题（子群体偏移 + 标签噪声）研究不足但实践重要。

Method: POTER 是一个基于最优传输（optimal transport）的重加权框架。它利用训练分布与由有限验证组标注构建的参考分布之间的传输几何来推导样本重要性，在单样本层面度量对齐程度而非依赖损失值。据此降低被错标或与偏差强对齐样本的权重，提高与参考分布对齐更好的样本的重要性。此外，POTER 仅需单一 ERM 训练阶段，摆脱了近期工作中常见的重训练范式。

Result: 在标准基准和噪声标签设定下，POTER 取得最差组准确率（worst-group accuracy）的当前最优表现，包括标签噪声集中在少数子群体内的情况。

Conclusion: POTER 通过最优传输几何在样本层面度量与参考分布的对齐，规避了损失信号在标签噪声下的失真问题，并以单阶段训练实现最差组准确率的领先性能，为子群体偏移与标签噪声的联合场景提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Machine learning models often suffer performance degradation under subpopulation shift, particularly when spurious correlations cause models to rely on shortcut features that fail to generalize across subgroups. A recent line of work mitigates this issue by using loss-based signals to identify informative samples, but these signals can become severely distorted under label noise: mislabeled samples may also incur large losses and contaminate subsequent reweighting or retraining. Despite its practical importance, this intersection remains largely underexplored. We propose POTER, a reweighting framework based on optimal transport that derives sample importance from the transport geometry between the training distribution and a reference distribution constructed from limited validation group annotations. By measuring alignment at the individual-sample level rather than relying on loss, POTER downweights mislabeled or strongly bias-aligned samples while assigning higher importance to samples better aligned with the reference distribution. In addition, POTER requires only a single ERM training stage, moving beyond the retraining paradigm common in recent work. Across standard benchmarks and noisy-label settings, POTER achieves state-of-the-art worst-group accuracy, including cases where label corruption is concentrated within minority subgroups.

</details>


### [421] [SLIM: Simplex-Lattice Interpolation Merging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01037)
*Seongcheol Jeong,Masahiro Suzuki,Yutaka Matsuo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SLIM，用经典混料设计的二次代理模型在系数单纯形上逼近大模型合并性能，仅需评估单个专家与等权配对即可确定代理，从而在有限评测预算下优化合并系数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型合并系数优化通常需要大量昂贵的基准评测，评测成本成为主要瓶颈，需要一种在有限评测预算下高效确定合并系数的方法。

Method: SLIM基于系数单纯形上的经典混料设计构造聚合性能的二次代理模型；通过评估单个专家与等权配对，以识别该域上一般二次模型所需的最少测量数确定代理；随后在不进行额外目标指标评测的情况下优化该代理。

Result: 在两种模型架构上的实验表明，SLIM能准确预测未见过的多专家混合性能，并在有限评测预算下取得有竞争力的合并效果；等预算对比显示，结构化评测点相比随机设计（包括使用正则化拟合的设计）提升了预测保真度。

Conclusion: 结构化混料设计可在有限评测预算下有效替代昂贵的合并系数搜索，为高效模型合并提供可行方案。

Abstract: Optimizing merging coefficients for large language models can require many costly benchmark evaluations. We propose \textbf{Simplex-Lattice Interpolation Merging (SLIM)}, which constructs a quadratic surrogate of aggregate performance on the coefficient simplex using a classical mixture design. Evaluations of individual experts and equal-weight pairs determine the surrogate with the minimum number of measurements needed to identify a general quadratic on this domain. SLIM then optimizes the surrogate without further target-metric evaluations. Experiments on two model architectures demonstrate accurate prediction of unseen multi-expert mixtures and competitive merge performance under limited evaluation budgets. Matched-budget comparisons show that structured evaluation points improve prediction fidelity over random designs, including those using regularized fitting.

</details>


### [422] [Kernelized Activation Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01062)
*Laziz U. Abdullaev,Minh-Hieu Pham,Bach Do,Khoat Than,Tan M. Nguyen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出核化激活引导（KAS）框架，将激活引导提升到再生核希尔伯特空间，实现根据激活位置自适应调整的局部非线性引导，且DiM成为线性核下的特例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有激活引导方法（如Difference-in-Means, DiM）对所有激活使用单一、与输入无关的引导向量，表达力有限，并忽略了激活空间的局部几何结构。

Method: 提出KAS，将激活引导提升到再生核希尔伯特空间，用纯核评估形式化引导优化问题，无需构造显式特征映射，从而得到隐式、依赖激活的引导分数；每个激活根据其相对于源集与目标参考集的相对位置进行修正，形成表示空间上的非线性引导场。

Result: 在标准激活引导任务上（包括越狱大语言模型与图像风格控制），KAS优于或与现有方法持平；DiM可在线性核下作为特例被还原，而更丰富的核可实现几何感知的干预。

Conclusion: KAS是激活引导的统一框架，通过核方法实现局部自适应与几何感知的非线性引导，为控制生成模型的属性提供了更具表达力的免训练机制。

Abstract: Activation steering provides a simple, training-free mechanism for controlling attributes of generative models such as sentiment, style, and helpfulness. However, standard approaches such as Difference-in-Means apply a single input-independent steering vector across all activations, limiting expressivity and ignoring the local geometry of the activation space. We propose Kernelized Activation Steering (KAS), a unifying framework that lifts activation steering into a reproducing kernel Hilbert space. KAS formulates steering as an optimization problem expressed purely via kernel evaluations, yielding an implicit, activation-dependent steering score without constructing explicit feature maps. Unlike DiM, KAS induces locally adaptive steering: each activation is modified according to its relative position with respect to source and target reference sets, producing a nonlinear steering field over the representation space. Importantly, DiM is recovered as a special case under a linear kernel, while richer kernels enable geometry-aware interventions. Across standard activation steering tasks, including jailbreaking LLMs and image style control, KAS outperforms or is on par with the existing methods.

</details>


### [423] [GLoC-EHR: Evidence-Cited Clinical Reasoning over Global Context and Local EHR Events](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01076)
*Chaiho Shin,Kwangsoo Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GLoC-EHR是一种多模态语言模型，通过全局记忆与局部记忆编码EHR序列，先以生成式预训练对齐临床文本，再经原理微调与GRPO训练实现引用证据后作答，在MIMIC-IV结局任务上取得最高宏AUROC并可迁移至EHRSHOT。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构化EHR是临床代码序列，回答临床问题既需整体病程语境，也需支持答案的具体事件。现有零样本LLM直接读取序列化记录效果不佳，缺乏整体与局部信息的兼顾及证据可溯源性。

Method: 提出GLoC-EHR：以固定大小的全局记忆编码整个病程语境，以局部记忆编码选定事件，二者均为多模态并读取EHR上下文编码。训练分阶段：先从全局记忆生成住院病程摘要、从局部记忆生成被掩码概念描述，与临床文本对齐；再经理由（rationale）微调与GRPO强化学习，奖励正确答案与记录支持的证据，使模型先引用证据再作答。

Result: 在三个MIMIC-IV结局任务上，GLoC-EHR直接作答时宏AUROC为对比模型中最高，而零样本LLM读取序列化记录远逊；证据引用推理时宏AUROC接近直接多任务版本，证据项奖励在相近宏AUROC下减少无支持证据；局部记忆带来额外受支持发现（严格匹配下尤明显）且宏AUROC无可检测变化；无需重训即可迁移至EHRSHOT，与EHR-BERT相当，并在两个未见实验室问题上优于其自身骨干的零样本提示。

Conclusion: 全局与局部记忆结合的生成式对齐与证据引用强化训练，使GLoC-EHR在EHR结局预测上兼顾高性能与可溯源证据，并具备良好的跨数据集迁移与泛化能力。

Abstract: Structured electronic health records (EHRs) contain a patient's clinical trajectory as a sequence of clinical codes. Answering clinical questions from such records requires both the context of the whole trajectory and the specific events that support the answer. We introduce GLoC-EHR, a multimodal language model that reads a contextual encoding of the record through a fixed-size global memory of the trajectory and a local memory of selected events. The model learns to generate hospital-course summaries from the global memory and descriptions of masked concepts from the local memory, aligning both with clinical text. It is then trained to cite evidence before answering, through rationale fine-tuning followed by group relative policy optimization (GRPO) with rewards for correct answers and record-supported evidence. On three MIMIC-IV outcome tasks, GLoC-EHR attains the highest macro AUROC among the compared models when it answers directly, whereas zero-shot LLMs reading the serialized record fall far behind. With evidence-cited reasoning, it stays close to its direct multi-task counterpart in macro AUROC, and the evidence terms of the objective reduce unsupported evidence at a similar macro AUROC. The local memory adds distinct supported findings, particularly under strict matching, without a detectable change in macro AUROC. Without retraining, GLoC-EHR transfers to EHRSHOT on par with EHR-BERT and answers two unseen laboratory questions better than zero-shot prompting of its own backbone.

</details>


### [424] [Dataset Identity, Not Novelty: The Source of an Inflated OOD Detection Gain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01096)
*Donghoon Lee,Shinjin Kang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出，post-hoc OOD 检测器在基准评估中通过在 OOD 数据上拟合参数（如温度常数、特征方向或可学习组合器）所报告的增益，大部分来自"识别数据集身份"而非"识别新颖性"。作者提出用留一整个 OOD 数据集（而非留出样本）来测量该差距，称为 inflation（膨胀）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 OOD 检测基准协议在 OOD 数据集上拟合检测器，并在同一数据集的留出样本上验证。这种验证只能排除记忆单张图像，却无法排除拟合过程学到"正在看哪个数据集"——即一个能识别特定 OOD 数据集而非新颖性的方向也能完美通过验证。而实际部署时检测器面对的是从未拟合过的来源，因此该协议报告的增益可能被高估，需要量化这一偏差。

Method: 作者将整个 OOD 数据集（而非其样本子集）留出，测量拟合协议报告的增益与真正泛化增益之间的差距，定义为 inflation。在 ImageNet 与 CIFAR-100 骨干网络上评估多种组合器（combiner），包括在 OOD 数据上调节的常数、特征空间方向、以及灵活组合器。通过两个仅改变"输入是否暴露类别身份"的对照实验来分离膨胀来源，并给出从拟合行计算该效应的闭式表达式。

Result: 大多数常用协议报告的增益实际来自数据集身份而非新颖性。拟合规模（fit size）不影响残存增益，说明该效应并非普通过拟合。膨胀比例取决于输入是否暴露类别身份，两个仅改变该属性的对照在两种基准的所有骨干上都能分离出膨胀。闭式公式可从拟合行直接计算膨胀，无需运行留出协议。最终只有单一常数（领域已在指定验证集上选取的常数）能在留出协议下存活。

Conclusion: 任何高于该单一常数的拟合所报告的增益，都无法被留出协议复现；在某一基准上，真正存活的增益下降而报告值却上升。作者呼吁重新审视 OOD 检测基准的评估协议，并提供了无需额外实验即可判断哪些拟合会膨胀的实用工具。

Abstract: A post-hoc out-of-distribution (OOD) detector reads the activations of a trained classifier and returns a score. It fits that score on in-distribution data, and the benchmarks that evaluate it supply a second piece of OOD data for the fitting itself. Some detectors tune a constant on it. Others fit a direction in feature space or train a flexible combiner and report the number that it reaches as the gain that is still available. Every such fit is validated on held-out samples of the same OOD dataset. That check rules out memorizing individual images. It says nothing about a fit that has instead learned which dataset it is looking at, and a direction that recognizes one OOD dataset rather than novelty passes it perfectly. The detector that a practitioner installs meets OOD data from a source that nobody fitted it on, so the difference decides what the reported number is worth. We measure it by holding out the whole OOD dataset rather than a sample of it, and we call that gap the inflation. We read it across a range of combiners on ImageNet and CIFAR-100 backbones. Most of the gain that the usual protocol reports turns out to be dataset identity rather than novelty. The size of the fit does not move what survives, so the effect is not ordinary overfitting. The share depends instead on whether the input exposes class identity, and two controls that vary that property alone separate the inflation on every backbone of both benchmarks. A closed form accounts for the effect and computes it from the fitting rows, so a practitioner can tell which fits will inflate without running the hold-out protocol. One of these fits survives, namely the single constant that the field already picks on a designated validation dataset. Anything above it reports a gain that the hold-out protocol does not return, and on one benchmark what survives falls while what is reported climbs.

</details>


### [425] [Persistent Depth Ordering amid Shifting Block-Bypass Responses in Language Model Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01165)
*Shengye Tao,Yinzhu Cheng,Haihua Xie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究通过单块恒等旁路（single-block identity bypass）干预，追踪五个已发布训练轨迹、11个模型-领域组合中的层敏感度随预训练的演变，发现层排序结构持久但幅度重分布，单检查点干预响应需结合扰动通路演化来解读。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有层干预分析多基于单一训练检查点，但模型表征与计算在预训练中持续演化，因此无法区分哪些深度依赖的干预响应反映持久组织、哪些是训练的瞬时结果。作者希望厘清该纵向问题。

Method: 对固定的 teacher-forced 上下文施加单块恒等旁路，覆盖五条已发布训练轨迹与11个模型-领域组合；比较邻近与远距离检查点的秩对应关系，考察大幅变化是否在文本样本间复现并跨评估领域迁移；并通过受控实验（含复制的 Pythia 运行与 OLMo-2 7B）检验自然旁路效应变化是否可归因于单一下游敏感度，同时考察匹配响应与扰动强度、方向的关系。

Result: 块旁路响应保留可识别的深度排序，但幅度发生重分布；邻近检查点的秩对应强于远距离检查点；大幅变化集中于跨文本样本复现、跨领域迁移的位置。Pythia 复制运行中，局部缺失更新幅度增大而汇集的匹配下游响应减小；OLMo-2 7B 呈现不同平衡。匹配响应依赖扰动强度与方向，未发现定向补偿。

Conclusion: 纵向层敏感度是有结构但非静态的；单检查点的干预响应必须结合基础扰动通路在训练中的演化来解读，而不能简单外推为模型的持久内部组织。

Abstract: Layer interventions are widely used to probe the internal organization of language models, yet most analyses examine a single training checkpoint even though model representations and computations evolve throughout pretraining. This leaves open which depth-dependent intervention responses reflect persistent organization and which are transient consequences of training. We study this question using single-block identity bypass on fixed teacher-forced contexts across five released trajectories and 11 model-domain combinations. We find that block-bypass responses retain recognizable depth ordering while their magnitudes redistribute: nearby checkpoints preserve stronger rank correspondence than distant ones, and large changes concentrate at positions that recur across text samples and transfer across evaluation domains. Controlled experiments further show that changes in the natural bypass effect cannot be reduced to a single downstream sensitivity: in replicated Pythia runs, local missing-update magnitude grows while the pooled matched downstream response decreases, whereas OLMo-2 7B exhibits a different balance. These matched responses also depend on perturbation strength and direction, without identifying targeted compensation. Together, our results show that longitudinal layer sensitivity is structured but not static, and that single-checkpoint intervention responses should be interpreted in the context of how the underlying perturbation pathway evolves during training.

</details>


### [426] [How Much Can Language Models Gain from Test-Time Computation?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01110)
*Bangji Yang,Jingyuan Li,Jiajun Fan,Yi Evie Zhang,Ruihan Guo,Hongba Ma,Neil He,Chumeng Liang,Qinglong Zheng,Zhanghan Ni,Ge Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 SELF-POT 基准与评估框架，在统一预算规则（含选择/评审调用的美元成本）下，跨竞赛数学、竞技编程与智能体工作流测量模型的测试时潜力，并区分候选覆盖率与最终准确率、跟踪修订下的正确性转移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测试时缩放常被提议作为更大模型的替代方案，但现有比较通常一次只评估单一领域，且很少把"选择"（selection/critique）的开销计入预算，导致增益被高估、跨领域结论不可比。

Method: 构建 SELF-POT 基准与评估框架：1) 静态任务上分离候选覆盖率与最终准确率，跟踪修订过程中的正确性转移；2) 智能体环境中同时测量协议完成度与任务成功率；3) 统一预算规则下，以 Direct 推理为基线，在固定预算倍数处比较 Direct 与并行采样、自修订；4) 将每次模型调用（含选择与评审）按美元计费。用于两类比较：同一模型从额外推理获得的增益，以及低成本模型+额外推理对抗更强模型。

Result: 在 350 个封存任务、5 个低成本推理模型上，以 Claude Opus 5.5 Direct 为参考，增益随领域、选择规则和失败处理方式而变化。重放保留的编程候选池：基于公开样例的选择将正确提交从 500 个计划单元中的 376 提升至 453，同时节省 12–49% 的逻辑 API 成本；判题失败时直接保留可用候选，可在成本不变下多恢复 61 个提交。在相同数学候选池上，带回退的判题得到 186 个正确提交，投票为 182，但投票节省 12–21% 逻辑 API 成本。

Conclusion: 在相同生成候选下，选择规则与失败处理会显著改变实际获得的增益，并量化了模型判题器的边际价值；测试时缩放的可比评估必须把选择与评审成本纳入预算。

Abstract: How much can test-time computation improve a language model, and at what cost? Test-time scaling is widely proposed as a substitute for larger models, but existing comparisons mostly evaluate one domain at a time and rarely charge selection to the budget. We introduce SELF-POT, a benchmark and evaluation framework that measures the test-time potential of a model across competition mathematics, competitive programming, and agentic workflows. SELF-POT separates candidate coverage from final accuracy on static tasks, tracks correctness transitions under revision, and measures protocol completion alongside task success in agentic environments. Under a unified budget rule, it compares Direct inference with parallel sampling and self-revision under fixed multiples of the Direct budget, and charges every model call, including selection and critique, in dollars. This design supports two kinds of comparison: the gain a model obtains from additional inference, and a lower-cost model with additional inference against a stronger model. Across five low-cost reasoning models on 350 sealed tasks, with Claude Opus 5.5 Direct as the reference, the returns depend on the domain, the selection rule, and failure handling. When we replay the retained programming candidate pools, public-example selection raises correct submissions from 376 to 453 of 500 scheduled cells while saving 12-49% of logical API cost across models, and simply retaining an available candidate when judging fails recovers 61 submissions at unchanged cost. On identical mathematics pools, judging with fallback yields 186 correct submissions versus 182 for voting, while voting saves 12-21% of logical API cost. These controlled replays show how selection and failure handling change the gains realized from the same generated candidates, and they quantify the marginal value of a model judge.

</details>


### [427] [Latent Information Sharing for Accelerating Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01126)
*Seungjun Lee,Ensieh Khazaei,Dimitrios Hatzinakos,Baturalp Buyukates,Sunwoo Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种新型潜在信息共享方案，通过共享少量隐藏层激活来直接缓解联邦学习中的客户端漂移问题，在保证收敛性与数据隐私的前提下显著提升训练效率，并在固定通信轮次预算下优于FedProx、SCAFFOLD、FedPVR、FedProto和SplitFed等方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习是一种通信高效的分布式学习范式，但客户端漂移（client drift）是阻碍全局模型高效训练的关键挑战之一，其根源在于客户端间数据异构（non-IID）。现有方法如FedProx、SCAFFOLD等多从优化修正或正则化角度缓解漂移，未直接针对数据异构本身进行信息层面的弥补，因此性能与通信开销之间仍存在权衡空间。

Method: 提出一种潜在信息共享（latent information sharing）方案，在客户端之间直接共享少量的隐藏层激活值，以此弥合客户端间的数据异构。作者从理论与实证两方面分析了激活共享对联邦优化过程的影响，并将其与多种主流联邦学习算法（FedProx、SCAFFOLD、FedPVR、FedProto、SplitFed）在固定通信轮次预算下进行对比。

Result: 理论与实验结果均表明，共享少量隐藏层激活能够显著提升训练效率，同时保持收敛性保证与数据隐私；在固定轮次预算下，所提方法的模型精度优于FedProx、SCAFFOLD、FedPVR、FedProto和SplitFed，且未引入过度的通信开销。

Conclusion: 本文提出了一种有前景的新型知识聚合方案，并对激活共享在联邦优化中的作用给出了较为全面的分析，为缓解客户端漂移、提升联邦学习训练效率提供了新的思路。

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) is a communication-efficient distributed learning paradigm. However, client drift remains one of the most critical challenges, hindering the efficient training of a global model. In this study, we propose a novel latent information sharing scheme that directly mitigates data heterogeneity across clients. Our theoretical and empirical results show that sharing a small amount of hidden-layer activations significantly improves training efficiency while preserving convergence guarantees and data privacy. Furthermore, we compare our method with existing FL approaches designed to address client drift, including FedProx, SCAFFOLD, FedPVR, FedProto, and SplitFed, and demonstrate superior model accuracy under a fixed round budget without incurring excessive communication overhead. Overall, this work presents a promising new knowledge aggregation scheme and provides a comprehensive analysis of the impact of activation sharing on federated optimization.

</details>


### [428] [Does Scaling Reinforcement Learning Really Require More Training?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01133)
*Bangji Yang,Jiajun Fan,Hongba Ma,Ruihan Guo,Ge Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"策略空间扩展"概念：在固定RL训练历史中通过模型融合构造新策略，超越原有检查点性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩展推理能力通常依赖增加RL训练算力或推理算力，但已完成的RL训练历史中存储的策略信息可能未被充分利用。

Method: SURGE方法：选取同一次RL运行中的高精度锚点与生成更短回复的捐赠者检查点，将其表示为相对共享初始化的更新，对锚点更新做谱分解保留主导成分并融入捐赠者的互补成分；按固定保留比例从权重直接确定块大小，无需评估候选策略。

Result: 在DeepSeek与Nemotron两个1.5B数学推理历史及OLMo 7B代码历史上验证：DeepSeek AIME24达54.17%（原最高50.83%），OLMo HumanEval+达83.7%（原82.8%），且推理token少于锚点；几何对照实验表明RL更新结构本身具有作用。

Conclusion: RL训练历史是一种可复用的扩展资源，训练运行所能提供的能力不必止步于最优检查点。

Abstract: Scaling reasoning typically spends more compute on reinforcement learning (RL) or on inference. We show that a completed RL training history can yield policies stronger than the checkpoints visited by its optimizer. We call this policy-space scaling: expanding the deployable policy set accessible from a fixed RL history, without extending training or increasing per-query inference computation. We instantiate it with SURGE (Scaling Up RL Gradient-free via Eigenspace fusion). SURGE combines two checkpoints from the same RL run: a high-accuracy anchor and a competitive donor that generates shorter responses. It expresses both checkpoints as changes from their shared initialization, then spectrally decomposes the anchor's update to retain its dominant component and incorporate the donor's complementary component. With a fixed target for how much of the anchor update to retain, SURGE determines the block size from the weights without testing candidate policies. We evaluate two 1.5B mathematical-reasoning histories, DeepSeek and Nemotron, and one 7B coding history, OLMo. SURGE improves benchmark-average accuracy over both input checkpoints while using fewer reasoning tokens than the anchor. It reaches 54.17% on DeepSeek AIME24 against a measured native maximum of 50.83%, and 83.7% on OLMo HumanEval+ against 82.8%. These gains exceed the observed training curves. Geometric controls support the importance of RL-update structure beyond weight displacement or token reduction alone. Each constructed model runs as a single policy. Our findings identify stored RL history as a reusable scaling resource: the capability available from a training run need not end at its best checkpoint.

</details>


### [429] [Parameter-Efficient Distributionally Robust Adaptation of Tabular Foundation Models under Subpopulation Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01143)
*Seonghwi Kim,Sung Ho Jo,Minwoo Chae*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DR-TFM：一种无需真实组标注的参数高效分布鲁棒适配框架，通过仅微调/训练查询缩放网络调整注意力，在五个表格基准上显著提升最差组准确率，同时保持平均准确率竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型（TFM）尽管平均准确率高，但在子群体分布偏移（训练与部署时组比例变化）下对代表性不足的群体表现较差。

Method: 提出 DR-TFM：参数高效的分布鲁棒适配框架，无需真实组标注。通过微调已有查询缩放网络或新增并训练一个查询缩放网络来调整对带标签上下文样本的注意力，其余参数全部冻结。使用由训练数据估计得到的组或源条件分布实例化两种鲁棒目标。以 TabPFN-3 为例，仅更新预训练模型 0.016% 的参数。

Result: 在五个表格基准上，DR-TFM 在无真实组标注条件下取得显著更高的平均最差组准确率，优于预训练 TFM 和对比的鲁棒基线，同时平均组准确率具有竞争力；在 ACS Income 及另外四个 TFM 上亦提升平均最差组准确率。

Conclusion: DR-TFM 证明通过极少量参数的高效适配即可实现无组标注的分布鲁棒性，适用于多种表格基础模型。

Abstract: Despite strong mean accuracy, tabular foundation models (TFMs) can perform poorly on underrepresented groups under subpopulation shift, where group proportions change between training and deployment. We propose DR-TFM, a parameter-efficient distributionally robust adaptation framework that requires no true group annotations. DR-TFM adjusts attention to labeled context examples by fine-tuning an existing query scaling network or adding and training one, while keeping all other parameters fixed. We instantiate the framework with two robust objectives using estimated groups or source conditional distributions derived from training data. For TabPFN-3, adaptation updates only 0.016% of the pretrained model's parameters. Across five tabular benchmarks, DR-TFM achieves substantially higher average worst-group accuracy than pretrained TFMs and the compared robust baselines without true group annotations, while maintaining competitive mean group accuracy. DR-TFM also improves average worst-group accuracy on ACS Income and across four additional TFMs.

</details>


### [430] [Looping Beyond Twice: A Scalable Recipe for Looped Mixture-of-Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01153)
*Di He,Pengxiang Li,Da Chang,Qingyan Meng,Lu Yin,Shiwei Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对循环式MoE大模型在FLOPs对齐下收益递减的问题，诊断出"深度诅咒导致隐状态方差累积"与"专家选择坍缩"两大障碍，提出LOOM，通过稳定循环状态并强制每轮循环贡献新计算，将循环深度稳定扩展至9-12层。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环Transformer以共享块重复应用来增加有效深度而不增加参数量，是一种新的扩展维度。但在FLOPs对齐比较下，大规模MoE LLM中循环的收益不明确：额外迭代的增益迅速衰减甚至转为退化，导致先前工作通常只采用两次循环。作者希望厘清限制循环式MoE扩展的根本原因并加以解决。

Method: 作者首先诊断出两个障碍：(1) 循环继承并放大了"深度诅咒"，残差更新累积使隐状态方差随迭代增长，破坏深层递归稳定性并造成表示漂移；(2) 循环式MoE出现专家选择坍缩，路由器在各轮循环中反复选择相同专家，使额外迭代只增加计算量而不增加计算多样性。基于"每轮循环既贡献新计算又保持递归状态稳定"的原则，提出LOOM：通过缩放残差更新以约束方差增长，并在每轮循环重新注入输入embedding来稳定递归；通过每轮独立路由器（激活不同专家）与Looping Residual（前向传递早期输出）实现计算多样化。

Result: 在100M-1.7B模型上实验，可稳定扩展至9-12次循环。近似等FLOP下，700M模型在5次循环时最优，困惑度从18.36降至16.54，平均零样本准确率从38.84%提升至39.53%；不做FLOP对齐时，1.7B模型在60B token训练下于9次循环达峰值，困惑度从9.62降至7.77，平均零样本准确率从42.4%提升至47.7%。

Conclusion: 循环是MoE LLM可用的有效扩展轴，但需同时解决递归稳定性与计算多样性两个问题；LOOM通过方差约束、输入重注入、每轮独立路由与Looping Residual，使循环式MoE在广泛规模下稳定扩展并取得一致的性能增益。代码已开源。

Abstract: Looped Transformers introduce recurrent depth as a new scaling axis for LLMs: by repeatedly applying shared Transformer blocks, they increase effective depth without increasing parameter count. However, the benefits of looping remain unclear for large MoE LLMs under FLOPs-matched comparisons. The main reason is that the gains from additional iterations diminish quickly and can even turn into degradation, so the extra FLOPs spent on looping yield little substantial improvement. Consequently, prior work typically settles on two loops. We identify two main obstacles to scaling looped MoE. First, looping inherits and amplifies the curse of depth: hidden-state variance grows with each iteration as residual updates accumulate, which destabilizes deep recurrence and causes representations to drift. Second, looped MoE suffers from expert selection collapse: routers repeatedly select the same experts across loops, so extra iterations add computation without adding computational diversity. Guided by this diagnosis, we propose LOOM, built on a single principle: each loop should contribute new computation while keeping the recurrent state stable. LOOM stabilizes recurrence by scaling residual updates to bound variance growth and re-injecting the input embedding at every loop, and diversifies it through per-loop routers that engage different experts and a Looping Residual that carries earlier outputs forward. Experiments across 100M-1.7B models show stable scaling to 9-12 loops. Under near-iso-FLOP, the 700M model performs best at 5 loops, reducing perplexity from 18.36 to 16.54 and improving average zero-shot accuracy from 38.84% to 39.53% over the non-looped baseline. Without FLOP matching, the 1.7B model trained on 60B tokens peaks at 9 loops, reducing perplexity from 9.62 to 7.77 and improving average zero-shot accuracy from 42.4% to 47.7%. Code is available https://github.com/hed-ucas/LOOM.

</details>


### [431] [Detect, Explain, Interpret: An End-to-End Benchmark for Time Series Anomaly Detection, Explainability and Interpretability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01168)
*Roberto Stanzione,Jules Barbe,Magali Parrino,Jérémie Fourmann,Paul Boniol*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SHAD——一个由Scality真实分布式云存储系统采集的215条多元高维时间序列组成、带丰富语义标注的时间序列异常检测基准，覆盖三类不同严重度的异常，并为检测、可解释性和可理解性三个环节提供基线评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列异常检测方法日益增多，但多数检测器与领域语境脱节，忽视可解释性与可理解性。现有基准主要关注检测精度，仅少数评估空间可解释性，且没有任何基准提供足够丰富的语义标注来支撑生成人类可理解的异常解释。

Method: 构建SHAD基准：采集自Scality真实分布式云存储系统的215条多元高维时间序列，包含丰富上下文信息，覆盖三类严重程度不同的异常。并在此基础上评估覆盖TSAD流水线各阶段的基线方法：检测方面测试多种现有异常检测器；可解释性方面评估通过度量各维度对异常分数的贡献能否实现准确的异常归因；可理解性方面考察冻结LLM基线在异常定位与解释上的有效性。

Result: 在真实世界数据集上验证了现有异常检测器的有效性，评估了基于维度贡献的异常归因准确性，并检验了冻结LLM基线在异常定位与解释任务上的表现。

Conclusion: SHAD通过提供带丰富语义标注的高维多元真实时间序列基准，弥补了现有基准在空间可解释性和可理解性方面的不足，并为后续检测、可解释性与可理解性研究提供了基线基础。

Abstract: Time Series Anomaly Detection has received increasing attention, driven by the growing availability of complex time series data. This surge has led to the development of numerous detection methods, as well as a variety of benchmarks aimed at thoroughly evaluating their performance. However, most existing detectors remain largely agnostic to domain context, overlooking explainability and interpretability. One of the main reasons for this gap is that current benchmarks primarily focus on detection accuracy, and only few of them evaluate spatial explainability. Moreover, no benchmark currently provides sufficiently rich semantic annotations to support the generation of human-understandable interpretations of anomalies. To address these limitations, we introduce SHAD (Scality High-dimensional Anomaly Detection benchmark), a fully annotated benchmark composed of 215 multivariate, high-dimensional time series collected from real-world distributed cloud storage systems operated by Scality. The proposed dataset includes rich contextual information, covering three families of anomalies with varying degrees of severity. As further contribution, we provide a foundation for future work by evaluating baseline methods for Detection, Explainability, and Interpretability, covering all stages of a TSAD pipeline. For Detection, we benchmark a wide range of existing anomaly detectors, testing their effectiveness on the proposed real-world dataset. Then, we consider explainability by evaluating whether measuring the contribution of each dimension in the generated anomaly score can provide accurate anomaly attributions. Finally, for interpretability, we investigate the effectiveness of frozen LLM baselines in localizing and interpreting anomalies.

</details>


### [432] [QK-Wanda: Coupling Queries and Keys for Unstructured Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01554)
*Ivan Ilin,Peter Richtárik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出QK-Wanda，一种耦合查询与键投影的LLM剪枝准则，在无掩码pre-RoPE重构目标下按删除代价评分并共享剪枝预算，重构误差较Wanda显著降低，但下游收益因模型而异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Wanda等现有方法在每个线性投影内独立评分权重，忽略了查询与键通过点积相互作用的耦合关系，导致剪枝准则与QK实际功能不匹配。

Method: 提出QK-Wanda：在未掩码的pre-RoPE重构目标下，以单个权重删除代价对查询和键权重评分；用对侧投影信息（键信息用于查询权重、查询信息用于键权重）增强Wanda分数；二者共享同一剪枝预算；分数有闭式解，无需梯度或权重更新。

Result: 在TinyLlama、Llama 2、Llama 3、Qwen2.5共15个0.5B-72B模型上评估QK-only剪枝：相比Wanda，QK重构误差在50%稀疏度下平均降低60%，80%下降低45%；A100上剪枝耗时仅增1.3%，H200增3.1%。Llama 2 70B在80%稀疏度下WikiText-2与C4困惑度分别下降20.3%和13.5%，零样本平均准确率提升5.94个百分点；Qwen2.5-72B亦有提升，但Llama-3.1-70B困惑度明显更高。

Conclusion: 耦合剪枝准则具有潜力，但局部重构误差并非模型质量的可靠预测指标——Llama-3.1-70B在重构误差更低的情况下困惑度反而更高。

Abstract: Wanda (Sun et al., 2024) prunes large language models by scoring weights independently within each linear projection, although queries and keys interact through dot products. We introduce QK-Wanda, which scores query and key weights by their individual deletion costs under an unmasked pre-RoPE reconstruction objective. It augments Wanda scores with information from the opposite projection (keys for query weights, and queries for key weights), allowing both projections to share a pruning budget. Its closed-form scores require no gradients or weight updates; full pruning takes 1.3% longer than Wanda on A100 and 3.1% longer on H200 with the calibration used in our main experiments. We evaluate QK-only pruning across 15 models from TinyLlama, Llama 2, Llama 3, and Qwen2.5, spanning 0.5B-72B parameters. Relative to Wanda, QK-Wanda reduces QK reconstruction error by an average of 60% at 50% sparsity and 45% at 80%. Downstream gains depend on the model. At 80% sparsity on Llama 2 70B, WikiText-2 and C4 perplexity decrease by 20.3% and 13.5%, while mean zero-shot accuracy rises by 5.94 percentage points. Qwen2.5-72B also improves, but Llama-3.1-70B has substantially higher perplexity despite lower reconstruction error. These results show both the promise of coupled pruning criteria and the limits of local reconstruction as a predictor of model quality.

</details>


### [433] [Learning Rate Transfer for Hybrid Transformer-SSM Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01172)
*Jimin Seo,Gyubok Lee,Yeonsik Jo,Kiwoong Yoo,Yeongoon Kim,Minhae Oh,Jin Woo Koo,Suhwan Kim,Nakyung Lee,Minsik Seol,Idris Nechnech,Jaehyeon Kim,Giho Lee,Jungwoo Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究Transformer与状态空间模型(SSM)混合架构的学习率缩放，发现尽管这类架构不满足μP的理论条件，仅用原始μP配方即可在256-2048宽度、4-32深度直至十亿参数规模实现近乎零的学习率迁移差距，其机制可分解为全局更新-权重不变性与AdamW提供的局部逐分量平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合架构已用于多个近期生产级语言模型，但理论上的SSM缩放规则（基于无限宽度、状态规模增长的ZOH离散化）与实践中固定状态规模的简化ZOH Mamba实现之间存在明显差距。作者希望弥合这一理论与实践之间的鸿沟。

Method: 作者在Transformer与SSM混合架构上进行学习率迁移实验，覆盖宽度256-2048、深度4-32直至十亿参数规模，仅采用原始μP（maximal update parametrization）配方，并与零阶保持(ZOH)离散化、无限宽度下推导的SSM理论缩放规则进行对比。研究还检验了SSM操作是否满足张量程序(Tensor Programs)的可表示性条件，以及各参数化是否通过μP的标准坐标检验诊断。

Result: 在该实际训练区间内，混合架构仅用原始μP处方即实现了近乎零的学习率迁移差距，即便SSM操作超出张量程序可表示性条件、且所有测试的参数化都未通过μP正确性的标准坐标检验诊断。最优学习率对宽度保持不变（可达8倍），该宽度不变性在深度、序列长度、批大小和Transformer-to-SSM比例上均成立，并可迁移到生产级混合模型Nemotron-H。

Conclusion: 作者将混合架构中的学习率迁移分解为两个条件：由μP初始化和学习率缩放保证的全局更新-权重不变性，以及由AdamW逐参数归一化提供的局部逐分量平衡。研究结果填补了理论缩放规则与实际混合实现之间的空白，并呼吁进一步研究以弥合二者差距。

Abstract: We study learning rate (LR) scaling for hybrid architectures combining Transformer and State-Space Model (SSM) blocks, a class adopted by several recent production language models. In particular, we focus on the gap between the theoretical scaling rules derived for SSMs under zero-order-hold (ZOH) discretization at infinite width with growing state size, and the field-standard practical implementations using simplified-ZOH Mamba at fixed state size. Surprisingly, in this practical regime hybrid architectures achieve a near-zero LR transfer gap across widths 256-2048 and depths 4-32 up to billion-parameter scale using only the original $μ$P prescription, even though SSM operations fall outside its Tensor Programs representability conditions and every parameterization we test fails the standard coordinate-check diagnostic of $μ$P correctness. We attribute this to a two-condition decomposition of LR transfer in hybrid architectures: a global update-to-weight invariance, enforced by $μ$P's initialization and LR scaling; and a local per-component balance, provided by AdamW's per-parameter normalization. Our observations show that the optimal LR is invariant to width up to 8$\times$, that this width invariance holds across depth, sequence length, batch size, and Transformer-to-SSM ratio, and that it transfers to Nemotron-H, a production hybrid outside our custom architecture set. We hope these findings fill the gap between theoretical scaling rules and practical hybrid implementations, and stimulate further research toward bridging it.

</details>


### [434] [CAGE-NAS: Certified Functional Descent for Efficient Model Growth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01173)
*Santiago Florido Gomez,Stéphane Rivaud*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CAGE-NAS：在函数空间用泛函梯度近似的可容许性准则决定神经网络表示是否扩展，准则失效时进行保函数扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 渐进式增长的神经网络需要判断当前表示何时仍足以支持优化、何时应当扩展，现有方法缺乏在函数空间中对这一决策的严格刻画。

Method: 将增长决策表述为函数空间中对泛函梯度近似的可容许性准则：若表示能保证一个经认证的泛函梯度下降步，则架构固定；准则失效时施加保函数扩展并重新评估。主要实例研究切空间诱导的族，使用泛函梯度的正则化投影。

Result: 在具有精确认证的受控设定中，CAGE-NAS生成的架构在同参数预算的所有可容许备选中，按留出RMSE位于第99.8百分位以上，且增长轨迹中无需枚举候选。

Conclusion: CAGE-NAS通过函数空间可容许性准则实现了有认证的架构增长决策，在受控条件下以极低枚举成本获得高性能表示。

Abstract: The progressive growth of neural networks requires deciding when the current representation remains sufficient for optimization and when it should be expanded. CAGE-NAS formulates this decision in function space through an admissibility criterion on approximations of the functional gradient. As long as a representation enables a certified Functional Gradient Descent step, the architecture remains fixed; when the criterion fails, a function-preserving expansion is applied and the resulting representation is evaluated again. As the main instance, we study the family induced by the tangent space, using a regularized projection of the functional gradient. In a controlled setting with exact certification, CAGE-NAS produces architectures positioned above the 99.8th performance percentile by held-out RMSE among all admissible alternatives within the same parameter budget, without enumerating them during the growth trajectory.

</details>


### [435] [A Safe Prototype Is Not a Safety Direction: Reference Dependence and Prompt Confounds in Response-Safety Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01801)
*Sahil Kadadekar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究审计了"用安全响应的均值嵌入（正质心）通过余弦相似度打分响应安全性"这一做法，发现该质心仅提供类别位置而非安全方向，在多个数据集上表现不稳定甚至低于随机，而显式的"安全减不安全"参考向量显著更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期一种"sleeper-agent检测器"提出用正质心（正样本均值嵌入）的余弦相似度来评分响应安全性。然而该原始正质心规则从未被明确识别：正样本只能确定安全类别相对于编码器原点的位置，却无法确定区分安全与不安全响应的方向。作者因此系统审计该规则的有效性。

Method: 在两个受提示控制、人工标注的语料库及一个辅助的评审（jury）标注来源控制上，使用四个冻结编码器和按提示分组的划分进行审计。对比"安全原型（正质心）"与"显式安全减不安全参考向量"，并在验证集校准的5%假安全阈值下评估，同时进行无标注与少量标注的参考恢复实验及仅提示消融分析。

Result: 在人工标注语料上，安全原型ROC-AUC为0.457–0.545，其中两个单元格显著低于随机、一个高于随机；而显式安全减不安全参考在同一嵌入上达到0.588–0.738。在jury控制上原型反向（0.358–0.405），参考达0.754–0.793。在5%假安全阈值下，参考在PKU-SafeRLHF（0.153–0.263 vs 0.039–0.061）和Aegis（0.189–0.291 vs 0.004–0.045）接受更多安全响应，但在BeaverTails上不可靠。完全无标注的留出参考可恢复部分至大部分排序效果，当不安全比例仅5%时恢复较少，80–634个标注不安全响应可恢复大部分。仅提示消融显示提示-标签构成会夸大非受控评估。

Conclusion: 这是一个关于原始正质心的有限结论，并非针对所有单类方法或安全专用防护模型。类别均值只是一个"位置"，未必是"安全方向"；只有声明明确的参考向量且具备足够的不安全样本量，才能识别方向。因此用正质心余弦相似度评分响应安全性不可靠。

Abstract: Can response safety be scored by cosine similarity to the mean embedding of known-safe responses? A recent sleeper-agent detector proposes exactly this score, yet the raw positive-centroid rule is not identified: positive observations locate the safe class relative to an encoder origin, but do not determine which direction separates safe from unsafe responses. We audit the rule on two prompt-controlled, human-labeled corpora and one auxiliary jury-labeled source control, using four frozen encoders and prompt-grouped splits. On the human-labeled corpora the safe prototype reaches ROC-AUC 0.457-0.545, with two cells significantly below chance and one above, while an explicit safe-minus-unsafe reference reaches 0.588-0.738 on the same embeddings; on the jury control the prototype is inverted (0.358-0.405) and the reference reaches 0.754-0.793. At validation-calibrated 5% false-safe thresholds, the reference accepts more safe responses on PKU-SafeRLHF (0.153-0.263 versus 0.039-0.061 across encoders) and Aegis (0.189-0.291 versus 0.004-0.045), but not reliably on BeaverTails. A fully unlabeled held-out reference recovers part to most of the referenced ranking, much less when only 5% of the pool is unsafe, whereas 80-634 labeled unsafe responses recover most of it. Prompt-only ablations show that prompt-label composition can inflate uncontrolled evaluations. This is a bounded result about a raw positive centroid, not all one-class methods or safety-specialized guards. A class mean is a location, not necessarily a safety direction; a declared reference with enough unsafe mass identifies orientation.

</details>


### [436] [Rethinking the Information Bottleneck: Structured Decomposition under Label-Induced Partitions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01175)
*Jingyao Zhang,Yuxuan Li,Lu Han,Ali Anaissi,Nguyen H. Tran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种双重瓶颈（dual-bottleneck）信息瓶颈正则化方法，通过标签诱导划分将全局信息容量与条件内信息解耦，以抑制冗余变异、提升低数据场景下的泛化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准信息瓶颈（IB）仅用单一标量 I(Z;X) 约束表示，将所有信息视为同质，导致一个全局压缩控制同时耦合了标签相关结构与条件内残差变异，无法独立调节二者的分配，使冗余信息残留在学到的表示中。在医学影像等任务中，残差变异常源于采集条件、背景因素或受试者外观差异，在数据受限时尤为突出，模型易过拟合此类变异从而损害泛化。已有正则化方法虽能稳定训练、控制容量或塑造表示几何，但并未显式分离冗余变异与任务支持结构。

Method: 作者从基于标签诱导划分的结构化视角重新审视 IB，其中条件级结构与条件内信息扮演不同角色，从而提出双重瓶颈形式：一个标准 KL 项控制全局信息容量，一个条件 KL 项针对条件内信息。理论上证明条件 KL 可精确分解为条件内信息项与先验失配项，说明其与设计目标的一致性。采用单纯形结构的条件先验，使方法具备可控的隐空间几何，并能无缝集成到既有流程中。

Result: 在分类与分割任务上的实验表明：在低数据分类场景中增益最为显著，并在密集预测基准上取得一致的性能提升。

Conclusion: 通过将 IB 从单一全局压缩扩展为结构化双重瓶颈，该方法显式区分并独立调控标签相关结构与条件内冗余变异，兼具理论可解释性（条件 KL 的精确分解）与工程易用性（单纯形先验、即插即用），在数据受限条件下有效缓解过拟合并改善泛化表现。

Abstract: Standard information bottleneck (IB) regularization constrains representations via a single scalar I(Z;X), implicitlytreating all information as homogeneous.
